world.title: Forbidden Zones
world.introText: In Shrouding the Heavens, the Life Forbidden Zones (生命禁区) are the most terrifying and mysterious regions in the universe. Also called Forbidden Lands or simply Forbidden Zones, they are ancient domains where former Heavenly Venerables, Ancient Emperors, and Great Emperors sealed themselves at the brink of death. Unable to accept the end of their lifespan, these supreme figures performed the act known as “self-severing” (自斩一刀), cutting away part of their Emperor-level cultivation and falling from the complete Emperor realm. Afterward, they sealed themselves within Immortal Source (神源) to delay the passage of time and wait for the opening of the Path to Immortality (成仙路).
world.history:
Notable Supreme: 大鹏古皇 — Great Roc Ancient Emperor

A floating forbidden region in the heavens. It served as a sealed habitat for ancient Supremes awaiting immortality. During Ye Fan’s breakthrough to Emperor as the Holy Body, a Supreme from this region was slain in battle. Later, the remaining Supremes were eradicated when Ye Fan completely pacified the zone.

characters.title: Duan De
characters.introText: Duan De (段德), also known by his many aliases such as the Fat Taoist (胖道士) and the Grave-Robbing Daoist, is one of the most iconic and enigmatic characters in Shrouding the Heavens. His appearance is instantly recognizable and contrasts with the elegant, immortal cultivators commonly seen in the series.
characters.appearance: Duan De is a short and plump middle-aged Taoist with a round face and a perpetually amused, crafty expression. He rarely appears dignified; instead, he carries himself with the confidence of someone who is always plotting his next scheme.
characters.personality:
Duan De, often known as the Fat Taoist (胖道士), possesses one of the most colorful and unpredictable personalities in Shrouding the Heavens. At first glance, he appears greedy, shameless, and comical, but beneath his eccentric behavior lies an exceptionally intelligent, loyal, and ancient individual who has witnessed countless ages.

Duan De is an extraordinary strategist who rarely acts without a plan. He excels at:

Reading people's intentions.

Turning unfavorable situations to his advantage.

Outsmarting enemies far stronger than himself.

Escaping seemingly impossible dangers.

His quick wit and adaptability make him one of the most difficult people to deceive.

Perhaps his most famous trait is his obsession with treasures.

He constantly searches for:

Emperor inheritances.

Divine medicines.

Heavenly materials.

Emperor Weapons.

His love of wealth often leads him into dangerous situations, yet he possesses remarkable judgment and knows when a treasure is worth the risk.

Duan De has virtually no concern for appearances.

Lies without hesitation.

Exaggerates stories.

Bargains over everything.

Tricks friends and enemies alike.

Calls himself a righteous Taoist while doing the exact opposite.

His shameless antics provide much of the series' humor, earning him a reputation as one of its funniest characters.

Despite his greed and trickster nature, Duan De is deeply loyal to those he truly considers friends.

Although he often argues with and deceives Ye Fan over treasures, he repeatedly risks his own life to fight alongside him during humanity's greatest crises.

When true danger arrives, he never abandons his companions.

Having experienced countless reincarnations and possessing fragments of ancient memories, Duan De is one of the most knowledgeable figures in the novel.

He has profound understanding of:

Ancient history.

Forbidden Areas.

Formation techniques.

Tombs and mausoleums.

Daoist cultivation.

Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures.

Many mysteries that puzzle even Holy Lands are ordinary knowledge to him.
characters.history:
The name "Duan de" in Chinese does not have a single meaning and depends on the Hanzi character used for "de". If "de" means "from" or "belonging to", then "Duan de" can mean "Duan of" or "belonging to Duan". However, "de" can also mean "good" or "to have", so "Duan de" can mean "good Duan" or "Duan who has".

Here is a more detailed explanation:

Duan (段): Is a surname in China, Vietnam, and Korea. It can also mean "segment" or "paragraph" in Mandarin.

De (德): Can mean "good," "advantage," "goodness," or "ability."

De (的): Used as a particle to indicate possession or "from".

So, if "de" means "from", then "Duan de" means "Duan of" or "belonging to Duan". If "de" means "good", then "Duan de" can mean "good Duan" or "Duan who has goodness".

If you want to say "good Duan", you can use "Duan de" (段德) with "de" meaning "good".

If you want to say "Duan from the Chen family", you can use "Duan de Chen" (段的陈) with "de" meaning "from".

The meaning of the name "Duan de" depends on the Chinese character "de" used. "De" can have different meanings, and this will affect the overall meaning of the name.
characters.trivia:
Duan De is one of the few characters connected to all three protagonists of Chen Dong's trilogy, having formed close friendships with Shi Hao (Perfect World), Ye Fan (Shrouding the Heavens), and Chu Feng (The Sacred Ruins).

Despite losing his memories across many "reincarnations", Duan De retains faint instincts from his past life as Cao Yusheng. During the Chaotic Ancient Era, he buried his close friend and sworn brother Shi Hao (Desolate Heaven Emperor) after his death. The emotional imprint left behind from that era remained buried within his subconscious, causing him to instinctively search for Shi Hao even after forgetting the events themselves. This lingering attachment manifested as an unconscious habit of digging ancient graves, driven by a desire he could no longer understand as if searching for something he had forgotten but never truly lost.
characters.quotes: “Where did I come from?”

characters.title: Ji Ziyue
characters.introText: ⭐Ji Ziyue is one of the main deuteragonists in Shrouding The heavens. (Novel/Donghua) She is also one of the wives of Ye Fan.⭐
characters.appearance: A goddess from an ancient family, Ye Fan's wife, the younger sister of Ji Haoyue, the Eastern Wilderness God Body, and a descendant of the Void Emperor.
characters.personality:
Ji Ziyue has a naughty yet charming personality, agile like the moonlight dancing among the stars, always bringing joy and charm that is hard to forget.

She has a Yuanling body (wet nurse), is friendly to the law, can use the power of heaven and earth for her own use, has a lively and naughty personality but is often narcissistic.
characters.history:
This was the main reason why Ji Ziyue showed her this ring. She couldn’t calm down after seeing this scene. Knowing that Ye Fan was going to leave, she couldn’t help but tell him the secret of the five-colored altar. In Ji Ziyue’s dream, it was a very remote mountain village. The little girl came from a poor family. Her clothes were patched up and even her shoes had holes. It was very pitiful. The young man was her only relative. They depended on each other. The demon mask was their only toy. There was no luxurious jewelry. In order to make the little girl happy, the young man used a piece of bronze to make a ring for her. Although it was very crude, the little girl treated it as a treasure.

Later, a group of people came and treated the young man as a genius. They took him away but shook their heads at the little girl's talent. No matter how she cried, they forcibly took the young man away. The little girl cried and ran away with her tattered shoes. The young man begged bitterly and the group finally agreed to let him send them away.  Finally, they arrived in front of the five-colored altar. The young man and a group of people, as well as many young geniuses, climbed up and were about to leave. No matter how much the little girl cried, she couldn't get any closer.  Before leaving, the young man took the demon mask and left his ring. He waved at her and finally disappeared from the five-colored altar.

A few years later, the little girl grew up in hardship. She always guarded the altar, and one day, she saw many people coming back. She ignored everything and ran forward, only to see the young man's skeleton. She was forcibly pulled away, not even able to see him. She cried loudly, and from then on, she was never seen again. All the scenes ended there and never appeared again. This was the blurry scene that Ji Ziyue often dreamed of when wearing the ring.
characters.trivia: Ji Ziyue wanted to follow Ye Fan to Earth, but was stopped by Ji Haoyue
characters.quotes: — Ji Ziyue looked at Ye Fan and said softly.

characters.title: Pang Bo
characters.introText: Born in his father's 30s, Pang Bo is Ye Fan's best friend since university first year in Jinan, Shandong, during the first decade of 2000. He is an atavistic distant descendant of an unknown Monster/Demon God of Earth from his father's side. This Monster/Demon God connection later made the Third Valley Lord from the Myriad Demon/Monster Valley of Mount Daba start a hidden, but fruitless investigation, into the unknown bloodline. He works at an unknown company after graduation.
characters.appearance:
Before Cultivation: When Pang Bo first appeared in the coffin, he held his mobile phone and had "bushy eyebrows and big eyes" with a sturdy body. As the name suggests, he has a "majestic (磅礴 páng bó, homonym)" appearance, but he is not fat, but really strong, burly man, his arms are almost as thick as ordinary people's legs. He inherited his tall burly figure from his father. His rejuvenation in the Ancient Desolation Forbidden Lands turned him into an eleven year old.

After being possessed by Emperor Azure/Qīng's descendant, he had thick waist long black hair, thick healthy bronze gloss limbs and a height over the average human. He also began to dress topless.

After Initial Atavism: Due to cultivating the Monster Emperor Ancient Scripture, the demon spirit as a Four Pole Realm is soaring to the sky, the momentum is like a mountain, powerful and sharp, with piercing eyes, like a god in the demon/monster race coming to the dust. Ch. 359/364/653/657

Third Batch of Undying Medicine Fruits: As a peak Dragon Transformation Realm cultivator, Pang Bo's

Daoist Tōngtiān: On the day Ye Fan finally set off on the trip back to Earth, Pang Bo's bloodline completed its awakening. This awakening caused Pang Bo's ...

Saint King 8th Layer: After the double layer jump tribulation, Pang Bo's body was really too huge, and now he was more than half a head taller. His muscles were bulging all over the body like a huge monument. His bronze body, which was more than ten feet (一丈多) tall, stood there, making people feel frightened. 妖尊宝体 ch.1645 妖尊眼
characters.personality:
Pang Bo possesses a resolute disposition accompanied by a nuanced sensibility. His upbringing under the red flag has not only endowed him with a robust character but also instilled in him a subtle bias against individuals who do not exhibit a Chinese appearance. This bias, while not overt, reflects a trace of prejudice deeply rooted in his background. He has a stubborn will that can survive three mortal years of isolation in gloomy darkness, two-and-half years in an extinct volcano's deadly refining formation, twelve years of being a fugitive, and some years in a Great Emperor's Tomb eating wooden coffin boards.

At heart, Pang Bo feared the unknown possibility of losing hope for his family if he returned to Earth, therefore he left all hope to Ye Fan.
characters.history:
庞 Páng is formed by two radicals: 广 yǎn for hut, 龙 lóng for Chinese Dragon. "Housing the dragon". 庞 means huge; big; disorderly; messy; shape of the face; facial contours.

博 Bó is formed by two radicals: 十 shí for 10; topmost; utmost, 尃 fū for to diffuse; scatter. "Widespread faraway." 博 means abundant; plentiful; rich; wide; broad.

庞博 Páng Bó describes "The family dragon spreads their majesty to the wide world and beyond" or "For great abundance." It is also a homonym of 磅礴 Pángbó meaning boundless, majestic; magnificent. The 磅礴 homonym was referred several times towards Pang Bo during the Shrouding the Heavens story.
characters.trivia: More than two years later, Pang Bo and Ye Fan reunited at Qishi Manor.

characters.introText: Ye Fan is the protagonist of the Shrouding the Heavens.
characters.appearance:
“Mortal Leaf”  or "Commoner of the Ye Family”

Ye Fan is:
The main character who started out as an ordinary person from Earth.

Treading the path of cultivation to become the highest existence in the universe.

The name describes the transformation from “ordinary” to “extraordinary”.

During college, he was a key player in the school football team, a popular figure in the school, and a lover of bizarre books. When he and his old classmates gathered at Mount Tai, they were taken away from the earth in a bronze coffin, and found the ruins of Leiyin Temple on Mars. After experiencing the catastrophe of the divine crocodile, they came to the Big Dipper Star Region. After being rescued by the girl Weiwei, they were selected by the six great caves. Only Ye Fan, who had an ancient holy body and could not practice conventional cultivation, was not accepted as a disciple, but he still stayed in Lingxu Cave to practice and figured out a way to move forward by himself.

The tomb of the Demon Emperor of the East Desert appeared. Ye Fan and Pang Bo went to watch, but Pang Bo was possessed by a big demon and left. Ye Fan, who gained some benefits in the treasure hunt, knew that Lingxu Dongtian was not a good place, so he left decisively. Later, he rescued Jiang Haisheng and Jiang Ting, the grandparents and grandchildren of the Jiang family who were stranded outside, but was chased by Jiang Yichen, who coveted Ye Fan's treasure and was in the team that took them back to the Jiang family. During the escape, he provoked Ziyang Dongtian and was despised by Li Xiaoman. Elder Han of Lingxu Dongtian wanted to refine it as medicine, but instead helped Ye Fan and was killed.

Ye Fan was forced by the three major forces to go to the ancient forbidden land to collect herbs, but all three factions were wiped out, but Ye Fan succeeded in getting the herbs. After that, Ye Fan went to Wei and was tricked into the land of the demon tribe by the unscrupulous Taoist Duan De, whom he met during the treasure hunt in the tomb of the demon emperor. The demon princess Yan Ruyu forced Ye Fan to nurture the heart of the demon emperor with his body. Soon after, the Ji family wanted to surround and kill this group of demons to seize the demon emperor's holy soldiers. In the fierce battle, Ye Fan hijacked Ji Ziyue and broke through. Later, he mistakenly entered the Tongyou River and broke into the ancient bronze palace, but did not dare to enter the gate of all wonders, and escaped through the passage made by the predecessors.

After Ji Ziyue unlocked the ban, she forced Ye Fan to cooperate with her. The two joined the Taixuan Sect to learn one of the Nine Secrets, and Ye Fan became Zhuo Feng's disciple.  Later, the old madman who had brought Ye Fan out of the ancient forbidden land suddenly appeared in Taixuan, alarming everyone. Ji Haoyue, the divine body of the Ji family, tested Ye Fan and found that his physique was strange. In order to protect his secret from being discovered, Ye Fan told everyone about the appearance of the ancient bronze palace and fled from Taixuan.

Peacock King killed the Ji family for Yan Ruyu. Someone took advantage of the situation and hunted down Ji Ziyue. Ye Fan met him again and escorted Ji Ziyue back to the Ji family after many dangers.

Ji Hui, the elder of the Ji family, was ungrateful and sent Ji Ren to hunt down Ye Fan because Ye Fan practiced the "Great Void Technique".

Ye Fan killed Ji Ren and went away, but was rescued and taken in by the Peacock King.

However, the Ji family and the various forces from the Yaoguang Holy Land soon entered the Peacock King's cave, and Ye Fan was forced to flee the Qixia Mountains in the middle of Jin State and enter the Fire Region at the western end. He rushed into the sixth level of "Purple Air Coming from the East" to escape. Half a year later, he wanted to go to the Northern Region of the East Desert from the Xiaoyao Gate, but failed because of the siege by the Ji family. He was chased by Ji Haiyue and had a cause and effect with Yao Xi, the Saint of Yaoguang. Ye Fan's power was sealed by Yao Xi's Fengxian Powder and he was mistaken for a mortal. He then took the opportunity of the Yaoguang Holy Land to select people to go to the Northern Region to dig for sources and went to the Northern Region, and escaped during the riot in the mining area.

After rescuing the village of Zhang Wuye, the descendant of Yuan Tianshi, Ye Fan obtained information, entered Guhuang Mountain to obtain Yuan Tianshu, was taught the secret of Dou character by Jiang Taixu, and established the Mining Sect, starting to create his own power.

Ye Fan wanted to obtain the Yao Chi Xihuang Sutra, so he transformed into a Taoist priest name Gu Feng.

After experiencing the Kunyun Stone Appreciation and Taichu adventures, he was invited by the Yao Chi Saint to participate in a stone appreciation conference. However, he had to give up this identity because the Phoenix Blood Red Gold he obtained in the Taichu Forbidden Area was coveted. But with the help of the big black dog Black Emperor from the Ancient Emperor Mountain, he still obtained part of the "Western Emperor Scripture".

The Ji family and the Yaoguang Holy Land organized the Quzhou Youth Monks Conference, intending to mobilize people to arrest and kill Ye Fan, but Ye Fan went to kill people and disrupt it.

Afterwards, Ye Fan followed Tu Fei into the space where the Green Dragon King of Yunze Province lived in seclusion, and sneaked into the Palace of Immortality with Hei Huang. He suppressed the old demon's consciousness that had taken over Pang Bo's body, allowing Pang Bo to regain control of his body. Later,

Ye Fan experienced the battle of Wu Shi's bedroom, during which he cheated Duan De twice to avenge his past grudges. When escaping, he mistakenly entered the God Desert due to a mistake in the Black Emperor's transmission.

After solving the mystery of the God Desert, he went to the God City to gamble on stones, during which time Pang Bo came out of seclusion.

Ye Fan & Jiang Taixu

Jiang Taixu was rescued by the Jiang family from the Ancient Emperor Mountain, but was besieged. Ye Fan saved Jiang Taixu, was blessed by the God King, mediated the feuds with various forces, and was able to break into the Four Poles, but was injured by the Great Dao. He went to the Ancient Forbidden Land to continue his life. With the help of Zhongzhou monk Ye Huiling, he successfully obtained the Holy Fruit and was reborn.

After leaving, Ye Fan pretended that his injuries had not recovered, and exposed Hua Yunfei's identity as a ruthless descendant to divert the attention of all parties. After adopting Xiao Nannan in the Douyin and Yang Sect, Ye Fan and Pang Boli and others went on an adventure in the Immortal Mountain together.

After congratulating Feng Jingyun on his birthday, Ye Fan pretended to go to Tianxuan's hometown to receive treatment from Doctor Wang. There he found the old madman. Ye Fan used the secret message of the word "Xing" to let the old madman accompany him. Relying on the old madman to intimidate all forces, the group successfully went to the Holy Cliff and obtained the secret technique.

Ye Fan went to the Yaochi Grand Meeting. Because of the Xuanhuang Mother Qi, he was suspected by the strong men to be related to the ruthless emperor. He led the strong men to the Wanlong Nest to prove his innocence, but a group of masters suffered heavy casualties. However, the leader of the Yin-Yang Sect, Wang Yangzhan, held Xiao Nannan hostage, forcing Ye Fan to return to Yaochi. At the critical moment, the demon tribe rescued Ye Fan. The Killing Saint Alliance used Liu Yiyi to lure Ye Fan into the killing game. Ye Fan used the thunder tribulation to almost kill all the enemies, rescued Liu Yiyi and retreated, and went to Zhongzhou.

Ye Fan rescued Princess Yudie of Anping State and was named the Lord of Lucheng, which was adjacent to Qishi Manor.

He learned about the world of immortals from Qi Qi, the princess of the Nanling demon clan, and went there from the ancient locust tree forest.

He went in and out several times, rescued the brothers and sisters of the Ji family, and obtained many benefits such as the "Taihuang Sutra" and the dragon scroll.

Later, he went to Qinmen to find the secret of the word "bing",

Participated in the treasure hunt in the immortal pool, and survived the Yin-Yang death curse issued by Wang Yangzhan before his death in Qishi Mansion, and became a strong man of the immortal platform and returned to the East Wilderness.

In order to provocate Ye Fan, Wang family proposed to the Ji family to make Wang Teng marry Ji Ziyue.

Ye Fan obtained a small bronze coffin from the ancient forbidden land and Nine colour fire forom the fore domain then he went to Ji Family to fight Wang Teng and defeated him.

After the fight they try to open the small coffin, but it flew back to the forbidden land and caused a change. The Nine Dragons pulled the coffin and set sail again.

Ye Fan boarded it but lost in the universe, then he came to Ziwei with Divine will of Sovereign Sun, there he met Old madman.

He told the old madman that there was an alien ship in the sky filled with ancient kings and three great saints. The old madman took action and attacked the ancient kings. Ye Fan gave him one of the nine secrets and the sealed evil ancient person. The old madman and the evil person disappeared in the sky along with the ancient kings. Before leaving he gave Ye Fan the six paths of reincarnation fist.

He killed Lu Ya, Duanmu Ming, Yin Tianzhi, Jiutou Jiaowang and other masters of the new generation of Ziwei.

He also had a cause and effect with Yi Qingwu, the fiancée of Yin Tiande, who obtained the Laozi Daotong.

Then he returned to Beidou with Yan Yixi and Li Tian, ​​the two brothers of Renyu Dao, and found that the ancient creatures had been born strongly.

Ye Fan led the barbarians race to attack and destroy the Wang family.

He killed ZI Tiandu, the young master of Shenling Valley

He Entered Guhuang Mountain again to activate the Wushi Bell. Together with the fifth generation Yuan Tianshi Zhang Lin, he destroyed Shenling Valley.

The Yaochi Ten Thousand Races Grand Meeting was held. Jiang Taixu and the saints of the human race made a plan together to shock the ancient races.read more...

Ye Fan passed Qi Luo's test, he rebuilt the Ancient Heavenly Court with him.

Rescued Dongfang Ye from Purgatory.

He fought against Yuan Gu and killed him...read more....

Then he set up a series of tricks to trap and kill all the enemies Three of his enemies are his old friends from Earth. Li Changqing, Wang Yan, and Liu Yunzhi...

He received the Inheritance from Ancient desolate sacred Body great perfection.

The Yuhua Ancestral Temple appeared. After Ye Fan bid farewell to An Miaoyi and other old friends, he repaired the Five-Color Altar in the Ancient Forbidden Land through the broken altar and teleportation array on the top floor of the temple. When he was about to leave Li Xiaoman came and fought with him, at the end of the fight Li Xiaoman threw himself into the ancient desolation abyss. then Ye fan used the ancient path and passed through the star path, the star path was not perfect and he fell on Mars. there he met the crocodile ancestor again, when he was about to be killed by the crocodile ancestor Ye Fan released the ancient saint he got in the dragon nest. the ancient saint then fought against the crocodile ancestor and defeated him. after the crocodile ancestor was defeated the ancient saint cut him into pieces and ate them with Ye Fan. After that He returned to Earth, but his parents had passed away.

He meet Xu Qiong, and she told everything that happened, about Ye Fan's parents. However, his parents were no longer there… In one day, he had no purpose in life, and his whole world collapsed.

characters.trivia:
Divine Medicine
When he ate the divine fruit for the first time, in addition to being reborn, it also opened up his sea of ​​bitterness, allowing his divine body to evolve.

When he consumed the Divine Fruit for the second time, his physical body underwent a metamorphosis, and his divine sense also became extremely terrifying. A small golden lake appeared between his eyebrows, and it became a powerful trump card.

When he consumed the Divine Fruit for the third time, a strange power entered the scar of the great dao and did not appear. It helped him overcome his inevitable death.

He likes fighting using fists

He is the only one of the three Heavenly Emperors without a primary offensive weapon. In battle, Ye Fan prefers close combat, relying on his fists and treating his own body as a weapon, often defeating opponents with his bare hands.

characters.title: Ye Fan's Classmates
characters.introText: Ye Fan's Classmates are the 29 class reunion members, excluding Ye Fan, who accidentally accompanied him on his destiny trip, crossing the stars in the Three World Bronze Coffin that orbited the Earth on June 11, 2010. The trip occurred on June 16, 2010 Mount Tai, Earth, passing through Mars and arriving at the Ancient Desolation Forbidden Lands, Emperor Burial Star. The foreigner Cade was included due to attending the class reunion.

characters.title: Abandoned Heaven Supreme
characters.introText: “Abandoned Heaven Supreme” represents a being who has:
characters.history: After he failed to enter the immortal domain, he launched an attack on living beings, taking their innate essence to prolong his life, at least he needed billions of living beings' soul essences. Abandon heaven supreme went crazy, he slaughtered living beings from one planet to another, finally he arrived at the life star belonging to the tyrant body tribe, he launched his attack but the sealed tyrant body ancestor rose again and fought him. Heaven abandon supreme felt that fighting the tyrant body great perfection would make him lose time and essence. so he offered the tyrant body ancestor to follow in his footsteps to get a second life again. as a result, the tyrant body followed his instructions standing side by side not fighting anymore but starting a dark turmoil launching attacks on other living planets.

characters.title: An Miaoyi
characters.introText: An Miaoyi is one of the main deuteragonists in Shrouding the Heavens (Novel/Donghua), she is also one of the wives of Ye Fan.
characters.appearance: An Miaoyi like a fairy of Guanghan, she wear white clothes fluttered and flew. She was the most beautiful woman in the Eastern Barren Territory, and her every frown and smile could move people's hearts.
characters.personality: An Miaoyi is a peerless and flawless, graceful and pure, like the divine moon in the sky. A woman who can truly make several heirs fall in love with her.
characters.history: An Miaoyi is the current generation of the head nun of the Miaoyu Temple. An Miaoyi is different from the previous head nuns. She is unmatched. She is one of the most beautiful women  in the Eastern Barren Territory. Regardless of their heritage, the Miaoyu Temple is no worse than a holy land. Their cultivation method is very strange and impossible to prevent. In the past, they had an ancient Daoist Dual Cultivation Method and recently the Miaoyu Temple obtained another cultivation method from a thousand years ago. It is said that this is a secret Buddhist scripture from the Western Desert. Now, they have cultivated the Dual Cultivation Method to a mysterious level.
characters.trivia:
She chose Ye Fan to be her dual cultivation partner

She has very high hopes for Ye Fan. With the hope that Ye Fan can bring her to the highest peak of eternity

People's opinion of her is that she is a holy and pure fairy. But in front of Ye Fan, she can be very naughty.

characters.title: An Pu
characters.introText: An Pu is a mysterious figure who appears among the great figures of the ancient continent. He appears calm, but possesses immense power and a profound understanding of heavenly laws. Although unknown, his appearance evokes suspense, particularly due to his hidden background and ability to access divine-grade enlightenment items.
characters.appearance:
A young man with a handsome but pale appearance , as if he had just recovered from a long illness.

Deep eyes and a mysterious aura that cannot be underestimated , even though he looks calm and weak.

His face exuded a cold elegance, and his aura of calm actually radiated fear and respect from the other heroes.
characters.personality:
Quiet, very calm, rarely shows strong emotions.

Friendly , humble, and polite, even when showing his strength.

Has a hidden decisiveness , shown when he recognized Ji Ziyue as his arch enemy.

Not chasing fame, more interested in observation , ancient knowledge , and spiritual insight .
characters.history:
Living near the Dark City , a mysterious location that holds many ancient secrets and hidden powers.

Emerging suddenly from the “middle region”, it hints at unknown origins but is full of potential.
characters.trivia:
His seemingly weak appearance made many figures underestimate him at first, but then they were all silenced by his deep aura.

His reaction to Ji Ziyue reveals the fact that the conflicts of the previous generation are still inherited , making him a complex character.

Giving sacred tea selflessly shows that he values encounter and dialogue , not just power.

Perhaps one of the seven hidden figures of the forbidden area.
characters.quotes: — An Pu to Ye Fan.

characters.title: Ancient Sovereign Bái Hǔ
characters.introText: Ancient Sovereign Bái Hǔ - The Daoist White Tiger was one of the Dark Supreme Beings who resided in the Forbidden Zones during the final era of the Shrouding the Heavens . He hailed from the ancient White Tiger race and was a figure who had reached the pinnacle of dao in his time, becoming one of the supreme rulers respected throughout the universe.
characters.appearance:
The Daoist White Tiger is typically depicted as possessing a ferocious and domineering aura. Although it often appears in human form, its body exudes the distinctive pressure of the ancient White Tiger. Its eyes gleam like sharp blades, while the murderous aura surrounding it is enough to make heaven and earth tremble.

His presence gives the impression:

fierce, majestic, and deadly like a sacred tiger that rules the battlefield.

When its power is released, a giant White Tiger shadow can appear behind it, emitting a pressure capable of suppressing ordinary cultivators to the point of being unable to move.
characters.personality:
As an ancient Supreme, Daoist White Tiger possesses:

very strong body,

extraordinary blood qi,

deadly close combat skills,

as well as emperor level dao suppression.

Its strengths are heavily focused on:

and absolute domination in battle.

His White Tiger aura is known to have a very pure and sharp killing intent, as if it can tear space apart with just the pressure of the dao.
characters.history:
As an ancient Supreme, Daoist White Tiger possesses:

very strong body,

extraordinary blood qi,

deadly close combat skills,

as well as emperor level dao suppression.

Its strengths are heavily focused on:

and absolute domination in battle.

His White Tiger aura is known to have a very pure and sharp killing intent, as if it can tear space apart with just the pressure of the dao.
characters.trivia: The Daoist White Tiger embodies strength, courage, dominance, and a refined predatory instinct. As an ancient White Tiger who once reached the pinnacle of the dao, it symbolizes the glory and power of the ancient race. However, its story also depicts the tragedy of the Supremes, beings who once stood at the pinnacle of the world but ultimately chose to abandon their noble path in order to survive. Thus, the Daoist White Tiger symbolizes the combination of the ferocity of a sacred tiger and the moral decline of a Dark Supreme Being.

characters.title: Ancient Sovereign Huángjīn
characters.introText: Ancient Sovereign Huángjīn - The Ancient Sovereign Huangjin mastered the supreme dao of gold and possessed an incredibly powerful body. He was renowned for his nearly impenetrable defense, immense blood qi, and terrifying melee combat prowess. Like other Ancient Sovereigns, he possessed a powerful dao of suppression, capable of suppressing weaker cultivators with just his aura. As an emperor, he left behind emperor dao laws that continued to influence the world after his death and served as the foundation of the Gold Clan's power for hundreds of thousands of years, ensuring the race's continued glory throughout the ages.
characters.appearance:
Ancient Sovereign Huangjin possessed an extremely majestic and domineering appearance. His body was enveloped in dazzling golden light like a golden sun, while his hair and blood radiated a powerful aura of divine metal. His eyes shone like two golden stars, and his every move exuded a dao pressure capable of shaking heaven and earth.

His presence gives the impression:

Majestic, Noble, and Unshakable like eternal gold.

As a member of the Gold Clan, his body possessed incredibly powerful racial characteristics and far surpassed that of ordinary cultivators.
characters.history: Ancient Sovereign Huangjin represents the glory, strength, steadfastness, and glory of the Gold Clan. As one of the Ancient Sovereigns who once stood at the pinnacle of the world, he symbolized the power and majesty of the ancient race during its heyday. However, his life story also reflects the tragic side of the ancient Supremes: those who once ruled the heavens and the earth but ultimately chose to preserve their lives at all costs to avoid death. Therefore, Ancient Sovereign Huangjin symbolizes not only the glory of an emperor, but also the moral downfall of a Dark Supreme Being who abandoned his noble path for the sake of longevity.

characters.title: Ancient Sovereign True Sun
characters.introText: Ancient Sovereign True Sun -  Ancient Sovereign True Sun is one of the most supreme human Ancient Sovereigns in the Shrouding the Heavens world . He hails from the Purple Fern Ancient Star (Ziwei Ancient Star) and is known as the creator and ultimate inheritor of True Sun Scripture.
characters.appearance:
Ancient Sovereign True Sun is often depicted as having:

body covered in sunlight,

hair like golden fire,

eyes shining like solar stars,

and a hot aura capable of burning the sky.

His presence is felt:

Bright, majestic, and dominating like the eternal sun.

When his emperor dao rises, the entire sky can be filled solar flames, golden light, and the immense pressure of Yang energy.
characters.personality:
The Ancient Sovereign True Sun was one of the earliest and most revered Human Ancient Emperors of the 太古时代 (Primordial Era/Ancient Times) Tàigǔ shídài. He created the Solar Immortal Scripture (太阳仙经)  one of humanity’s original mother scriptures and founded the Solar Ancient Sect (太阳古教). His cultivation embodied the purest, most blazing form of Primordial Yang, representing absolute radiance, strength, and uprightness.

Even among the ancient emperors, he was remembered as a true Human Emperor (人皇) , a sovereign who lived and died entirely for the protection of his race.

His greatest legacy is:

True Sun Scripture (太阳古经).

This scripture is one of the most powerful cultivation scriptures in the history of the Human Race and focuses on:

and the life force of the sun.

This cultivation method is able to:

purify the body,

increase vitality,

and produce highly destructive solar fires.

An important inheritor of this scripture is:

The legacy and dao he left behind are symbols of hope and progress, demonstrating that the light of the sun not only provides life but also guides humanity towards a stronger and more glorious future.

Emitting a pure, bright and blessed aura.

characters.title: Battle Saint Ape
characters.introText: Battle Saint Ape is son of the Battle Saint Ape Emperor and one of Ye Fan's close friends.
characters.appearance:
When Ye Fan gambled on stones in the heavenly city, he cut a stone called the tomb of the immortal, which turned out to contain a golden monkey sealed inside. It was not very tall, less than five feet tall, but it was extremely sturdy. It had a human-like appearance, covered in sparkling golden fur. Although it was not very majestic and imposing, it had a strong sense of power. With a raise of its hand, it seemed as if it could pick the stars and seize the moon. With a light movement, even the void would be distorted. It was like an ape, but more like a human. It was just that its golden fur was dense, making it difficult to classify as a human. When it stood there, there was a kind of aura of supremacy.

This was a kind of innate pressure, as if it was a supreme being towering above the clouds, looking down on all beings in this world. Its eyes emitted golden light in all directions, the light burning like a torch.
characters.personality: He has a noble, pure nature and is very loyal to his colleagues and family.
characters.history:
For millions of years, the great earth naturally could not avoid countless battles. All kinds of creatures were drawn into it, including the human race. They were extremely rare and weak, but they had room to develop. A supreme existence capable of contending against the Nine Transformations of the Divine Silkworm had appeared, shocking all races in the ancient era. Only then did the human race gain a place in the world. They were no longer the prey of other races. “Can you be more specific? For example, what techniques do they have? How do they cultivate them? How did they appear?” Wu Zhongtian asked. “Before the great calamity, I was still too young and my knowledge was limited. I only knew some simple things.” The Sacred Ape sighed. He came from an ancient royal race, but because he was too young, his understanding of that era was very limited. When the great calamity arrived, he was mysteriously sealed and fell asleep for millions of years. “The origins of the human race are mysterious. They should have come from the outer realm…” The Sacred Ape spoke of some past events that he knew. “Their techniques are very primitive, but their power is extraordinary…” The True Sun Secret Art could imitate the extreme Yang of heaven and earth and create an innate world. It was extremely powerful and could be said to be extremely terrifying. It was an ancient sacred art of the human race.

At that time, he was still a child. It was impossible for him to come into contact with the supreme secret. He only knew bits and pieces. The reason why he was able to grow to where he was now was because he had awakened a long time ago in the strange stone of the ‘immortal tomb’. He had cultivated for many years and had only achieved such an achievement now. Later, he was discovered by Ye Fan. When the primordial royal family cultivated to the extreme realm and took human form, they would be honored as emperors. This was the first time Ye Fan and the others had heard of it. In the past, they had always been called ancient kings.

Before the ancient emperors died, they were like gods. They could see the past and the future and left behind some prophecies. Later, everything was confirmed to be true. The Sacred Ape did not say much about this. He did not understand it and could not explain the truth of the great calamity in the Primordial Era. Ye Fan and the others felt regretful. This was an ancient mystery. Even this living ancestor could not understand it, so who else could know?

When Sacred Ape was not even three years old, his father, the sacred emperor who shook the ancient times, died. Apart from the inheritance of his race, he left nothing for him. However, he remembered the words of the ancient emperor. In the most ancient era, there should have been immortals, but they could not be seen in the future. Even Sacred Ape’s father, an invincible emperor in the ancient times, said that he had to trace back to the most ancient era… What kind of period was the so-called ‘most ancient era’? What happened in the past? What kind of past events happened there?
characters.trivia:
Even in the Ancient Era, there were only two or three Sacred Battle Apes. The Immortal Peach Tree was in the hands of their tribe. In the past, he had eaten a genuine Immortal Peach.

Sacred Ape’s father had lived for a very long time. As an Ancient Emperor, his achievements were extraordinary, and he could be said to be one of the strongest beings in history. On his deathbed, he once talked about the Immortal Domain, saying that the Immortal Domain most likely existed, but it was his regret, because he could not enter it while he was still alive.

“My little uncle said that my father was born at the wrong time, otherwise he would have had a slight chance. Unfortunately, the heavens and earth underwent a great change, and he did not have the same fate as the Heavenly Realm, so he could not imagine it.”

According to the Sacred Ape in the Ancient Era legend, there was an Immortal Heavenly Emperor.

The first master of the Immortal Divine Phoenix Medicine was said to be the Immortal Heavenly Emperor. The Immortal Heavenly Emperor, according to legend, he almost surpassed the gods. Even the ancient races were not sure if he had ever existed, so one could imagine how miraculous he was.

Battle Saint Ape Emperor was one of the most powerful existences throughout the ages. It was said that he competed with the heavens for supremacy, pressing the sun and moon with his hands, and plucking the stars with a flick of his finger. However, he also died with regret because he was not immortal.

characters.introText: Blood Moon King is a Saint King from Blood Moon Clan.
characters.appearance: His body was withered, and his hair was as sparse as yellow weeds.
characters.personality:
People say that Blood Moon Clan is bloodthirsty and cruel by nature, but they don't know that they use this to cultivate and absorb the essence contained in the blood of thousands of spirits to strengthen themselves.

The Blood Moon Clan is bloodthirsty. They can obtain heavenly energy from the blood of others, especially those with special bodies or Saints. To them, blood is like a precious medicine!

characters.title: Boundless Heavenly Venerable
characters.introText: “The Boundless Heavenly Venerable” — The one who embodies the infinite nature of the universe and its immortality.
characters.personality:
While not explicitly named, Wú Liàng Tiānzūn is tied to texts that describe:
Techniques for merging with the void.

The nature of immortality and the infinitude of the Dao.

Rituals and methods for invoking infinite cosmic force.

His legacy appears in fragments and oral traditions within the Nine Secrets and later Daoist texts.
characters.trivia:
Common Daoist Exclamation: In later ages, “无量天尊” became a habitual expression akin to “Oh my heavens!” or even “Oh fuck!” — used by cultivators when shocked or surprised.

Feared Figure: Created an aura of reverence and terror for generations.

Known for overpowering foes and shaping the era in which he emerged.

✅ Etymology: The Boundless Heavenly Venerable — a symbol of the infinite.

✅ Technique: Created the devastating Lone Destruction Heavenly Technique.

✅ Cultivation: Created the 5th of the Nine Secrets, 斗 (Dòu), representing the human struggle.

✅ Scripture: Left behind fragmented knowledge about immortality and the void.

✅ Trivia: Common exclamation evolved from his honorific due to sheer renown.

characters.title: Cade
characters.introText: The name "Cade" in English is gender neutral, meaning "round" or "barrel". The name is believed to come from the Old High German name "cada" meaning "wavy" or "round", or possibly from the Welsh name "Cadell" meaning "battle", according to The Bump .
characters.appearance: He had golden hair and blue eyes.
characters.history: When they arrived at Beidou, not long after that an old monk saw him. After that Cade was sent to the Western Desert by an old monk. The Buddhist monks believed that Cade was born with extraordinary talents. He had golden hair and blue eyes, and he looked a bit like the Fighting Sacred Monkey. Therefore, they allowed him to listen to the Buddha's teachings in an important place, and he was raised as a guardian vajra.

characters.title: Caiyun
characters.introText: In her old age she was like an old woman with a face full of wrinkles appearing in the field. Her body was bent, and her hair was sparse. She walked with the help of a stick. After being restored to her youth by Jiang Taixu, her appearance was jet black hair, her skin was shiny, and her beauty was unmatched.
characters.appearance:
In her old age she was like an old woman with a face full of wrinkles appearing in the field. Her body was bent, and her hair was sparse. She walked with the help of a stick. After being restored to her youth by Jiang Taixu, her appearance was jet black hair, her skin was shiny, and her beauty was unmatched.

She is saintess of the Holy Land of All Beginnings from 4.000 year ago (Saint here is not the saint that is meant in the realm of cultivation. But more towards the holy virgin or holy son of a sect)
characters.personality: Graceful, beautiful and loyal.
characters.history: She was Jiang Taixu's lover in the past, the first generation saint of the Holy Land of All Beginnings. Saints cannot marry outsiders, so Fairy Rosy Cloud cannot be with Jiang Taixu. Heavenly King Jiang entered the Holy Land of All Beginnings and wanted to take her away, but Fairy Rosy Cloud remembered her master's kindness and did not leave. But she never married the saint, and faced the Green Lantern Ancient Cave alone, never stepping into the mortal world again. No one thought she was still alive.
characters.trivia:
In The past Jiang Taixu gave her Earth Fruit to increase her lifespan

She came specifically to save Jiang Taixu. She fought with a terrifying person above the underground palace

She sacrificed herself to save Jiang Taixu by injected her Divine Essence into Jiang Taixu’s body

For four thousand years she faced the Green Lantern Ancient Cave alone

After Fairy Caiyun died, Jiang Taixu used a heaven-defying divine technique to restore her youth

characters.title: Cao Lin
characters.introText: The name "Cao Lin" in Mandarin (Chinese) has various meanings depending on the characters used to write it. In general, "Cao" (曹) can mean "hold" or "department", while "Lin" (林) means "forest". In the context of the name, "Lin" can also be interpreted as "beautiful jade".
characters.appearance: Cao Lin is charming and beautiful.
characters.personality: The Cao Family played an important role on the Eternal Lord Star Domain. A stomp of their foot could make anyone tremble. They were a powerful force.
characters.history: The Cao Family played an important role on the Eternal Lord Star Domain. A stomp of their foot could make anyone tremble. They were a powerful force.

characters.title: Cao Qing
characters.introText: Cao Qing is a young master with great power in the Eternal Kingdom.
characters.appearance: Cao Qing looked very young, and his aura was extraordinary. His cultivation was very deep, and he had long silver hair. He was handsome and unfeeling, and to ordinary women, he was very attractive.
characters.personality: He is like a rich young man who always spends his parents' money.
characters.history:
Cao Qing, a young master with great power in the Eternal Kingdom. In order to pursue Miss Fan Xian, he willingly came to the Fairy Feather Star Ocean to become a first-ranked guest elder. He could spend a lot of effort and money, he also gave the Brahman Race additional materials to refine the precious liquid.

That night when Ye Fan was comprehending the Dao, he used the sacred artifact warship to ambush Ye Fan, but he was stopped by Fan Zhou. He was a powerful relative of the Brahman Race. He was young and possessed extraordinary strength. He had cut off his Dao for many years. Because of his pursuit of Fan Xian, he was extremely hostile towards people like Ye Fan. After Ye Fan advanced to level 8 of the small step of dao severing he killed everyone who had ever tried to kill him, and one of them was Cao Qing.

After killing Luo Luo, he attacked Cao Qing and killed Cao Qing and his servant. After that, Xuan Linfeng came. In addition, Luo Luo's grandfather who was in seclusion also appeared. His expression was extremely gloomy. After learning that his granddaughter and the old woman had died, his eyes were spitting fire. A group of powerful experts appeared, including experts from the Brahman Race, surrounding Ye Fan. Fan Xian also arrived. The situation became more complicated and chaos ensued.readmore..

characters.appearance: The Heavenly Jade Holy Maiden was like an immortal descending into the world of mortals. Her white clothes fluttered about, and with every movement she made, natural laws were like a sea. characters.title: Chaotic Ancient Emperor AKA Luan Gu Great Emperor
characters.introText: Luangu Great Emperor (乱古大帝) is one of the most tragic and unconventional Great Emperors in the novel Shrouding the Heavens. Unlike all other emperors who rose undefeated, his path to supremacy was defined by relentless Defeat, loss, and despair. Known as the “Emperor of Hundred Defeats,” he is the only Great Emperor in history who achieved enlightenment through continuous failure rather than invincibility.
characters.appearance: Luangu Great Emperor (乱古大帝) is portrayed as a tall, imposing man with long black hair and sharp, deep-set eyes that reflect both exhaustion and unyielding determination. His features are stern and mature, often carrying a heavy, calm expression shaped by the countless hardships he endured throughout his life. Unlike other Great Emperors who radiate effortless dominance, his presence feels restrained yet intensely oppressive, as if forged through suffering and endless battle. His physique is that of a peak human cultivator, perfectly tempered by life-and-death struggles, and even at rest he exudes a dangerous aura
characters.personality: Luangu Great Emperor (乱古大帝) possesses a deeply resilient and tragic personality shaped by relentless hardship and repeated failure. Unlike typical Great Emperors who are naturally confident and dominant, he was once plagued by self-doubt and despair after suffering countless defeats and losing everyone close to him, including his loved ones, master, and friends. These experiences nearly shattered his Dao heart, leaving him on the brink of collapse multiple times. However, what defines him most is his unyielding will—despite overwhelming setbacks, he refused to give up and continued to struggle forward. After his rebirth, his mindset became colder, more resolute, and unwavering, embodying a quiet determination and an almost ruthless focus on surpassing himself. At his core, Luangu represents perseverance through failure, a man who turned despair into strength and forged an indomitable spirit through suffering.
characters.history:
Luan Gu the Great Emperor led an extraordinarily difficult life, suffering countless crushing defeats that repeatedly shattered his will and brought him to the brink of losing his Dao Heart entirely.

Through great fortune, he obtained partial cultivation techniques from the Ruthless Great Emperor, then partial secret arts from the Void Great Emperor. After enduring a hundred defeats, he gave birth to a Demon Fetus, which allowed him to achieve a level of mastery rivaling creation itself.

His path to Emperorhood was uniquely brutal — marked not just by battle losses, but by devastating personal tragedies: the death of loved ones, the loss of his partner, the murder of his master, and the annihilation of all his friends. It was precisely this accumulation of suffering that gave him the relentless will to keep fighting rather than submit.

Among all Great Emperors, he alone walked a path of repeated defeat. His greatest enemies in his youth were the Luan Tian Seven Heroes, who drove him to the edge of despair and mental collapse, forcing him to flee to the wilderness.

Ultimately, Luan Gu broke free from his chrysalis, completed his Demon Fetus transformation, defeated all former enemies, and stood alone at the absolute peak.

Note: Because his secret art Zhan Wo Ming Dao Jue and other techniques closely resemble the Ruthless Emperor's arts in aura, some suspected he was a reincarnation of the Ruthless Emperor. He is the only Great Emperor to have ever come from the Northern Region.

His Luan Gu Emperor Talisman was obtained by Ye Fan from Wang Teng's hands and later gifted to Pang Bo and Ye Tong.
characters.trivia:
Luan Gu is the only Great Emperor in history to have achieved Emperorhood through a path defined by repeated defeat rather than an unbroken record of victory.

His techniques Zhan Wo Ming Dao Jue and others share a strikingly similar aura to those of the Ruthless Great Emperor, leading to widespread speculation that Luan Gu may have been a reincarnation of the Ruthless Emperor in one of his later lives. This has never been confirmed.

The Northern Region, from which Luan Gu originates, is described as vast and sparsely populated. Throughout all of history, he is the only Great Emperor to have come from that land.

The divine spirit of the Luan Gu Axe demonstrated autonomous will during the Dark Turmoil, awakening and fighting independently without the Emperor's direct command.

characters.appearance: Chapter 1818 of novel, "The Intante Holy Body & Taoist Embryo", describe chenxi as a girl of eighteen or nineteen years old, as her name suggests, she is like a clear stream in a morning light, giving people a fresh, lively and beautiful feeling. She is beautiful and intelligent.She is not a monk, but is born with a lively and Otherworldly Temperature which make her stand out from crowd,she possess the wisdom of Earth & Heavens.
characters.personality: Chen Xi is ethereal and intelligent personality. Chenxi and Ye Fan Supported each Other in Mortal World until they grow old and they never have arguments in this entire life, which know how gentle and intelligent Chen xi is.
characters.history: Chen Xi was born with the Taoist Fetus, but she had never practiced Cultivation. She lived in Yuanchan, a place with beautiful mountains and clear waters. Yuanchan was not very famous in Qingyun Province, the people's living there were all are ordinary people's & there were no Cultivation.
characters.quotes:
However, Chen Xi's reaction exceeded its expectations. This was once an ethereal and intelligent young girl. Even though she was old, she was still flickering with wisdom.

"To be able to work hand in hand with the Celestial Emperor for my entire life, I am already very satisfied. I was originally very happy, so isn't it good to end things like this? Actually, you don't need to come find me and tell me these things."

The Black Emperor was stunned. The woman in front of him actually responded like this, causing him to be stunned. He felt more and more guilty, insisting on inviting her into the Celestial Court to extend her life.

Chen Xi smiled. She combed her white hair and said, "What I like is the person who will accompany me until I grow old, and not the true Celestial Emperor who rules over the world. If I return to the Celestial Court, he has his vast sky, and as for me, I still only like the people and things here. The most important thing in life is not having something forever. We were once moved, and we accompanied each other until we grew old. I am very satisfied, and all of this is enough. "

characters.title: Chi Long
characters.introText: Chi Long is one of the respected old experts in the world of Shrouding the Heavens.
characters.appearance: Chi Long has Taoist qualities. Philosophy grew out of obedience to nature, and religion grew out of belief in a cosmic balance maintained and regulated by the Tao.
characters.personality: Chi Long has Taoist qualities. Philosophy grew out of obedience to nature, and religion grew out of belief in a cosmic balance maintained and regulated by the Tao.
characters.history:
Chi Long Daoist (赤龙道人, Chì Lóng Dàorén), literally "Daoist Red Dragon," is one of the powerful old cultivators of the Eastern Wasteland during the early part of Shrouding the Heavens. He belongs to the older generation and is renowned for his profound cultivation, upright character, and dragon-related lineage.

Chi Long Daoist is a powerful cultivator with connections to the Dragon Race and ancient Daoist traditions. He has lived for many centuries and accumulated tremendous experience, becoming one of the respected seniors among human cultivators.

Unlike many old monsters who pursue selfish ambitions, Chi Long is known for his integrity and sense of justice.

When Ye Fan was still weak and surrounded by enemies, Chi Long Daoist became one of the senior experts who held no hostility toward him.

He recognized Ye Fan's extraordinary destiny and occasionally offered support and protection during critical moments.

Because of this, Ye Fan always regarded Chi Long Daoist with respect.

Chi Long Daoist became involved in the struggle surrounding the Green Lotus Emperor Weapon (Qinglian) and the ancient ruins related to the Demon Emperor's Heart.

During this turbulent period:

Numerous Holy Lands and ancient families fought over imperial treasures.

Ancient powers and terrifying experts emerged.

Chi Long Daoist stood among the powerful figures who attempted to maintain balance rather than seize everything for themselves.
characters.trivia:
He was trapped in the Holy Cliff for fifteen hundred years

When Ye Fan was about to break through the four pole realm, he came with The Peacock King, and The Green flood Dragon King brought 800,000 kg of resources to help Ye Fan break through

He was the smallest giant in his clan, and he could be called a genius of his generation. He obtained the ancient orthodoxy of the human race, and his Daoist name was Chi Yang. He was the youngest brother of the invincible king of the Golden Crow Clan.

Known for his long history and deep cultivation, he is regarded as one of the “old monsters” of the Southern Region.He is typically described as wearing a black feathered robe that resembles crow feathers, giving him an eerie and intimidating appearance. Despite his aged look, his strength remains extremely formidable, and he is capable of surviving some of the most dangerous forbidden zones in the cultivation world.

He often wears a purple-gold crown, adding a sense of ancient authority and highlighting his status as an old monster of the cultivation world. Despite his aged appearance, his body still carries immense vitality and pressure, reflecting his deep and long-standing cultivation.

characters.trivia:
Qing Thearch had entered the Qinling Mountains to search for the red-haired humanoid, but he could not find any trace of it.

Ten thousand years ago, before Qing Thearch died, he did many shocking things. He went deep into the God Ruins to seize the Pagoda of Destruction and went to the Middle Pass to search for green copper.

Finally, before he died, he wiped out the Cai Clan with a single finger. He even used the Demon Searching Boundless Mystic Power to slash the Qinling Mountains. Qing Thearch did not know where the red-haired humanoid was, but he sent the Demon Thearch Killing Intent there. Even if he died, this Killing Intent would not disappear unless it hit the enemy.

characters.title: Divine Silkworm Princess
characters.introText: Divine Silkworm Princess - The Divine Silkworm Princess is incredibly beautiful and elegant, imbued with an aura of ancient nobility. She is often depicted with beautiful silky hair, a sacred aura, and calm yet piercing eyes. Her presence exudes a natural grace and authority, making her seem like a princess from an ancient era. As a member of the Ancient Royal Race, she carried a natural pressure that made it difficult for ordinary cultivators to look directly at her. Her appearance exuded purity, nobility, and a profound, hidden power. However, beneath her beauty and graceful aura lay a terrifying battle prowess..
characters.appearance:
The Divine Silkworm Princess' first appearance occurred in the source stone gambling arc when Ye Fan fought against the experts of the source family and various major powers in a Source Art competition.

At that moment, a mysterious ancient source stone was opened. Sealed within the stone was an extraordinarily beautiful woman with a powerful ancient aura. This woman was the Divine Silkworm Princess. Her appearance immediately shocked the entire stone gambling hall, as no one expected a living being from the Ancient Race to be hidden within the source stone.

The Divine Silkworm Princess's body had been sealed within the divine source for countless years. Her appearance was serene and holy, but an ancient spear was embedded in her chest, sealing her. This spear contained a terrifying aura and was the reason she remained dormant within the source stone for so long.
Even though she was sealed and wounded by a spear in her chest, the Divine Silkworm Princess' aura still radiated:

and the terrifying pressure from the Ancient Royal Race.
characters.personality:
As a member of the Ancient Royal Race, the Divine Silkworm Princess demonstrated:

and Loyalty to his race.

But she also had a more open outlook than many of the other Ancient Kings, so she didn't completely sink into the enmity between humans and the ancient races.
characters.history:
Divine Silkworm Princess comes from:

Divine Silkworm Race (神蚕族)

one of the most powerful Ancient Royal Races in the Taigu era.

This breed is famous for:

extraordinary bloodline,

metamorphosis ability,

and biological evolution approaching perfection.

Each transformation of the Divine Silkworm is considered as:

The more transformations they successfully go through, the higher their life form becomes.

As a royal princess, Divine Silkworm Princess has:

Very high status,

Extraordinary talent,

and the legacy of ancient royal blood.

She was born in an era when the Ancient Races dominated the world before the rise of humans.

characters.title: Dongfang Man
characters.introText: Dongfang Man looked like he was in his twenties. The muscles on his naked upper body bulged like a horned dragon. His skin was bronzed, and he looked strong and powerful. His thick black hair hung down to his waist, giving him a kind of wild masculine beauty.
characters.appearance: Dongfang Man looked like he was in his twenties. The muscles on his naked upper body bulged like a horned dragon. His skin was bronzed, and he looked strong and powerful. His thick black hair hung down to his waist, giving him a kind of wild masculine beauty.
characters.personality: Same as Dongfang Ye, honest, pure and innocent person but he is very strong. His strength is like a monster.
characters.history:
In the ancient village, Dongfang Ye and dongfang man were a pair of brothers. They possessed the extremely rare Primordial Battle Blood and had the power to pull mountains. Their flesh far exceeded that of ordinary humans. Apart from the Saint Lords, no one could match them.

The two brothers cultivated the same cultivation technique and grew up in the same environment. Usually they wandered deep in the mountains and forests. Once they walked, they would walk for ten days to half a month, devouring wild dragons and fierce tigers. Finally, they succeeded in cultivating the Barbarian Martial Technique.

In ancient times, the entire Southern Mountains were the world of the barbarian race. However, the ancestral order was that they must live in seclusion in the mountains.

characters.title: Dongfang Taiyi
characters.introText: Dongfang Taiyi has a strange, ancient, and intimidating appearance . He is unlike any other cultivator—he is like an entity from a time before history .
characters.appearance:
Dongfang Taiyi has a strange, ancient, and intimidating appearance . He is unlike any other cultivator—he is like an entity from a time before history .

Tall, big and slender , like a dry wooden pole.

Old bronze skin , rough and cracked like ancient desert soil.

Dry muscled but contains great destructive power.

Sometimes it looks like a living corpse , but it emits a deep and frightening aura .

Only wearing animal skins , typical of ancient barbarians.

The skin was not an ordinary animal, but an ancient sacred beast , signifying status and long history.

In normal times, she appears half-naked , emphasizing the brutal simplicity of her origins.

Long, tangled gray hair , hanging down like wild grass.

The face is sunken and hard , high cheekbones, sharp jaw.

Eyes like a dark abyss , empty when closed, blazing like the sun or moon when open depending on the time of day.

Sometimes the eyes during the day shine golden , at night they become blood red or cold blue .

Wrapped in dark red iron chains , covered in ancient sealing patterns.

Wielding a white bone mace , a primitive weapon yet exuding divine power — it could shatter mountains.

The aura of his body could cause the air to vibrate, causing a mixture of fear and majesty.
characters.personality:
Dongfang Taiyi has a complex and paradoxical personality, shaped by extreme experiences, dangerous cultivation conditions, and a long period of time.

Midday :
Wise, noble, gentle, and compassionate.

Speaking like a wise sage, full of understanding of Tao and the universe.

Demonstrates the qualities of a holy teacher, a profound spiritual leader.

Sometimes he looks like a wise hermit from ancient times.

Evening :
Crazy, brutal, sadistic, and wild.

Losing control, attacking anything that moves.

Killing becomes an irresistible instinct.

Becoming a true demon, bloodthirsty, even towards fellow humans.

The inner conflict between these two sides is a major theme in her character. She is a victim of a powerful force she cannot fully control.
characters.history:
He comes from a tribe of ancient humans , who lived before the ancient royal race came to power .

Known as one of the Saints of humanity, equal to or even surpassing the ancient kings in spiritual and mystical power.
characters.trivia:
The "devil man" said that he once had a son named Dongfang Bei Ye. However, millions of years have passed and he is no longer found.

Dongfang Taiyi is a symbol of absolute dualism in human form —god and demon coexisting, forming a paradoxical existence. His name and cultivation path reflect the cosmic struggle between harmony and chaos .

This Primordial Saint actually possessed two supreme divine arts. In the Primordial Era, humanity only had two ancient scriptures. He had actually studied both and absorbed them into himself. However, this also resulted in a great disaster

Princess Yu Die, Dongfang Ye and Ye Fan join together to trap Duan De and plunder him. The three of them robbed him until Duan De was left with only his underwear. The immoral Daoist got his comeuppance.

Dongfang Ye is invited by Duan De to go Into the Immortal Burial Ground. There they meet Ye Fan and the Mysterious Blind Old Man.

On their adventure into the Ancient House, Ye Fan gave Dongfang Ye the arm bone left by a saint after transforming into a dao. This bone would later be refined and combined with his wolf tooth staff.

When Dongfang Ye licked his lips. This was a sign that the barbarians were about to attack.

Nickname:  “Hundred Years of Light”

Eternal Record:
Reaching the Peak of the Great Sage Realm in less than a hundred years — the fastest record in the history of both human and divine race cultivation.

Breaking through the deepest stage of the Holy King Realm , touching the initial boundary of Quasi-Emperor , but never being able to truly break through.

characters.title: Emperor Zūn
characters.introText: The coldness of Dao, the will of destruction, the mimicry of God
characters.personality: The coldness of Dao, the will of destruction, the mimicry of God
characters.history:
Origin : Earth, in the final era when the laws collapsed and the heavens rejected cultivators.

Unlike the ancient beings who inherited, Zūn created his own path through slaughter .

Seeing that heaven had no place for humans, he decided to forge a new “Heaven” , namely his own Ancient Heavenly Court .

Three times he burned his Dao to start over — at the third time, he shed all his human side and became an existence of law .

He created a cultivation technology based on forced refining: refinement by collapse , using planets, gods, and creatures as materials.
characters.trivia:
His full name is unknown. “Zūn” is a title he took on himself.

He never had true disciples — only followers, tools, and victims.

Despite being from Earth, he destroyed several sacred sites on Earth to wipe out all potential rivals .

The only emotions left in him were “cold ambition and the will to dominate the Dao.”

It is said that his footsteps formed a new path of law , and the areas he once walked became godless territories .

characters.title: Emperor Zūn / Dì Zūn
characters.introText: Literal meaning : His Imperial Majesty or Most Respected Emperor .
characters.personality:
The most terrifying person in the world was the last Celestial Being of the Legendary Era. Later, it was rumored that he abandoned all divine techniques, natural laws, and even cultivation, thus disappearing. As a baby, he was nurtured by heaven and earth. As soon as he was born, he devoured the essence of all living beings in the universe, becoming supreme and unrivaled. As for what happened afterward, the whole world knows. He was unrivaled in heaven and earth, walking the most glorious path. No one could stop him even half a step, and the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths all bowed to him. From then on, he became known as Emperor Zun, ending the reign of the supreme Celestial Being of the Legendary Era. He became the most revered person in history!

However, due to various reasons, the two eventually missed each other. Later, Zhang Lin got married and had children. Many years later, he became the guardian of the Jade Lake, protecting it in secret.

In the second half of their lives, they could only be close friends. Even if they met occasionally, they could only stand respectfully. It was difficult for them to get close again. It was only after the sad news came that Zhang Lin experienced a terrible event in the last years of his life that he turned into a demon and died. Yang Yi finally broke free from all his shackles and rushed to the Purple Mountain, dying for love. Ten thousand years had passed and the blue sea had turned into a mulberry field. However, to them, it was still a moment of separation. Their hearts had never changed.

characters.personality:
In the darkness of the universe, huge battleships were flashing with silver radiance. The cold metallic luster was bone-chilling as they sailed towards a sea of stars in an orderly manner. Although this fleet looked majestic up close, it was nothing compared to the vastness of the universe. Many star regions were the same since time immemorial, and loneliness was the eternal theme.

Lady Fan Xian was chased by Mo Feng, but she managed to survive because of Ye Fan. Lady Fan Xian has arrived at her flagship and met with her second uncle Fan Zhou, Fan Zhou heard the news from his niece then he led his fleet of battleships to fight the Origin Demon fleet of battleships. The usually cold universe was now completely boiling. Endless rays of light shot out, and many small planets around were affected. They exploded one after another, forming a violent storm. This kind of battleship was extremely powerful. Unlike other saint tools, it was specially prepared for long-range battles. It was the product of the perfect combination of the great dao and technology.

This was a massacre because the strength of both sides was not equal. This was a bitter battle. The people of the Origin Demon Sea suffered heavy losses. The difference in strength was too great. Lives were lost in the flames, and their souls turned to smoke. Mo Zhan from the Origin Demon side came out of his battleship using the "Golden Giant Body" (I think it's some kind of robot) to challenge Fan Zhou. Then Fan Zhou also came out of his Battleship and used the "Purple Giant Body". The battle between the two great experts was like a battle between ancient saints. Their bodies were contained in divine tools, and their fighting prowess was enhanced to an extremely terrifying level.

At the end of the war, Mo Zhan lost, he entered the trap set by Fan Zhou. In the end, he had to hand over the Absolute Beginning Life Stone for the safety of all his clan members. The people in the Origin Demon Star Ocean were all grief-stricken. There are many dangers during this journey. They encountered powerful lifeforms in the ancient lair, and even the sacred vessel was almost torn apart. They barely escaped with their lives, but the Life Stone of Absolute Beginning was snatched halfway. They are sad and full of reluctance.

characters.history: Gai Jiuyou is a person who shocks the past and the present. Unfortunately, he cannot withstand the passage of time.”
characters.trivia:
Gai Jiuyou is one of the rare figures in history who was widely regarded as possessing the potential to become a Great Emperor, with the novel describing him as a peerless figure worthy of being recorded throughout the history of cultivation. However, he was born too close to the era of the Qing Emperor. Because the Qing Emperor had already attained the Great Emperor position, the Great Emperor's Dao and the laws of his era prevented Gai Jiuyou from successfully proving the Dao in his own generation. Had he been born in a different era, he would have possessed a genuine opportunity to become a Great Emperor.

This makes Gai Jiuyou an exceptional example of how the timing of one's birth can determine whether even an unparalleled genius can attain the Great Emperor realm. A Great Emperor normally dominates an era for thousands of years, with the world's cultivation environment changing according to the rise and decline of successive Great Emperors. Gai Jiuyou's inability to prove the Dao was therefore not due to a lack of talent or combat ability, but largely because he was born at an unfavorable point in the Great Emperor cycle.

Despite failing to become a Great Emperor, Gai Jiuyou's combat prowess remained extraordinary even in his later years. Having already been unrivaled in the world roughly eight thousand years earlier, he was still capable of effortlessly killing multiple Ancient Saints after his blood and vitality had greatly declined. His performance demonstrated that his strength had remained at a level comparable to the greatest figures in history despite never attaining the Great Emperor realm.

The novel explicitly states that Gai Jiuyou was a figure who could have become a Great Emperor if not for his proximity to the Qing Emperor's era, effectively making him one of the most prominent "near-Great Emperor" figures in the history of cultivation.

characters.history:
Ge Xuan was one of the most important figures in Taoism. He was considered the founder of the Gezao Sect by later generations of Lingbao Sect Taoists. He was called Ge Xianweng. The Lingbao Sect revered Shangqing, who was also the Lingbao Celestial Being. It was one of the most important sects in Taoism, and Ge Xuan was the founder of the sect for a time, so one can imagine his status.

Furthermore, he was also revered as one of the Four Heavenly Masters of Taoism. His high status was evident from his name, Ge Xianweng. Not only was Ge Xuan an extraordinary man, but he also had a grand-nephew named Ge Hong, who was the author of the Baopuzi. He was even more impressive and was a Taoist leader during the Eastern Jin Dynasty.

The golden princess had never been defeated her entire life. She looked down on the archaic times and looked down on all under the heavens. She was known as the imperial family's fairy!

She had already revived more than ten years ago, but she had never appeared in the world. Her father turned the path he took into the Ten Extreme Imperial Formation and left it for her. Only recently did she walk out. This alone was enough to prove that her cultivation wasn't below that of golden emperors of the same age!

The golden ancient emperor had placed great hopes on her, viewing her as an extension of his life. He wanted her to enter the immortal domain in his place. Apart from the Ten Extreme Imperial Formation, he also refined a dao corroboration diagram. It condensed the most dangerous tribulations the legendary ancient emperors experienced into it and left it for his own daughter to face.

All these years, the golden princess had always been fighting. She had broken through the trials of life and death when the ancient emperors were young. She alone had witnessed the supreme immortal path of several ancient emperors!

It was hard to find someone who could stand shoulder to shoulder with her. But when fighting Ye Fan, her clothes were destroyed and her upper body was exposed. And that made her very insulted.

Golden Princess vowed to kill the Sacred Body of Humanity. She had never experienced such a great loss. Skin to skin with a strange man almost “naked”.
