Early in the morning, the morning sun shone brightly, shining through the mist, making one’s heart sparkle. Ye Fan sat cross-legged on a short mountain, continuously breathing in and out. The White Innate Spiritual Essence flowed in and out of his mouth and nose like a dragon, rumbling like thunder. Not far away, several children were also seriously cultivating while swinging their arms and kicking their legs. They were extremely serious.

Tong Tong was only five years old, but he was Ye Fan’s first disciple. After escaping from the hands of “Devil” Li Tian, ​​he had become extremely serious. He faced the morning sun and methodically practiced his fists. His entire body was glowing, as if he could resonate with the sun.

Gu Fei and Gu Lin, this pair of siblings, were only eleven years old. They were also extremely talented and also extremely serious. They had already adapted to life in the Heavenly Village.

As for the last one, Tiny Dot, she was still a child. Little Que ‘er was only a little over a year old. She held a pacifier in her mouth, limping as she walked. Her little hands moved randomly as she shouted, “Heh, heh, heh.” Her childish voice was really cute.

They were the future hope for the Ancient Heavenly Court. Even if the others had all fallen and only these four little things were left, perhaps they could still support a thriving godly dynasty and rule the world.

characters.title: Gu Ling
characters.introText: Gu Ling <Leader of the Thirteen Steeds of Heaven Wasteland>.
characters.appearance:
His black hair hung wildly behind him, fluttering in the midst of the raging energy storm. His upper body was bronze in color, gleaming like ancient metal forged in the spiritual flames for thousands of years. Every muscle of his was a picture of pure power—wild, savage, and unbridled, as strong as a horned dragon rampaging through the ancient sky.

His gaze was terrifying. From his two eyes radiated a sharp golden light like a heavenly spear—full of pressure, like an ancient beast awakened from a long slumber, staring at its prey that was about to be torn apart in one deadly strike.
characters.personality:
Gu Ling — the leader of the Thirteen Steeds of Heaven Wasteland — was a reflection of the world he came from: harsh, savage, and merciless. He was not only a warrior, but also a symbol of a will that refused to submit to fate.

Gu Ling rarely spoke. When he did, his words were short and sharp, like a sword that went straight to the heart of the matter. He showed no open emotion. His face was calm even in the midst of bloodshed, and he never overreacted, even when cornered.

Without the need to shout or show off his strength, Gu Ling’s presence made experts bow and allies follow him without hesitation. His aura of leadership was born from real actions: from the blood he shed, and the victories he personally wrested from the field of death.
characters.history: Thirteen Steeds of Heaven Wasteland. This group consists of 13 peak geniuses who all come from Heaven Wasteland. Gu Ling is the leader of the Thirteen Steeds of Heaven Wasteland.

characters.title: Guan Cheng
characters.introText: Guan Cheng <The captain of the guard of "the number one city of mankind">.
characters.appearance: He was a very handsome young expert. His black hair was spread behind him, and his skin was as white as jade. He could be considered a heroic and powerful person.
characters.history:
Guan Cheng The captain of the guard of the “first city of humanity” fought with Ye fan's dao body. Guan Cheng was so powerful that he far surpassed many of the examinees. However, his armor was shattered, and he almost became a living victim.

“This is the second defeat that I, Guan Cheng, have suffered.”~ The voice was heavy and oppressive. The sky trembled slightly, and the ground beneath Guan Cheng’s feet let out fine cracks as his majestic warrior aura surged.

“More than ten years ago, I was pierced by a spear along with my mount. We were almost nailed to death in a boundless ancient land, a place where heaven and earth knew no law.”~ he continued in a voice as cold as steel,

“Even though I was angry—angry to the point where my body was shaking—I had no choice but to retreat. That time, I lost. And I wrote it down, burning it into my soul.”“Now… even if I get hurt again, I am not afraid. Not like back then.”“I will not retreat. I will not fall again. I… will take your head!”~ He stared straight at Ye Fan, eyes as sharp as swords, full of determination and humiliation that wanted to be cleansed with blood.

Their battle continued, with Gu Ling and the number 2 of the Thirteen Steeds of Heaven Wasteland joining forces to attack Ye Fan's dao body. No one won, and no one lost. At the last moment, an ancient trumpet sounded, boundless and distant, summoning all the test takers. An altar appeared in the sky, flowing with misty light.

characters.title: Heavenly Emperor Huang
characters.introText: Shi Hao (石昊, Shí Hào), officially entitled as the Desolate Heavenly Emperor (荒天帝, Huāngtiāndì, Heavenly Emperor Huāng) in Shrouding the Heavens World, is a legendary figure from ancient times and the contributor to this world's creation. He is revered as an invincible cultivator who created the foundation of the Five Secret Realms cultivation system used in later eras to prove Immortals. Though he does not appear directly in the Shrouding the Heavens story, this Heavenly Emperor is referenced many times.
characters.history:
Owner of the Desolate Tower

Heavenly Emperor of the Chaotic Ancient Era

Half Real/Half illusion
characters.trivia:
Shi Hao's contact with the Three World Bronze Coffin left by the Sick Old Man physically changed his appearance to be the same as Heavenly Emperors Ye and Chu as well as the Ruthless Emperor's brother. This is causality related to Transcendence.

His true name "Shi Hao, Huang" is a taboo. In both Shrouding the Heavens and The Sacred Ruins, his true name cannot be spoken because it carries immense karmic weight. Merely mentioning his real name brings severe backlash to those who are not strong enough to withstand the karma associated with him. As a result, he is referred to simply as “That Person.” Even Ye Fan, Wu Shi and Ruthless Emperor who travelled into the past in Perfect World could not directly call his true name until they themselves have reached sufficient strength. Before attaining comparable power, even they would suffer karmic consequences due to the overwhelming destiny and cause-and-effect tied to his existence.

In The Sacred Ruins, Chapter 1560, when Jiu Dao‑Yi — one of Shi Hao’s 800 disciples — attempted to utter the his name, he barely spoke the first sound before the world itself reacted. A sudden heavenly phenomenon erupted: chaotic lightning fell from a clear sky, and the River of Time briefly appeared before everyone's eyes flowing across them, terrifying bolts of lighting piercing through the river of time.The backlash struck the one who heard or reacted to the name, nearly obliterating their body and soul. Jiu Dao‑Yi survived only because he carried a protective aura on his spear left by his master. Even a Quasi-Immortal Emperor could not withstand the full force of the backlash. This is why characters always refer to him indirectly as “That Person,” to avoid the punishment and overwhelming karmic backlash tied to his true name.

The Heavenly Knight was an extraordinary talent at a young age. He was a genius who could look down on his peers and was nurtured as a child of a god. His talent was said to be the best in the Western Earth for tens of thousands of years! However, he was too naughty and often played around in the temple. One time, he accidentally dropped the newly unsealed Holy Grail.  At that time, he created a great disaster, but he bathed in the blood of the gods and swallowed all the precious medicines. He reached an extraordinary height and obtained an indestructible body. Vatican City was greatly shaken. All the big figures were shocked and angry, but they could do nothing. The blood of the gods had disappeared, helping this naughty genius.

From then on, he was labeled a sinner and could only cultivate bitterly every day. He was forever shrouded in darkness and could not obtain glory. He could only silently protect Vatican City. There was a sage from ancient times who left a mark on his body and cursed him as a sinner. That was why he could not obtain the power of faith. Since ancient times, he has relied on himself to break through to his current realm step by step. As a result, even though he was only a Dao Severing Expert and was still far from becoming a great king, he was still quite terrifying and powerful to the extreme. After all, this was the Cultivationless Age, and he relied on his own strength to cultivate.

He had been cultivating in secret since ancient times. The world's essence energy was slowly drying up and he severed his dao with great difficulty. He was the only person who had passed the heavenly tribulation when the world became silent several hundred years ago. His cultivation did not change much after that, but his dao skills were extremely powerful. His understanding of the dao was difficult for ordinary people to comprehend. He was extremely powerful.

Since he was young, he was not from the mortal world, but rather a being from the Immortal Domain who accidentally fell into the underworld through a rare void rift. This fall left him separated from his origins and trapped in the lower realm, something he has been obsessed with throughout his life.

From then on, his entire cultivation path had one primary goal: to return to the Immortal Domain . With extraordinary talent and extreme determination, he continued to transcend his limits until he finally reached the level of Red Dust Immortal , a realm that was almost unmatched even in his time.

However, despite having reached the pinnacle of power in the mortal world, he still could not easily return to his home realm. This highlights the great irony of his life:

A person who comes from the immortal world has to struggle desperately in the mortal world, but still fails to achieve his initial goal.

In short, the background of Bù Sǐ is the story of a fallen immortal, rising to become the strongest in the mortal world, but still bound by destiny and ambition to return to his origin —a journey filled with both majesty and tragedy.
at the end of his life, he said ;

Fans commonly associate Hei Huang with Xiaotian Quan the Howling Celestial Dog due to their shared deep dog loyalty to their owners, Wu Shi and Erlang Shen respectively.

Black Emperor began following Wushi Great Emperor during his later years: Black Emperor revealed that when he began following Wushi Great Emperor, the Great Emperor had already entered his later years and withdrawn from the world. characters.title: Heng Yu
characters.introText: Hengyu Emperor, whose real name is Jiang Hengyu, was one of the Human Great Emperors in Shrouding the Heavens and the founder of the ancient Jiang Family. Born in the Ziwei Star Domain nearly two hundred thousand years ago, he rose to the peak of cultivation and attained the Extreme Dao realm, becoming a protector of the human race. He forged the imperial weapon Hengyu Furnace using Phoenix Blood Red Gold within the dangerous Taichu Ancient Mine and even fought multiple Forbidden Zone Supremes alone, killing several and forcing the restricted areas into a non-aggression pact. Throughout his life he sought the truth behind the Immortal Heavenly Emperor, leaving traces across different lands and legends, and after death his body gained spirituality and was worshipped as Shennong. During the Dark Turmoil, his remaining will revived through the faith of living beings and he ultimately sacrificed himself in battle, perishing together with the Light and Dark Supreme to safeguard the world
characters.appearance: He was a middle-aged man, tall and strong, with a robust physique, like a peerless hero from ancient times, extremely powerful, with incredibly deep eyes.
characters.history:
This is a long story, inseparable from the romantic past of the Jiang Family's ancestor, the Hengyu Great Emperor.

The Hengyu Great Emperor was quite an eccentric in his youth—he had a friend on the Purple Micro Ancient Star who founded an indescribable Dao lineage, known as the "Human Desire Dao Sect" The official propaganda stated that it taught about the seven emotions and six desires, refining the heart in the mortal world, and comprehending the supreme Dao.
As for the unofficial aspect… well that aspect branched directly into Yin-Yang dual cultivation, which was universally condemned!
That the Hengyu Great Emperor could have such "bad company"… was quite extraordinary. Not only were they good friends, but he even forged a Quasi-Imperial Armament for him!
And, forging the armament was one thing, but he kept it hidden, only to be revealed as an 'armament within an armament' during critical moments…
This makes it hard not to suspect whether this friend of the Hengyu Great Emperor was a true friend, or one of those legendary "I have a friend" situations?
Who knows?
Many felt a little envious in their heart.

To be an Emperor, one must learn from Hengyu!
If the life of the Void Great Emperor was an epic of heroic tragedy.
Then the life of the Hengyu Great Emperor was, without a doubt, that of a winner in life!
He had a "friend" who was a driver, he himself achieved the Great Emperor's cultivation, and he founded two immortal families and divine dynasties; facing the Dark Turmoil, he struck first, breaking into the Primordial Ancient Mine, directly slaying a Supreme being, and then managed to retreat unharmed, full of prestige.
These things aside, he also fished!
He fished for a big fish like the Undying Heavenly Emperor!

Although he didn't catch him… it was fortunate he didn't.
Like the Tai Huang Great Emperor, who clashed with the Undying Heavenly Emperor and ended up dying miserably, without a complete corpse, collapsing before the Immortal Road, unable to be pieced back together.
The Hengyu Great Emperor is special even among the Emperors of the Chaotic ancient era.
The Tai Huang died tragically in his later years, the Void Great Emperor's life was tragic, the Luan Gu Great Emperor was driven mad by inner demons, the West Empress lived a lonely half-life, the Ruthless Great Emperor had deep-seated obsessions, the Beginningless Great Emperor turned his back on living beings…
Qing Di transformed himself into an Immortal Realm, but his descendants fell into decline.
…
Everyone envies the Emperors and Empresses of the ancient era, but who knows the sorrow of Emperors and Empresses?
And among the strongest individuals in this universe, the Hengyu Great Emperor seems somewhat out of place.
—Everyone else is doing poorly, why was he living so comfortably?!

As a reader and an outsider from another world, I admired the Ruthless Great Emperor's obsession that led to immortality, revered the Beginningless Great Emperor's boundless combat power, and respected the Void Great Emperor's noble character… But if I had to choose the type of person readers most resonated with and most wanted to become? Without a doubt, it had to be the Hengyu Great Emperor!
His youthful dream wasn't grand.
To achieve longevity, then to claim territory as his own and live a carefree life… He was very honest, and he deserves praise.

Origin and Ascension Born 190,000 years ago in the Ziwei Star Domain. After attaining the Dao (becoming an Emperor), he traveled to the Falling Sun Ridge in the Ancient Mine of Early Beginning. There, he harnessed the ultimate "Extreme Yang Fire" to forge his Imperial weapon.

Battles with Supremes His actions provoked the Forbidden Zone Supremes. During the ensuing conflict, he successfully killed three Supremes who had "sublimated" to their peak power. This feat forced the Ancient Mine of Early Beginning to sign a non-aggression pact.

Later Life and Rebirth He later moved to the Central Region to establish new forces and forged the "Goddess Furnace" in the Ziwei Star Domain. Utilizing a Divine Herb of Immortality, he successfully lived a second life.

The Dark Disturbance During the catastrophic "Dark Disturbance," he was temporarily resurrected through the gathered willpower and faith of all living beings. He ultimately sacrificed himself to take down the Light-and-Dark Supreme, ending in a mutual destruction.

The Hengyu Scripture: The "Four Poles Volume" of this scripture is hailed as the strongest of all Imperial scriptures for that specific cultivation realm.

Phoenix Blood Scarlet Gold: The rare material left behind during the forging of his Imperial weapon remains a primary target for the descendants of the Jiang family to seek out.

Historical Mystery: He spent much of his time tracking the Immortal Emperor (Bushi Tianhuang) in the Immortal Manor World, and his later years are deeply intertwined with the legends of Shennong.

characters.history:
"Huo yun" (火云) in Mandarin literally means "fire cloud". In general, this term has several meanings, depending on the context:

1. Fire cloud in literal form:  This refers to a natural phenomenon where clouds appear red or orange, resembling fire.

2. Strong and vibrant imagery:  "Huo yun" is often used to describe something that is very strong, passionate, or full of energy, such as a person full of passion, fighting spirit, or fire.

3. In a mythological or literary context:  "Huo yun" can also be used in Chinese mythology or literature to represent powerful natural forces, such as the power of fire or the power of spirit.

"Fire cloud" (literal):  "Huo yun" can refer to the sunrise or sunset creating red clouds.

Spirit imaging:  "Zhao Yun has huo yun (Zhao Yun has a burning spirit)," to describe Zhao Yun's extremely high fighting spirit.

He sat high on the throne. His unparalleled charm had been passed down for thousands of years.

The Divine King had a head full of white hair that shone like snow. His body was tall and strong, and his appearance was peerless. As soon as he appeared, he gave people the feeling of a majestic mountain that could support the sky. He made people feel that everything could be held up, like an eternal pillar supporting the sky.

characters.history:
In the hearts of the people of the Northern Region, the Jiang Clan was like a god, unshakable and supreme. Who knows how many countries there were in this region, big and small. Many ancient countries actually worshiped Emperor Heng Yu.

In the past, the Jiang family made a big fuss about Jiang Taixu's disappearance. They suspected that several holy lands had done this, and several peerless masters had joined forces to kill the Divine King, Jiang Taixu. More than four thousand years ago, the situation was turbulent, and an earth-shattering war between holy lands almost broke out. Fortunately, it was finally explained, and the storm subsided.

Back then, when his name shook the world, he was not very old. In the eyes of many of the older generation, he was still a child, yet he had already cultivated the Divine King body to the Great Accomplishment Realm. Many people speculated that, given time, his future would be limitless! He was not very old, but he was like the sun in the sky. Whenever he moved, it would cause the clouds to move. It was just when he was rising and reaching his peak that he suddenly disappeared from the world, never to be seen again. He disappeared from the world’s sight forever. At that time, many people speculated that he might have gone into seclusion to break through to a higher realm.

characters.title: Jin Yan
characters.introText: The name "Jinyan" (金言) in Mandarin has several possible meanings depending on the characters used. In general, the character "金" (jīn) means "gold" or "metal", while the character "言" (yán) means "words" or "speaking". So, literally, "Jinyan" can be interpreted as "golden words" or "precious sayings".
characters.history:
Two hundred days after Ye Fan returned to Beidou, after going through the Beidou crisis. He went to the demon tribe to return the sacred shell to Qing Yi. The last time he came, he was full of worries. The main reason was to borrow the sacred shell. He did not stay for a moment. Now, everything finally calmed down and he went to Qin Yao Pavilion. But the pavilion was no longer there. There was no sign of life at all. In the depths of the pine forest, there was only a lonely grave. The mound was not large, and there was a stone tablet with Qin Yao's name clearly engraved on it.

There Jin Yan came to him along with Three demon races appeared. They were Bai Feng, Jin Yu, and Ku Zhu. They were the pursuers of fairy Qin Yao at that time. Bai Feng told him that Qin Yao had died less than 200 days ago, Ku Zhu also said she was very happy after learning of your return, but Qin Yao soon fell silent again and began to cultivate bitterly, she did her best to catch up, but in the end she failed in her cultivation.

“If you never showed up, she would be living well. Maybe she would have already become dao companions with one of Ku Zhu’s brothers and the others.”

These calm words were spoken by Jin Yan. It was like a knife stabbing Ye Fan's heart. He became even more silent. He couldn't say anything, only feeling a wave of bitterness.

Accordig to Sacred Ape

During the Archaic Era, powerful clans stood in great numbers. It was unknown how many times they rose and fell. They were used to seeing the tragedy of a great clan that ruled the world being annihilated in a single night.

Among them, there was one clan that had experienced ups and downs. Although they had never produced an ancient emperor, they had ruled the world several times and were known as the Crownless Emperors.

Their population was small, and their blood was pure silver. They had terrifying talents, and once they matured, they would be terrifying and powerful. Although they were not emperors, the Great Sages were endless. Even the Imperial Clan did not dare to provoke them.

characters.title: Li Changqing
characters.introText: The name "Li Changqing" in Chinese has a positive and good meaning.
characters.history:
Ye fan, Pang Bo returned to the Southern Region. They went to Immortal Ascension Valley to find Lin Jia. There they found evidence that someone was chasing them in the dark. On Lin Jia's phone, there was an evil creature in the coffin. The photo was taken when they crossed the stars from ancient Mars to Beidou. After leaving the Immortal Ascension Valley, they went to the ancient desolate forbidden land to look for evidence. Ye Fan suspected that Liu Yunzhi, Li Zhangqing, and Wang Yan were not dead. And they were the ones who tried to plot Ye Fan's murder.

They went to the Tiger Cave around the ancient Desolation forbidden land. The Tiger Cave was still the same as before. It was dry and spacious, and there was a terrifying aura surrounding it. In the depths of the Tiger Cave, Ye Fan found three human skulls. The three of them seemed to have died from extreme fear. They huddled in a corner and leaned against each other. Their arms were tied with rotten cloth and leather belts. More than twenty years had passed, and they had long since turned into withered bones. Only a few key pendants and hairpins remained, as well as some messy hair. It was a terrifying sight. They walked over and carefully examined the three skeletons. Each of them had a drooping chin. They had died in extreme fear. The space between their eyebrows had been pierced, and they had died under the mouth of the divine crocodile.

Since there was nothing suspicious they were going to leave. But Ji Ziyue’s instincts were different, she said: “The most suspicious thing is when there is nothing suspicious. It is clear that they thought you all would come to seek confirmation, and they targeted every detail to mislead you, making you believe that they are really dead.”

Finally they decided to call Duan De. Inside the tiger cave, Duan De had arrived. After entering the tiger cave, he was immediately frightened. Duan De was completely covered in cold sweat. He couldn’t help but tremble and said, “This time, we’ve met a big shot. This is the first time I’ve seen one in my entire life!” Suddenly, the light from the mirror flashed for the last time. When the blurry shadow caught the three people and walked out of the ancient cave, it suddenly turned around and revealed a cold smile at the people in the mirror. For the first time, it revealed its true form. It was actually a terrifying evil spirit!

Previously, everything was blurry and they couldn’t see its shape. But now, they truly saw it for the first time. It was extremely evil and terrifying. It had snow-white teeth, dead eyes like a fish, and a pitch-black body. There was not the slightest bit of vitality and an aura of death filled the air! They couldn’t help but retreat. This evil spirit was too terrifying. It suddenly appeared in the mirror, causing the little phoenix on Ji Ziyue’s chest to stand up. The light on the bone mirror dimmed. Everything disappeared and was no longer visible. The cave became extremely silent and a cold aura pervaded the air.

In conclusion “Liu Yunzhi, Li Changqing, and Wang Yan are not dead. Now, there are even evil spirits and divine crocodiles. Could it be that something else is crossing us?” Pang Bo muttered to himself. The process of crossing the starry sky was much more complicated than they had imagined.

Ye Fan who brought them was demanded by them to take responsibility, but it was all just to vent their frustration towards Ye Fan.  In this tense situation, the Peacock King, Red Dragon Daoist, and Green Flood Dragon came to help Ye Fan. they also held a fighting contest. The peacock king challenged Li Daoqing.

Everyone was alarmed. To challenge him in such a situation, it was clear that he wanted to slaughter the Holy Lord. Everyone sucked in a breath of cold air. If the two of them were to have a great battle, it would definitely shake the world. Eight hundred years ago, they fought for three days and three nights without a victor being determined. The entire world knew of this, and it shook the entire Eastern Wasteland.

characters.history:
Holy Son of Da Yan, Xiang Yifei Together with Holy Son of Dao Yi, Li Donglai, the heir of the Golden Family of the Northern Plains, Jin Chixiao, the Holy Daughter of All Beginnings, Zhao Yanran and 9 other saints and saintesses made a plan to kill Ye Fan. A total of thirteen saints and saintesses had come, and it was comparable to the night when the thirteen Supreme Beings besieged the Heavenly King Jiang Taixu! Liu Yiyi was taken hostage by them and they threatened to kill Yiyi if Ye Fan did not come.

Ye Fan swept his gaze across everyone and said, “Let go of Yiyi. I’ve fulfilled my promise and rushed here. You guys can’t even do this, right?” “Sure, no problem. As long as you’re here, it’s enough. She’s just an insignificant person,” someone said indifferently. Ye Fan shattered the heavenly light and then formed a sword imprint with a flip of his hand. He entered the void and split the black-clothed man in half. Fresh blood rained down like a storm.

During this process, he faced them calmly and said, “If you wanted to kill me, you could have done it openly. Why do you have to hide like this?”  Everyone quickly approached and surrounded him. Killing intent was everywhere. Sword light and sword shadows were everywhere, and many magical treasures hung in the air.  “Isn’t there anyone who wants to fight me? Are they all that afraid of me?” he mocked.  “I’ve always wanted to test how strong you guys are. Everyone, don’t kill him yet. Let me measure his strength!” The descendant of the Northern Plains Golden Family, Jin Chixiao, spoke up. He was indeed an expert. Last time, when he transformed into a god and entered the killing formation, he displayed the combat power of the Holy Son. It was hard to say how terrifying his main body’s cultivation was.

“Let me try first!” Dao Yi Saint Li Donglai shouted. He was the first to attack. After advancing to the first transformation of Dragon Transformation, he had great confidence. Liu Donglai took out the Space-Penetrating Divine Ship! This golden warship passed through the void and disappeared in the blink of an eye. However, a terrifying aura appeared between heaven and earth, as if an evil spirit from the abyss was about to appear. It was impossible to judge where it appeared from, and no one knew what kind of combat power it would display. The danger was hidden in the darkness. When faced with this kind of warship, Ye Fan did not display other sacred techniques. He could only smash his fist into the sky! The golden fist was like a divine mountain. Its power tore through the void and hit the bottom of the ship fiercely, releasing endless light.

A clear crack appeared, and the body of the warship shook. Light overflowed in all directions like ripples stretching across the snowy mountains. The holy son of Dao Yi, Li Donglai, had advanced to the first transformation of the dragon transformation. He was full of confidence, but he did not want to fight a life and death battle with Ye Fan. He just wanted to test everything, but he found that the great treasure was about to be destroyed. Dao Yi’s holy son, Li Donglai, was shocked. This was a secret treasure that he had obtained not long ago and wanted to use his life to cultivate. His divine sense was immersed in it, and at this moment, he vomited a mouthful of blood. Ye Fan laughed and said, “That’s it? Who else wants to try? If you can’t, you can all come together!”

“Is there not a single one of you who dares to fight me?” Ye Fan looked at the 13 Holy Sons, with a hint of mockery on his face. The expressions of all the Holy Sons changed. Ever since they were young, who had ever spoken to them like this? There was actually a hint of disdain in his tone! They were the prodigies of the Eastern Desolation, and had always been the center of attention. They were proud and respected, so when had they ever been looked down upon like this?

However, at this moment, none of them stepped forward. Among them, not a single one had the confidence to suppress Ye Fan. Just now, everyone had already tested him. The 13 Holy Sons were unable to do anything to Ye Fan, and because of that, some were seriously injured, and there was even one who lost his life here. This was a lesson learned, and blood was the proof!

Ye Fan repeatedly provoked them, with the aim of gathering them at one point. he even lured them by throwing his cauldron on the ground. until everyone in the dark appeared then he began his heavenly tribulation. Endless lightning and boundless purple light completely drowned the sky and earth. This was no longer a bolt of lightning, but a sea of ​​lightning! Nothing existed anymore, everything was submerged in lightning. It was blinding, and even from afar, one could feel its destructive power. Needless to say, there was no need to mention those who were undergoing tribulation. Purple light covered everything, and even those who were far away felt a suffocating feeling, making them tremble. Heart-rending screams immediately rang out. Someone was undergoing tribulation, turning into ashes, forever erased from this world.

Five bolts of lightning descended. Li Rui's head exploded, and his brain fluids flowed everywhere. His consciousness scattered, and another wave of lightning descended. His body and soul were destroyed, turning into dust. Nothing was left. On the other side, the head elder in the Eighth Transformation of the Dragon Transformation let out a miserable cry. His skin split open, and his bones were exposed. Then Ye Fan arrived in front of the head elder. He stretched out his finger and tapped the space between the old man’s eyebrows. Electricity flowed in, and with a bang, the elder exploded. His bones flew everywhere. Many of the older generation screamed. They had seen Ye Fan walk through the lightning without suffering any injuries. He kept killing people. They were in despair. Ye Fan was like a god of death walking in the darkness, reaping lives. Wherever he passed, people would fall and turn to ashes. The hair of the Dao Yi Holy Son Li Donglai was disheveled as he screamed in fear. Lightning wrapped around his body. He convulsed, and many parts of his body were ripe. The Luo Heaven Umbrella that was woven with natural laws could not hold on any longer and slowly shattered. His Luo Heaven Umbrella had been destroyed, and he no longer had any barriers. He could not live any longer. His flesh could not block the purple sea at all. Ye Fan's palm fell, and his head was smashed into pieces. Li Donglai died a violent death.

characters.personality:
Xiaoman is a proud, ambitious, and pragmatic woman that aimed for status, recognition, and success in a materialistic manner. While once Ye Fan’s girlfriend on Earth; they have separated by the time of the fated class reunion. Careful of her social standing, she never revealed her past relations with Ye Fan on Earth nor donghua realm;  she reveals a materialistic and opportunistic nature in the other world. She prefers to side with those who seem stronger or more promising, showing limited vision and little faith in Ye Fan’s potential during his early struggles. Although intelligent and socially adept, she tends to prioritize status and security over emotional bonds, which leads her to distance herself from her former companions. Her short-sightedness and emotional detachments ultimately defined her, making her more of a symbol of Ye Fan’s lost past than a lasting presence in his journey.

Xiaoman isn't completely heartless, when she thought Ye Fan became a vagrant, she offered him money to keep him out of trouble. However, she never admitted to her sect siblings the depth of their relationship and called him an acquaintance. Xiaoman never stayed long term in any sect due to limited loyalties; she would change allegiances to other sects if it can grant her better standing. Although Ye Fan has never betrayed nor harmed Xiaoman, she show limited loyalty and trust to him; she's quick to judge against his favor. It was only after Ye Fan elevated to the top of the donghua realm that she realized her short-sightedness.

After Liu Yiyi woke up, she walked inside the cold and gloomy palace. She accidentally stepped on a formation pattern and was teleported out..

After the elders of the Jade Lake examined Liu Yiyi's body, it was as if they had obtained a priceless treasure. With such boundless divine power, who knows how many years of bitter cultivation could be saved? They immediately accepted her as a disciple of the Jade Lake, and nurtured her with great care.

characters.introText: He was quite handsome with his black hair flowing over his shoulders. His eyes were clear and bright, and his cultivation was strong. He wears a green robe
characters.appearance: He was quite handsome with his black hair flowing over his shoulders. His eyes were clear and bright, and his cultivation was strong. He wears a green robe
characters.personality: He had an air of indifference and unnaturalness about him. He is also very calm.
characters.history:
Liu Yun was the Servant of the Body Ether Tyrant. He came to the fiftieth city of the human race to convey a message to Ye fan,

"The Tyrant King hopes that you can wait for him in the fiftieth city of the human race. Fight with all your might and let this battle shine brilliantly." ~ Liu Yun to Ye fan

Ye Fan asked Liu Yun Why did he have to fight in the fiftieth city of the human race?

“During the Desolate Era, a sacred battle once took place here. The Tyrant King wanted to continue his glory and make this place the Tyrant Blood War City of the Ether lineage."~  Liu Yun explained

After Liu Yun explained, the fiftieth city of the human race erupted into an uproar at this moment. The person with the Firmament Tyrant Blood constitution was going to turn around and fight against the celestial body of the Burial Emperor Star. This caused everyone to discuss excitedly, and there was not a single person who did not look forward to it.

In the past few decades, there had been several heroes whose bones were buried in foreign lands, dying on the path of training, but there had never been a battle that attracted this much attention. This was an extraordinary sensation.

characters.title: Liu Yunzhi
characters.introText: Arrogant and looks down on people (especially Ye Fan). Easily prone to jealousy.
characters.personality: Arrogant and looks down on people (especially Ye Fan). Easily prone to jealousy.
characters.history:
Ye fan, Pang Bo returned to the Southern Region. They went to Immortal Ascension Valley to find Lin Jia. There they found evidence that someone was chasing them in the dark. On Lin Jia's phone, there was an evil creature in the coffin. The photo was taken when they crossed the stars from ancient Mars to Beidou. After leaving the Immortal Ascension Valley, they went to the ancient desolate forbidden land to look for evidence. Ye Fan suspected that Liu Yunzhi, Li Zhangqing, and Wang Yan were not dead. And they were the ones who tried to plot Ye Fan's murder.

They went to the Tiger Cave around the ancient Desolation forbidden land. The Tiger Cave was still the same as before. It was dry and spacious, and there was a terrifying aura surrounding it. In the depths of the Tiger Cave, Ye Fan found three human skulls. The three of them seemed to have died from extreme fear. They huddled in a corner and leaned against each other. Their arms were tied with rotten cloth and leather belts. More than twenty years had passed, and they had long since turned into withered bones. Only a few key pendants and hairpins remained, as well as some messy hair. It was a terrifying sight. They walked over and carefully examined the three skeletons. Each of them had a drooping chin. They had died in extreme fear. The space between their eyebrows had been pierced, and they had died under the mouth of the divine crocodile.

Since there was nothing suspicious they were going to leave. But Ji Ziyue’s instincts were different, she said: “The most suspicious thing is when there is nothing suspicious. It is clear that they thought you all would come to seek confirmation, and they targeted every detail to mislead you, making you believe that they are really dead.”

Finally they decided to call Duan De. Inside the tiger cave, Duan De had arrived. After entering the tiger cave, he was immediately frightened. Duan De was completely covered in cold sweat. He couldn’t help but tremble and said, “This time, we’ve met a big shot. This is the first time I’ve seen one in my entire life!” Suddenly, the light from the mirror flashed for the last time. When the blurry shadow caught the three people and walked out of the ancient cave, it suddenly turned around and revealed a cold smile at the people in the mirror. For the first time, it revealed its true form. It was actually a terrifying evil spirit!

Previously, everything was blurry and they couldn’t see its shape. But now, they truly saw it for the first time. It was extremely evil and terrifying. It had snow-white teeth, dead eyes like a fish, and a pitch-black body. There was not the slightest bit of vitality and an aura of death filled the air! They couldn’t help but retreat. This evil spirit was too terrifying. It suddenly appeared in the mirror, causing the little phoenix on Ji Ziyue’s chest to stand up. The light on the bone mirror dimmed. Everything disappeared and was no longer visible. The cave became extremely silent and a cold aura pervaded the air.

In conclusion “Liu Yunzhi, Li Changqing, and Wang Yan are not dead. Now, there are even evil spirits and divine crocodiles. Could it be that something else is crossing us?” Pang Bo muttered to himself. The process of crossing the starry sky was much more complicated than they had imagined.

characters.title: Longevity Heavenly Venerable

characters.history:
者 (Zhě) = “The one…” or “One who…” — indicating existence or identity .

Zhě is not the secret of direct power, but the secret of absolute existence.

As long as Zhě is active, your existence cannot be completely erased.

He works on the concepts of collective memory, the world soul, and karmic paths : even if your body is destroyed and your name is forgotten, Zhě makes the world subconsciously retain your traces.

Postponement of death even after the destruction of the soul.

Awakening in the form of conceptual awareness.

characters.title: Longevity Tianzun
characters.introText: Longevity Tianzun <the creator of the Secret Character ‘Swordsman’>.
characters.appearance:
He was a humanoid creature.

He wore a purple-gold crown on his head, and a Taoist robe covered his body, but his true appearance was obscured. His pale brown hair scattered across his chest and back, and his eyes revealed the vision of the sun, moon, and stars in ruins.
characters.personality:
When the long-sealed Path to the Immortal Domain finally opened, Longevity Tianzun and six other Supreme Beings advanced toward it together, their burning life force igniting the heavens. Like seven immortal monuments, they stood before the gate of eternity, turning their final battle into a spectacle of unmatched brilliance.

The laws of the Great Emperors surged across the southern cosmos as they entered the Immortal Path, beginning an event destined to be remembered as the most glorious chapter in history. Whether they succeeded or perished no longer mattered—their defiance and sacrifice ensured their immortality in legend.

With each roar, the sky shattered and the earth split, as the seven fought through the divine barricades. Never before had so many emperor-level beings moved in unison, their combined might shaking the universe and suppressing all ages.

In that moment, their creed resounded through creation:

“If one wishes to enter the Immortal Domain—one must rely on strength.”

After failing to attack the eternal path, he launched the dark turmoil with the other dark emperors, absorbing the essence of millions of living beings to prolong his life. He then fought with the sacred body of great perfection.
characters.history:
Longevity Tianzun is a supreme being in the mythological era. In the post-barren era, Tianzun was known as the Great Emperor.

Longevity Tianzun, the creator of the Secret Character ‘Swordsman’ and the one who has a deep understanding of the secret technique of immortality, who can traverse such a long span of time and pay a heavy price to be sealed from that distant era to the present day!
characters.trivia: He draws out the life-essence of countless beings, refining their longevity into his own body. This is how he endured from the Mythological Era to the present.

His eyes were a fiery gold, exuding the intelligence and profundity of age that had seen the ravages of time. As he shot forward, the starry sky rumbled, as if his mere existence was enough to shake the stability of the universe.

characters.personality:
Mo Ke represents an orthodox elder monk who has devoted his entire life to Buddhism —specifically to the Great Buddha Amitabha . He places absolute trust in the teachings and structures passed down on Mount Meru.

"He did not question order; for him, doctrine was heavenly law."

Mo Ke isn't a criminal , but he's part of a system that enslaves the souls of people under the guise of blessings and salvation . He maintains the system because he believes it's the path to salvation, not out of malicious intent.

“What may appear as cruelty to Mo Ke is a long-term form of generosity in an orthodox Buddhist perspective.”

When the demon-subduing pestle (the weapon of the Great Emperor Amitabha) spoke, Mo Ke immediately submitted without the slightest resistance. This shows that he upholds the heavenly hierarchy and never considers himself above the Emperor's legacy.

“He knew his place in the chain of dharma. Even as a great sage, he would never contradict the voice from above.”

At the end of the fight, as the pestle orders Huahua to be released, Mo Ke realizes that they have gone too far . He recites the Buddha's name in repentance and confesses his sins .

"He is not a fallen criminal, but a gatekeeper who failed to see the shadow in the light."
characters.history:
The Great Ancient Buddha Mo Ke was an ancient Buddha. Although his aura was restrained, he still gave off an oppressive pressure. Unlike other monks, his head was bright, and he actually had thin, yellow hair like weeds. His face was covered in wrinkles, like a dried orange. He was extremely old, and his body was withered, but his hidden vitality was terrifying.

In the past, the Victorious Fighting Buddha had once fought a fierce battle with him, and in the end, he was suppressed beneath Mount Meru.
characters.trivia:
The Battle of Mount Meru was not about winning or losing, but about legacy , the unfinished dao , and the eternal solitude of emperors .

The Emperor's weapons carry the hopes and regrets of their masters, forming a battle deeper than mere power: it is a clash of souls, legacies, and histories .

The world was shaken, not by the destruction, but by the significance of this unprecedented meeting of imperial weapons .

Strategic Role ;
Mo Ke was the leader of Mount Meru's defenses. He coordinated arhats, bodhisattvas, and even Mahamayuri to maintain the Buddha formation and the power of the soul.

He is at the forefront in maintaining the stored strength of the people's spirits.

When the God Emperor walked up Mount Meru, Mo Ke trembled with fear , sitting cross-legged while reciting the name of Amitabha. - This shows that even though he was a great sage, he was powerless against the power of the Emperor .

When the demon-subduing pestle spoke, Mo Ke immediately admitted his mistake and handed over Huahua without protest - Here we see Mo Ke respecting Dharma more than his own position or reputation.
characters.quotes:
“Dharma is not subject to storms. Even if mountains collapse, the teachings must remain standing.”

“You see taking, we call it maintenance. You see shackles, we call it protection.”

"Mount Meru is not just rock and earth—it is the resting place of millions of souls. Who are you to dismantle it?"

“Virtue without structure is water running wild. We give it a container.”

“If we are guilty, then we are guilty of believing too much that suffering must be kept in check so that the meaning of happiness can be kept alive.”

“I hear the lamentations of souls, but I am bound by a sacred oath higher than pity.”

“Compassion that is not guided by discipline will lead beings astray into the abyss of chaos.”

“Amitabha Buddha is not just a name—he is the living law in the walls and air of Mount Meru.”

"If the shadow remains standing, then I will not fall."

“Don't ask my will. Ask the bodhi tree that still stands, the old bell that continues to ring.”

“Why does the light we gathered now shine upon us with pain?”

"If the demon-conquering pestle commands, who am I to refuse? I am but a servant at the Buddha's hand."

“If the people have woken up, and I am still sleeping, then I am not a teacher… but a burden.”

"Maybe we closed the door for too long, so the light coming in is now blinding."

“We look after the mountains, but forget to look after those who climb.”

“I have chanted Buddha's name thousands of times… but tonight, I feel unheard.”

"It is not I who unchains the chains, but the voice from within the great bell. This is not the end, but the beginning of a new dharma."

“Buddha never taught to lock ourselves away. We are the ones who close ourselves away in our own fear.”

characters.personality: A very cool guy with high self-confidence without needing to seek too much attention.
characters.history:
The sky above the Flying Celestial Battlefield burned with a pale gold twilight. Countless broken stars drifted in the void, their dying embers illuminating the remnants of ancient wars. Among those who stood beneath that vast and fractured heaven was Mo Wentian, his robes fluttering in the cold stellar wind.

He stood silently for a long time, his gaze fixed upon the far horizon where Ye Fan, the Human Clan’s Sacred Body, had once burned brighter than the sun. The silence around him was heavy—an unspoken reverence for the hero who had died three centuries ago.

At last, Mo Wentian spoke. His voice was calm, but each word struck like thunder.

“Ye Fan Sacred Body died in battle three hundred years ago,” he said. “He was buried in the universe with the supreme glory of a supreme being. He is worthy of respect.”

The warriors gathered behind him lowered their heads. The memory of that day still haunted the stars—the golden blood, the shattering of galaxies, and the cry that tore through the Nine Heavens.

characters.title: Nangong Qi
characters.introText: Nangong Qi is a male character in Chen Dong’s xianxia novel Shrouding the Heavens (《遮天》). He comes from the Source-Arts (Origin-Stone) lineage, the Nangong family, and is revered as a grandmaster of Source Arts; even the Holy Lands treat him with great respect.
characters.history:
As a leading authority in the Source-Arts world, Nangong Qi once engaged in a three-round stone-gambling duel with the protagonist Ye Fan at the Stone Workshop of the Yaoguang Holy Land. Each side selected three origin stones—the Lieyang Stone, the Big Elephant, and the Blood Sacrifice Platform—with wagers reaching as high as one million jin of source. During the cutting process he revealed a head-sized piece of divine source, the head of an ancient royal being, and a crystal origin stone sealing the Divine Silkworm Princess. He employed techniques such as the Yuantian Divine Wheel and secretly attempted to scheme against Ye Fan using a rare variant source.

The contest was ultimately judged by the Saint-King Bo, who declared Ye Fan the victor. Nangong Qi questioned the ruling and was warned, and his family’s refusal to accept the loss created a grudge with Zhao Qianyu. During the stone-cutting, Zhou Tong attacked him with the Great Void Hand Seal; after his protective source wheel was shattered, half his body was gravely injured. His earlier attempts to harm others later sparked further disputes, while the resources Ye Fan gained from the gambling match laid the foundation for his breakthrough into the Four Extremes Secret Realm.

characters.title: Nangong Zheng
characters.introText: Nangong Zheng  is a prominent Human Race powerhouse from the novel Shrouding the Heavens (遮天) by Chen Dong. Revered as one of the strongest cultivators of the Eastern Wasteland during his era, he is often referred to by  as "Nangong Daxian" (南宫大仙). He is famous for his belief that one should risk everything for a chance at immortality, giving rise to the saying: "An Immortal Platform Second Layer cultivator daring to fight for a lifetime of immortality" (仙二敢搏一世仙). A supreme expert among humanity, Nangong Zheng cultivated the Longevity Art (长生诀) and possessed the legendary Jianmu Vision, allowing him to manifest the ancient divine tree said to connect Heaven and Earth. Despite approaching the end of his lifespan, he fearlessly ventured into the dreaded Bronze Immortal Palace in pursuit of the secrets of immortality, becoming one of the few individuals to return alive.
characters.appearance:
Nangong Zheng is depicted as a tall and imposing man with an extraordinary and refined temperament. He has snow-white hair that flows like frost, giving him a transcendent and aged yet elegant appearance. His facial features are handsome and sharp, often described as heroic and otherworldly. He is almost always surrounded by vegetation, as he cultivates the Longevity Art and lives in close affinity with nature. Flowers and plants frequently accompany him, sometimes even appearing beneath his feet or around his body when he moves or uses his techniques.

When he appears in battle or reveals his cultivation, petals often drift through the air, forming a radiant floral path. His most striking visual manifestation is the Jianmu Vision, where a colossal ancient divine tree rises into the sky, its canopy vast enough to obscure the heavens, symbolizing his connection to life, vitality, and the natural order.
characters.personality:
Nangong Zheng is a bold and decisive human cultivator known for his relentless pursuit of immortality and opportunities within the cultivation world. He embodies the philosophy of “risking everything for a single chance at immortality,” often placing himself in life-or-death situations without hesitation. His mindset reflects both ambition and a willingness to challenge fate, even when facing far more dangerous opponents or forbidden regions.

Despite his fierce and daring nature, he is not reckless in a simple sense; rather, he is calculating and experienced, fully aware of the dangers he engages with. His long lifespan and deep cultivation have given him a calm, almost detached temperament, especially when confronting life-and-death struggles that would terrify ordinary cultivators. He is also highly resilient, surviving multiple catastrophic events that eliminated many stronger figures.
characters.history:
Nangong Zheng is a powerful human cultivator from the xianxia novel Shrouding the Heavens, first introduced as a near-limit figure of the older generation of cultivators. He is regarded as one of the top “ancient experts” of the Eastern Wasteland, having cultivated to the Immortal Platform realm after an extremely long period of practice and accumulation.

He was originally believed to have died in seclusion around five hundred years prior to the main story, but re-emerged when rumors spread about the reappearance of the Bronze Immortal Palace, a legendary forbidden site connected to the secrets of immortality. Driven by the pursuit of the “immortal fate,” he left seclusion and re-entered the world, positioning himself once again in the center of major conflicts among peak cultivators.

Nangong Zheng belongs to a generation of “old monsters” who bridge the gap between ancient legends and the current era. Unlike many cultivators who retreat into isolation upon reaching their limits, he actively seeks opportunities in dangerous ancient ruins and forbidden zones, believing that only through extreme risk can one obtain a true chance at immortality. This philosophy defines his re-entry into the cultivation world and sets the stage for his involvement in major events such as the Bronze Immortal Palace expedition and later large-scale conflicts across the Eastern Wasteland.
characters.trivia: As a Powerful being of the second level of Immortal Platform, Nangong Zheng possessed a lifespan of approximately two thousand years. In the early part of the story, he was nearing the end of his lifespan, with only about twenty years remaining.
characters.quotes:
Within a single flower lies a world, within a single tree leaf is the embodiment of Shrouding the Heavens. It is truly a blessing among countless mortal ages, for such a supreme great cultivator to exist among men.

The sacred Jianmu grows endlessly, covering the sky and blocking the stars without flaw; green mist flows like streams, full of vitality and boundless life force. The flawless stars represent divine techniques, while overflowing vitality represents perfected origin energy.

Such a great cultivator is admired across endless ages; even emperors cannot stand beside him as equals. The human supreme expert is named Nangong, and beneath the heaven-reaching sacred tree he connects directly to the sky.

The mysteries within this cannot be fully named or described—heaven’s secrets, once revealed, can never be completely spoken.

characters.title: Niu Yi
characters.introText: Niu Yi is younger generation from The Demon Bull Tribe.
characters.appearance: An existence that looked like the Ox Demon King holding the Heaven Supporting Trident and covered in thick black fur, with a human body and an ox head, a wide mouth full of fangs, and a pair of thick and sturdy black horns.
characters.history:
Qi Luo told the old sabre honcho to call Ye fan to the heavenly city. There Ye Fan was tested by Qi Luo, he spread the news about Ye fan, then Ye Fan's haters came one by one to kill him. Most of them came from the Archaic Immemorial Races, such as Lu Dongfa, Niu yi and experts from various races. Ye fan had been surrounded, he immediately started his fight with the six reincarnation fists he flew, splitting the sky and cutting everything in his way! He blocked Lu Dongfa of the Heavenly Feather Race, forced back Niu Yi of the Demon Bull Race, and then quickly killed the four great experts.

Ye Fan’s clothes were not stained with blood. He stood in the sky alone, facing the experts of the various races. In another direction, Niu Yi of the Demon Bull Race’s entire body crackled. More than a hundred bones reconnected, and his body emitted a dazzling light. The black fur on the surface of his body became translucent.

characters.history: The Vatican was the land of the Messengers and the holy land where the gods slept. It was extremely vast and much larger than a small piece of land in the mortal world. Here, towering heavenly mountains rose and fell. Rays of holy light enveloped them as angels sang hymns. Strange flowers bloomed, ancient plants grew on the cliffs, and pure-blooded unicorns roamed the forests. This was a peaceful ancient Daoist Rite Temple, and one could even see strange spirits, giants, and dragons that had been extinct since ancient times. A desolate aura assaulted one’s face. In the distance, the Dragon Pool was extremely deep. Waterfalls flowed down from the sky, and dozens of mountains were the most striking. Each of them was engraved with the dao marks of heaven and earth. On each mountain was a magnificent temple. Regardless of whether it was the foundation, tiles, or wooden pillars, they all came from ancient times and had existed for a long time. This place gave people a feeling of great change. No matter how much time passed, this place remained the same since ancient times. It was sacred and dignified. Not everyone could set foot in this place, especially those who came to denounce the Vatican. Since ancient times, not many people have been able to do so.

characters.title: Primordial Beginning Heavenly Venerable
characters.introText: Here’s an etymological breakdown of 元始天尊 (Yuánshǐ Tiānzūn), a title for one of the highest deities in Chinese Daoism:
characters.history:
Yuánshǐ Tiānzūn is the Great Emperor from Mythological Era, representing the Primordial Beginning, the source of all cosmic order.

In Daoist esoteric traditions, especially in the context of the Nine Secrets (九秘), Yuánshǐ Tiānzūn is said to have created or revealed certain sacred characters or words of power.

Character 兵 ("Bīng"):
Literally means "soldier" or "military".

In a spiritual context, it symbolizes:
The ability to command spiritual forces.

The mobilization of divine troops (protective deities, spirits, or energy).

The power of alignment and order, making things “fall into place” like an army responding to a general.

The character 兵 within the Nine Secrets is used in rituals and meditations for:
Protection

Exorcism of malign forces

Summoning spiritual support

It's an active force (Yang), aligning with the creative and commanding nature of Yuánshǐ Tiānzūn.

characters.title: Qian Lun
characters.introText: Qian Lun is the Great Sage of the Ten Thousand Dragons Nest.
characters.appearance:
Qian Lun, the Great Sage of the Ten Thousand Dragons Nest, had an appearance that reflected the splendor of the dragon’s royal blood and the cultivation strength of the Great Sage level. He wore a dragon emperor robe embroidered with the symbol of ten thousand dragons, which shone softly with imperial light. Every thread on his robe was woven from spiritual gold thread and young dragon scales. His body was tall and sturdy, the aura emanating from him was like an endless ocean. Even when standing still, he was like an immovable mountain.

When using his full power, his true body could transform into a purple dragon tens of thousands of meters long, carrying imperial might that could destroy stars. His appearance was not only a symbol of status, but also a threat that silenced the surrounding Saints. Unfortunately, even his majestic form could not save Qian Lun from being destroyed at the hands of the Demonic Humans.
characters.personality: Qian Lun, is a cold, arrogant, and imperial figure. As one of the pinnacle figures of the ancient dragon race, his personality is shaped by the power, bloodline, and high status he inherited.
characters.history: He is the king of ten thousand dragon nests, he is an old cultivator of his clan and is the ancestor of the clan, his cultivation is very deep, he is currently at the peak of the Great Sage
characters.trivia:
His father was known as Little Di Que. He was an extraordinary figure who was almost on par with the most amazing gods.

In that era, Di Que was truly brilliant. Although he was unable to verify the dao, his heavenly talent was still comparable to the Fighting Emperor, and he was known as one of the most amazing gods since ancient times.

Qianlun's father was two thousand years younger than Di Que. Although his talent was not as good as Di Que, it was enough for him to be hailed as Little Di Que.

In the battle back then, Qianlun's father was too arrogant and wanted to capture the human demon with his bare hands. In the end, he did not expect that the extreme power of Yin and Yang would invade his body. After the battle, he fell into a deep sleep.

After that his father was sealed in a heavenly cocoon, unable to wake up.
characters.quotes: — To Ye Fan and Human Demon.

Briefly spoil this story.(Confirmed by Chen Dong)
The character of graceful girl with an adorable curve body ,coupled with her dubbing which really gets into her expressions, really suits her.

Qin Yao is most tragic girl in the Shrouding the Heavens novel, end her lifelong wish to obtain ye fan's love, but in the end she died

She was the first girl ye fan meet in the big deeper region and also the one who harassed Ye Fan. Her identity is actually not to much,because

She is only half heroine . She is just a servent under the arrangement of Yan Ruyu form the princess of demon race and also her status is not noble, it's just that she has a very steady body charm , and she even often teases Ye Fan verbally and Physically Which Cause Ye Fan's heart to beat very Fast .

Qin Yao was originally just a secret Servent sent to Ye Fan's side, to find out what Ye Fan know about the secrets of Ji Family,but she ended up getting caught up in it. After Qin Yao had a Relationship with Ye Fan. She also very Upset , she also carried about Ye Fan. Actually fell in love with Ye Fan.

When Ye Fan stepped into the ancient path of the Starry sky and fought for hundreds Years to fight against many powerful enemies an suppress many innate physiques, he became glorious and his information soon spread throughout the world. Ofcourse, Qin Yao naturally knew Ye Fan's supreme glory, and Ye Fan would return triumphlantly.

In order to be worthy of Ye Fan and, also be able fight alongside with him , Qin Yao trained like a frustrated person but know one expected the effect would be like Pang Bo who was drunk on the hundred grass Liquid and Qin Yao realized that the rush to achieve the Sucess has backfired on him , Qin Yao secretly cultivated alone behind Ye Fan to caught up. But, fate had its own way to solve it , she only had a ordinary Talent and finally she went to the losses of her love , She trained herself to death, and her aura was lost in Vast Red Dust.

Qin Yao's death was certainly a wound for Ye Fan. Because Ye fan also loved her and swore infront of Qin Yao's tomb and that he would bring her back to life .

Ye Fan said and hardened his words to fight towards Immortal Territory (Perfect World) and followed Shi Hao's footsteps to the Plateau (The Sacred Ruins).

Long Story in Short, Ye Fan and shi hao reached the dao sacrifice Realme (Transcendence). Shi hao raised its Family and Ye fan raised Qin Yao and An Miaoyi to be this wife's and also Reincarnated This dead Parents. And live happily.

Unconsciously, he arrived at the grave in the season of flying yellow leaves. On the tombstone, there was a inscription he has written himself in the past.
"Qin Yao, I'm hear to Visit you." As this eyes want in this direction, the lonely grave cracked open, and a lifelike women in the coffin opened her eyes.

"Ye Fan, you're back? I...have been waiting for you for a long time. Something went wrong while I was practicing, and I fell asleep." 
Qin Yao sat up and looked at him with joy and excitement.

But soon, her smile froze and she said, "No, I...seem to be dead. In order to catch up You and wait for you to come back, I...was to eager to succeed and become obsessed."

Her eyes were full of tears, filled with regret and loneliness. She said, "Is this the world after death? But why are you here? You shouldn't have come ... Go back now!"

Ye Fan helped her up and said, "No ,this is the world of the living. Do you want to go to the future and take a look? Or just live in the future, I'll take you there."

characters.title: Qing Emperor
characters.introText: Qing Emperor was originally an Immortal Divine Medicine, a green lotus, rooted in the Hua Immortal Pond of Qinling, coexisting with the Green Bronze for a million years. Later, it developed sentience, severed its divine medicine characteristics to take human form as a cultivator, and gave itself the name "Wan Qing". He traversed the Starry Sky Ancient Road to attain the status of Emperor, becoming the first person to prove the Dao and become an Emperor in the Post-Ancient Desolate era. Because the Immortal Realm had not opened, while his lifespan was still relatively abundant, he entered the Desolate Tower, intending to evolve an Immortal Realm himself, but did not fully succeed. As Ye Fan's first life was nearing its end, he witnessed the manifestation of the Green Emperor's primordial spirit. After conversing with him, the Green Emperor returned to the Desolate Tower to continue his path. In the later years of Ye Fan's fourth life, the Green Emperor emerged once more, adjusting himself to his peak state. With the Desolate Tower atop his head and the Green Lotus Weapon in hand, he attempted to forcibly break through to the Immortal Realm, ultimately disappearing into a blazing light channel.
characters.appearance:
When his attempt to evolve an Immortal Realm failed and he revealed his true body, he appeared as a thin, elderly man with long grey hair and a tall, slender figure. His eyes were deep and profound, carrying a calm wisdom that seemed to understand the rise and fall of all worldly affairs.

At his peak condition, however, Qingdi looked completely different. He appeared majestic and heroic, with loose black hair flowing behind him and eyes shining like lightning. His presence was lofty and transcendent, embodying the saying “under the eternal blue sky stands a single lotus.” His aura was serene yet overwhelmingly oppressive, giving others the feeling of facing an ancient being beyond time itself.

Even when standing still, he carried the natural dignity of a Great Emperor, and his temperament was often described as detached, tranquil, and unfathomably deep — like a lotus blooming in the chaos of the universe.
characters.history:
Qingdi, whose real name was Wan Qing (万青), was originally not a human or demon but a chaotic immortal medicine — the Chaos Green Lotus (混沌青莲). He grew within the Immortal Transformation Pool (化仙池) in the Qinling region of Central Continent, rooted for millions of years upon a mysterious green bronze fragment. After gaining consciousness, he severed his own immortal-medicine nature and transformed into a cultivator, beginning a true path of cultivation. From that moment, he named himself Wan Qing and stepped onto the Dao.

From the moment he appeared in the world, his talent shocked the entire ancient star. He later entered the Qishi Academy, then embarked on the Ancient Starry Sky Road, traveling across the Eternal Star Domain and the deepest regions of the universe. He fought through the only Imperial Pass and seized heaven-and-earth fortune, ultimately becoming the first Great Emperor of the Post-Desolate Ancient Era, ending the long age without emperors.

After attaining the Dao, Qingdi created the supreme scripture Yao Emperor Scripture (妖帝经) and wielded the Extreme Dao imperial weapon Chaos Green Lotus, while also controlling the immortal artifact Desolate Tower (荒塔). A single strand of his killing intent once annihilated a powerful Holy Spirit, and he even destroyed an ancient aristocratic clan with one finger. He left behind descendants in the demon race, most notably Yan Ruyu.

Despite possessing sufficient lifespan, Qingdi discovered that the Immortal Realm had not opened. Seeking immortality for all beings, he entered the Desolate Tower about ten thousand years before the main story, attempting to evolve an Immortal Realm by himself within the human world. The world believed he had died, but in truth he remained alive, continuing his experiment in seclusion. During this period, a lingering killing intent he left behind later manifested and slew a near-perfect Holy Spirit wielding two imperial weapons.

Near the end of Ye Fan’s first lifetime, Ye Fan encountered Qingdi’s manifested primordial spirit and learned his plan to create an immortal world where longevity could exist in the mortal universe. After explaining his Dao, Qingdi returned once more into the Desolate Tower.

In Ye Fan’s fourth life, Qingdi reappeared at his absolute peak. Holding the Chaos Green Lotus and carrying the Desolate Tower above his head, he forcibly attacked the Immortal Realm. He successfully broke into a blazing passage of light. When everything ended, the Desolate Tower remained behind and only several broken lotus leaves were left, while Qingdi himself disappeared.

By the time of Sacred Ruins (圣墟), it was confirmed that Qingdi had advanced beyond the Great Emperor realm and became a Quasi-Immortal Emperor, residing within Ye Fan’s Imperial Palace.
characters.trivia: The Azure Emperor (青帝) (Azure Emperor), also known as the Green Emperor or Qingdi, is a legendary figure who appears prominently in Shrouding the Heavens as one of the most powerful Great Emperors of the Post-Ancient Desolate Era. His true origin traces back to the Chaos Green Lotus (混沌青莲) (Primal Chaos Green Lotus), a supreme innate immortal divine medicine and a paramount existence from ancient times.  In Perfect World, during Chapter 1975 ("Opening the Origin Ancient Artifact"), the weakened Chaos Green Lotus seed—having suffered severe origin damage after nirvana and calamity—encounters Shi Hao (荒天帝) (Desolate Heavenly Emperor) in an ancient pool within the Immortal Domain. Recognizing its critical condition, Shi Hao uses immortal light and vast life force to nourish it, and ultimately bestows a drop of his essence blood to restore its vitality. Revived by this power, the lotus begins to recover, surrounded by swirling chaos qi and radiant green light.  Deeply moved, the Chaos Green Lotus makes a solemn vow to repay this karmic debt across endless ages: "大恩不言谢，他年，只要我活着，无论过去多少个纪元，一定会还上这段恩情" (A great kindness need not be spoken of in thanks; in the future, as long as I live, no matter how many great eras pass, I will surely repay this debt of gratitude). At the same time, it chooses to undergo another rebirth, intending to let go of its memories and start anew, leaving only the deepest imprints within its origin to guide its future path.  In the era of Shrouding the Heavens, through this connection, the Chaos Green Lotus gradually develops sentience, severs its medicinal roots, and takes human form as Wan Qing (万青) (Wan Qing). In time, he proves the Dao and ascends as the Azure Emperor, earning the epithet "万古青天一株莲" (A single lotus beneath the eternal azure sky across ten thousand ages), symbolizing his unique origin and eternal legacy.

characters.title: Qing Yutian
characters.introText: Qing Yutian was a valiant middle-aged man, and he was exactly like a statue of a god worshipped by various clans. He was majestic and imposing, looking down on the world from above. His eyes were deep, and his tall body had a kind of intimidating dignity.
characters.appearance: Qing Yutian was a valiant middle-aged man, and he was exactly like a statue of a god worshipped by various clans. He was majestic and imposing, looking down on the world from above. His eyes were deep, and his tall body had a kind of intimidating dignity.
characters.personality: Qing Yutian is brave and fearless
characters.history:
Qing Yutian is the grandson of Qing Ming, a god child who was once robbed of his right to ascend the throne by a traitorous old god. Unlike his grandfather who failed to attain a second life due to not possessing the Ancient Tree of Life , Qing Yutian was sealed as a god in the ancient faith domain. He was raised with the legacy of sacred vengeance and a single goal: to take back the god throne that had been seized by the traitor.

As the representative of Qing Ming's legacy, Qing Yutian rebuilt the foundation of his clan's faith in the ancient domain, ignited the Heavenly Fire , and inherited the divine position with the power of his people's faith.
characters.trivia:
Qing Yutian is the only god who ascended the throne with a belief system from the outer realm, not the main god realm.

The destruction of the old god's heavenly position by another god elder was the turning point of Qing Yutian's victory.

One of the supreme divine artifacts refuses to follow the orders of the old gods, indicating a change in the power of faith in the God Realm.

Qing Yutian's fall when the Ancient Coffin was opened created a power vacuum that ushered in an era of chaos, the beginning of an era without gods.

characters.title: Queen Mother of the West
characters.introText: Queen Mother of the West is a character from Chen Dong’s fantasy novel Shrouding the Heavens. She was an Innate Saint Physique Dao Embryo who proved the Dao and became an Emperor during the Barren Ancient Era. She founded the Jade Lake Holy Land and possessed the Extreme Dao Emperor Weapon, the Immortal‑Tear Green Gold Tower. Her Dao companion was one of the nine Great Completion Saint Physiques of the  Barren Ancient Era, and together they gave birth to the Innate Saint Physique Dao Embryo, the Beginningless Emperor. In his later years, after falling into ominous corruption, the Great Completion Saint Physique willingly allowed Queen Mother of the West to kill him. In her own final years, Queen Mother of the West died in a life‑and‑death battle against a Forbidden Zone Supreme in order to avenge him
characters.history:
The West Queen Mother (Xihuangmu) was a Great Emperor who attained enlightenment during the  Barren Ancient Era. She possessed the rare Innate Dao Fetus, a physique naturally close to the Great Dao, granting her extraordinary comprehension and cultivation speed. After proving the Dao, she founded the Yaochi Holy Land, leaving behind the supreme inheritance known as the Western Emperor Scripture, allowing her lineage to flourish for hundreds of thousands of years.

During her life she formed a Dao-companion bond with one of the Great Accomplished Saint Body of the human race. Their union produced a child who inherited both bloodlines — the Innate Saint Body Dao Fetus, later known as the Wushi Emperor, one of the most legendary figures in history.

In his later years, the Great Accomplished Saint Body was afflicted by ominous corruption that often befell peak cultivators. To prevent catastrophe and protect the world, he willingly chose death at her hands. The West Queen Mother personally killed her beloved companion, an act of both mercy and resolve that deeply shaped her later life.

Afterward she devoted herself to safeguarding her son and his future. She buried herself together with her companion’s imperial corpse at the ancient grounds of Yaochi to protect the blood essence left for Wushi Emperor’s growth and cultivation.

In her final years, seeking vengeance and justice for the tragedy of her companion, she confronted the Forbidden Zone Supremes. She ultimately fell in a great battle against them, dying as a Great Emperor in war rather than fading with age.

Though she perished, her legacy endured. The Yaochi Holy Land, her scripture, and the rise of the Wushi Emperor ensured her influence continued long after her death, making her one of the most important female Great Emperors in the history of Shrouding the Heavens.
characters.trivia: This name also appears to be used as a title by the leader of Yaochi Holy Land. In Episode 136, the head of the Yaochi Holy Land is introduced and is likewise referred to as the Queen Mother of the West. However, the original Queen Mother of the West is no longer alive by that point. This suggests that "Queen Mother of the West" functions as a hereditary or institutional title passed down to successive leaders of the Yaochi Holy Land. Therefore, the profile image shown is that of the current Queen Mother of the West rather than the original Queen Mother, who was the mother of Wu Shi.

characters.title: Rui Wei
characters.introText: His body was thin but sturdy. He walked slowly, not because he was weak, but because he carried the burden of history and responsibility with every step.
characters.appearance: His body was thin but sturdy. He walked slowly, not because he was weak, but because he carried the burden of history and responsibility with every step.
characters.personality: A combination of softness, firmness
characters.history:
Rui Wei’s homeland was no ordinary place. On par with the heavenly domain of the Godslayer Dynasty or Vicious’s Land of Primordial Chaos, this area was once a center of spiritual and alchemical glory. But over time, its spiritual energy faded. Once full of divine medicines and celestial artifacts, it was now barely habitable.

Rui Wei is a symbol of a marginalized generation—those with talent and determination, but born from a land nearly forgotten by the heavens.
