characters.title: Ruthless Emperor
characters.introText: The Ruthless Empress is an important character in the classic xianxia novel Shrouding the Heavens by Chen Dong, as well as in its derivative works. She also makes cameo appearances in Perfect World and Sacred Ruins. A grand treasure vase hovers above her head, and everything retreats and all laws are broken wherever she goes, making her supreme in the world.
characters.appearance:
Appearance and Attire

A little girl with pigtails, her face dirty but her large eyes pure and gem-like, evoking sympathy.

Wore patched, tattered clothes and shoes with holes, revealing her toes.

When scolded, she would lower her head, timidly retreat, with tears in her big eyes, leaving alone, looking pitiful and lonely.

Flowing hair and fluttering clothes, with a tall and exceptional figure, appearing as if she emerged from a myth.

She exuded a transcendent aura, as if she didn't belong to this world, with an ethereal presence suggesting she could ascend to immortality at any moment.

Her hair shimmered like starlight, and her moon-white dress highlighted her graceful and proud immortal posture.

Her skin was jade-like, and although her face was hidden by a ghost-face mask, her clear eyes and exposed chin revealed her beauty.

A Daoist treasure vase hovered above her head, repelling all things and laws, making her the supreme ruler of the world.

As an Immortal King

Her long dress fluttered as she soared through the sky, her hair swaying, embodying a celestial charm, standing proudly above the mortal world.

She had an otherworldly air, appearing not to belong to the human realm, with a floating white robe suggesting transcendence.

Initially, she seemed like a true fairy from a secluded valley or an elf from the forest, untouched by mortal concerns.

However, as she approached swiftly, her presence was overwhelming, exuding restrained power and supreme elegance, able to dominate the heavens.

She stood still amidst the chaotic historical river, shrouded in chaotic mist, her white dress dancing in the wind, her black hair floating, each strand containing stars, making her the sole sovereign.

Her face was blurred, and a magical artifact continuously transformed in front of her, eventually becoming a bronze mask that added to her mysterious aura.

As an Immortal Emperor

She was indescribably beautiful, like an unreal being from the end of the immortal path, flawless and perfect.

Her white dress fluttered in the air, her beauty unparalleled.

With her eyes closed, her long eyelashes highlighted her transcendental beauty, embodying the spirit of heaven and earth, yet she was not simply ethereal, nor weak.

Her demeanor was that of an unparalleled empress, dominating past and future, unmatched and peerless.

If there was truly someone of supreme elegance, it would undoubtedly be her.

Her timeless grace remained undiminished through the ages, always maintaining her extraordinary demeanor.

Her hair was full of life, unaffected by time, her skin jade-like. Even in battle-worn armor, she retained her unparalleled elegance, untouched and transcendent.

She ruled over the heavens and the world, with countless realms revolving around her. Even as some worlds decayed, she remained clear and pure.

As a Sacrifice to the Dao Realm

Her hair billowed, her broken armor clinking softly, shrouded in white mist, her face even more indistinct.

In an otherworldly place, many weapon fragments appeared around her, forming a protective ring. Pieces of a shattered thunder pool and a broken cauldron transformed into armor covering her.

A broken wild sword became a halberd blade, and the remaining fragments of the thunder pool and cauldron formed the halberd shaft. She stood armored, holding the halberd, dominating the world.

The last fragments of the thunder pool and cauldron turned into a mask, resembling the bronze mask she once wore, with a sad, tearful smile.
characters.personality:
The Fact that refer to her title, the Ruthless Empress's ruthlessness resonates through the ages, making her one of the most enigmatic women in history. Deeply loving her brother, she was willing to become an enemy of the world for his sake. She created the "Heaven-Swallowing Devil Art" and devoured the essences of cultivators to achieve enlightenment.

She is incredibly strong-willed and refuses to show weakness. Instead of practicing the Nine Secrets, she chose to create nine great immortal arts to rival them, standing alone against the Nine Heavens with her own strength. Despite her formidable nature, she is also deeply sentimental. Without any offspring, she left her legacy to the village that once adopted her.

She held disdain for the pursuit of immortality and becoming an emperor was merely a means to an end: waiting for her brother's return.

characters.title: Sheng Huangzi
characters.introText: Sheng Huangzi is a fictional character appearing in Chen Dong’s novels Shrouding the Heavens (遮天) and The Sacred Ruins (圣墟). His true form is a member of the Fighting Saint Ape (斗战圣猿) race and he is the son of the Fighting Saint Emperor. He wields the imperial weapon, the Immortal Iron Staff. Possessing a fierce and upright personality, he inherits his father’s will to protect the human race. Due to the great upheaval at the end of the Primordial Era, he was sealed within Divine Source, and later emerged when Ye Fan uncovered him while gambling on source stones, after which he began his cultivation journey.
characters.appearance:
Golden eyes Sheng Huangzi was not very tall, less than five feet, but it was very strong, with a human body and covered with dense, shiny golden hair. Although it is not majestic as Pang Bo, it has a strong sense of power. It seems to be able to pick stars and moons with just a move of its hands and feet. Even the void can be distorted with its slight movements. It looks like an ape, but is more similar to a human, except that it has dense golden hair, making it difficult to classify it as a human. Standing there, it has an aura of "I am the only one who can do it better than me." This is a kind of natural pressure, as if he is a superior standing in the clouds, looking down on all creatures between heaven and earth, with a pair of eyes emitting golden light and blazing like torches.

A very strong young man with golden skin standing not far away. He was very solid and full of strength, with eyes as sharp as torches and bright and lively, and his voice was very young. His body's veins protruded like dragon tendons, giving off a powerful feeling.
characters.personality: Open-minded cultivator who equally cares for his clan, family and friends. A savvy, straight warrior.
characters.history:
As the unnamed Fighting Saint Ape, Sheng Huangzi was released from his sealed stone by Ye Fan. He was then group assaulted by publicly righteous cultivators

As the Fighting Saint Ape, Sheng Huangzi came to Yaochi's Peach Festival earlier to steal a castrated Undying Peach (Peach of Immortality) to save his half-dead Auntie, the Divine Silkworm Princess. He also hoped to exchange Ye Fan's undying medicine Kirin seed and already sworn Ye Fan as a brother due to their karma. Since his release, he had learned about the present situation of the Fighting Saint Ape Clan's losses and the Northern Plains becoming a wasteland.

During the Dark Turmoil, he summoned the phantom of the Fighting Saint Emperor and severely injured an Ancient Supreme. On the battlefield of the emperor’s descendants, he slew the imperial heir from the Taichu Ancient Mine. After achieving an alternative path to enlightenment, his combat strength rivaled that of a Supreme being. He later fought powerful enemies such as the Dragon Maiden and the Golden Heavenly Maiden, killed Shi Hu, and took part in the decisive battle of the Phoenix Nest.
characters.trivia:
Sacred Prince, his father Saint Sovereign Dòu Zhàn and his uncle Fighting Saint King/Buddha are divided portrayals of the famous Monkey King Sun Wukong from Journey to the West.
He was the child Monkey King as a Dao Seeker from birth to before his arrest by the Heavenly Court. Sacred Prince even married Six-Eared Macaque, also depicted in the West expedition.

His father was the youthful Monkey King as a War Immortal during and after the Rampage of the Heavenly Court.

His uncle was the mature Monkey King as an Ascetic for Buddhism during the expedition to the West, eventually becoming the "Victorious Fighting Buddha".

His child was the innocent Monkey King, always curious and loved to take risks that involved annoying others.

characters.title: Shenming
characters.introText: — Shenming to the human cultivator when he offended Jiang Taixu.
characters.appearance:
Shenming looked around twenty-five or twenty-six years old. He didn't appear frivolous, and his voice was low and firm. He was somewhat resolute, and the light in his eyes burned like a torch. Coupled with his black Nether Iron armor, which gleamed with a cold, crystal-like, and exquisite metallic luster, he looked extremely intimidating.

This person was well-built and possessed an extraordinary bearing. He was like an ancient war god who had walked from the ancient times. His feet were unstained by dust, and the black crystal armor wrapped around his legs. A halo of divine light emanated from his body.

His long black hair draped over his shoulders and back. The only part of his head uncovered by the Nether Iron armor was his face, allowing his appearance to be seen. His eyes were brilliant, and his features were resolute. His sword-like eyebrows were sharp.
characters.personality:
Self-confident, arrogant and cocky. Moreover, this kind of arrogance comes from within. It's not intentional or feigned. It's innate.

Shenming’s demeanor defines him as a true warrior of conviction:

Rational, direct, and fearless — he doesn’t insult; he questions.

Emotionally disciplined — calm even amid chaos.

Driven by principle — not by hate, jealousy, or pride.

“I won’t apologize, nor take back my words. That is my true thought. If you disagree, then fight.”

He becomes the embodiment of Daoist sincerity — the idea that truth, even if brutal, must be lived, not concealed.
characters.history:
When Ye Fan and Shenming began their fight, they were separated by the Battle Saint Ape and An Pu. Dissatisfied, Shenming proposed a battle between the younger generation. He brought his children and instructed the human race to find children of the same age to start the fight. Hei Huang, who had been silent all along, spoke up and provoked Shenming.

Shenming, feeling strange, said,

“Then, since you’re so confident, I’ll invite another child to come on stage. If they all lose, then we’ll naturally do as you say.”

Then Ye Fan summoned the Divine Child and ordered him to fight Minren. The Divine Child, who had always been bullied by Hei Huang and his friends, was extremely excited when he was asked to fight Minren. He felt like he had found a new punching bag. With great enthusiasm, he began to beat Minren, cursing him until the little fatty couldn't hold back his anger. If this continued, he would not only curse the child's parents, but he might even disrespect his almighty parents. The consequences of this were grave. A great being could not be humiliated, and even a child shouldn't speak like this.

When Min Ren was received by Shenming with a wave of his hand, he immediately fainted. This was entirely due to anger. Shenming, dissatisfied, sent another child, but this time it was his older brother, Shen You. Shen You had once fought a fierce battle with someone, resulting in him being injured and reduced to this size. Shenming didn't hold back; he spoke frankly. Ye Fan's side didn't object, so they sent Xiao Nannan to fight Shen You. At first, Shen You obeys, unleashing a murderous aura vast enough to shake the heavens, strong enough to make even sect ancestors tremble. But as he charges toward Nan Nan, something unimaginable happens— Behind the innocent child, a vision erupts:

a cosmic battlefield filled with fallen emperors, collapsed heavens, and blood-drenched worlds.

Mountains crumble, suns and moons fall, and among the countless corpses stands one radiant figure ascending to immortality, bathed in eternal light.

The sight freezes everyone—even Shenming and An Pu, divine beings from forbidden realms, are shocked into disbelief. This overwhelming vision comes not from Shen You’s attack, but from Nan Nan’s hidden destiny, her body glowing with an aura of immortal ascension. Under that light, Shen You collapses, screaming in agony, unable to bear the spiritual pressure. His godly will disintegrates into terror—the kind of fear born from witnessing a higher divinity.

He retreats, trembling and weeping, until Shenming shouts, “I concede defeat!” and rushes to save him. Even Shenming himself, approaching the little girl’s radiance, feels crushed as though by a mountain of eternity, suffocating beneath her power. He retreats with Shen You in awe and dread, realizing he had faced something beyond Gods or Emperors. Meanwhile, Nan Nan—the center of all this—remains innocent and unaware. Her wide, gem-like eyes blink in confusion as she looks up to Ye Fan, completely oblivious to the cataclysmic vision she just invoked.

After witnessing the unimaginable power hidden within the little girl Nan Nan, everyone — even the God King, Saint Prince, and Ji Zi— fell into deep reflection and awe. None of them had expected such divine might to emerge from a child.

Then, breaking the silence, Shenming suddenly struck his own face — a gesture that stunned everyone. It wasn’t from shame or anger, but a deliberate act of sincerity.

He then publicly apologized to the God King Jiang Taixu with complete humility:

“I take back my previous words. I apologize to the God King Jiang, and I sincerely congratulate you on your great happiness.”

Without pride or resistance, Shenming admitted his mistake before all present. To show true remorse and respect, he even vowed:

“For the next ten years, wherever you may be, I will keep my distance.”

His words demonstrated both honor and dignity — a divine warrior acknowledging a higher power, retreating not out of fear, but out of reverence for a truth greater than himself.
characters.quotes:
— Shenming said to An Pu.

— To Battle Saint ape.

Her skin glowed like living crystal , revealing her origins as a divine being from the outer world.

He wore a black and purple robe embroidered with patterns of lightning and a sea of stars , symbols of his status as a prince or high descendant of the Holy Spirit.

Appears calm and respectful to the other person , even when talking to Jiang Yifei and the Moon Spirit Princess.

Polite but highly self-confident , he knows who he is and where he comes from, and is not intimidated by anyone.

He's not overtly arrogant, but it's clear that he knows he's extraordinary , and doesn't hide it.

As a Holy Spirit from the Outer Realms, he views the human world with interest and a sense of superiority , yet respects the strengths of others.
characters.history:

Identity : He is a Holy Spirit who has obtained a flesh and blood body , something that can only be achieved through holy evolution or special refinement techniques .

Status : He is likely a prince or high noble of one of the great clans in the outer realms , considering the way people respect him and the influence he has over the geniuses.

characters.title: Sovereign King of the Eventide
characters.introText: Sovereign King of the Eventide or Dark Night Monarch is a character in the xianxia novel Shrouding the Heavens (Zhe Tian). He is one of the Twin Kings of the Central Region. He ambushed Jiang Taixu in an attempt to prevent his resurrection and tried to seize the Hengyu Furnace. In the end, he was killed by Jiang Taixu.
characters.appearance:
The Sovereign King of the Eventide is a figure who truly shakes the cultivation world, not only because of his power that surpasses logic, but also because of his appearance that depicts the depths of the night, mystery, and a calm yet deadly death.

Here is a general description of the Sovereign King of the Eventide’s appearance:

When he appears, night seems to descend prematurely. The sky darkens, and the temperature drops sharply.

His presence carries the pressure of the Great Dao—suffocating, making all beings around him feel small and crushed by the will of heaven.

Silent yet gripping—he is not the type to talk much or be explosive, but his every word and step makes people’s hearts race.

He wears a long, dark purple or jet-black night robe, which seems to absorb light.

His robe is embroidered with patterns of stars and crescent moons, depicting his authority over the night and mystery.

Long, dark silver or bluish-black hair, often left loose, fluttering like the night currents.'

His skin was pale and cold, but not weak—it had an eternal dead aura, like someone who had crossed the boundary between life and death.

His eyes were dark gray or dim purple, like a moonless night—sharp, full of hatred, yet calm as if they held hundreds of years of calculation.
characters.personality: The Sovereign King of the Eventide has a deep, complex, and shadowy personality. He is not a figure who moves only by power, but rather a figure driven by revenge, ambition, and thousands of years of solitude.
characters.history:
The older brother of the Twin Kings. Once the brightest and most aggressive figure, known for his incredible power that burned like the sun. Its power and aura symbolize explosive energy, dominance, and daytime majesty.

He once dueled Jiang Taixu in one of the most devastating battles in history, and was ultimately killed by Jiang Taixu with a devastating blow that destroyed his body and soul. It was this death that ignited a deep grudge in his younger brother's heart.

Younger brother, but no less strong and much cooler, more patient and calculating. Symbolizing night, emptiness, and deadly silence.

Hiding in the shadows for over 4,000 years, preparing revenge and devising plans to seize the Eternal Universe Furnace.

Not only hunting Jiang Taixu to avenge his brother, but also has a great ambition to become the absolute ruler of the cultivation world.

Using the mysterious extreme Holy Weapon and even the Thearch array pattern to fight against Jiang Taixu's supreme power.

Back when they were still together, the Twin Kings were called an invincible duo.

They swept across many lands, and only a few cultivators throughout history were able to rival them.

The combination of the sun and the dusk created complementary forces: light and dark, heat and cold, day and night.
characters.quotes:
— The Sovereign of the Eventide sneered.

— The Sovereign of the Eventide snorted and said.

Sovereign Ling, who held the title of Spiritual God, was a past Spiritual Emperor. He was a sacred spirit, but he wasn't a stone man who had attained the dao, but rather flesh and blood formed from waves of innate spiritual essence.

characters.title: Sovereign Qilin
characters.introText: Sovereign Qilin more commonly known as the Qilin Ancient Emperor (麒麟古皇), was one of the greatest rulers of the Supreme Ancient Era (太古时代) in Shrouding the Heavens. He belonged to the divine Qilin race, one of the most noble and auspicious races in the universe.
characters.appearance:
The Qilin Ancient Emperor is described as possessing:

Majestic imperial aura.

Auspicious multicolored divine light.

The bloodline of a divine Qilin.

Supreme combat prowess.

Boundless vitality and wisdom.

Like other Ancient Emperors, his mere presence was enough to make Saints and Great Sages tremble.
characters.personality: Benevolence, prosperity, and auspiciousness
characters.history:
He belonged to the divine Qilin race, one of the most noble and auspicious races in the universe. He attained enlightenment during the Primordial Era and became an Ancient Emperor, suppressing the heavens and ruling over the myriad races. His descendants later established the powerful Qilin Cave (麒麟窟), one of the royal clans among the Primordial races.

Despite belonging to the Primordial races, the Qilin Ancient Emperor was regarded as one of the more noble and righteous Ancient Emperors. His descendants, particularly Huo Lin'er and Huo Qizi, maintained relatively friendly relations with Ye Fan and played important roles in the later events of Shrouding the Heavens .

The second supreme being who rose from corpse to emperor, he was the supreme being of the chaotic ancient times before his death>.
characters.appearance: A large man with a dragon beard
characters.personality:
Ye Fan clashed with the forbidden area in the Northern Dipper, fighting against the dark supreme beings who were experts from the forbidden land of the sacred ruins, the tomb of immortals, and the mine of origin. There, four dark supreme beings who emerged from the forbidden land of life surrounded him. One of them was Sovereign Shi.

In this cultivation realm, he can slaughtered the heavens, believing himself to be the sole ruler. Under normal circumstances, he would not treat others with the slightest courtesy. However, when faced with Ye Fan, he took the initiative to announce his name, demonstrating the respect and concern he felt for Ye Fan.
characters.history:
His origins are extremely strange. He was the second person in this world to transform from a corpse into a living body, ultimately achieving the Dao and becoming an emperor. He is extremely powerful.

It is rumored that he was dug up by someone from the depths of the Underworld. As for which era he came from, it is impossible to say for certain. There is an ancient monument accompanying him, and based on the characters on it, it should be a corpse from the Chaotic Ancient Era.

characters.appearance:
Appearance: Once colossal in stature, now a towering skeletal figure half-wrapped in decayed royal armor. His body glows with necrotic runes, and tattered royal robes drift like ethereal shadows.

Aura: A chilling aura of death—wherever he steps, life simmers and rots. Breathing slows around him; plants wither, stars dim.
characters.history:
Role: Ruler of Taichu Ancient Mine, former giant from the Underworld, and overlord of underworld denizens.

Rank: Third known Dark Supreme Being to rise from actual death into dominion—after Bù Sǐ and Emperor Zūn.

Power Span: Once supreme in the Chaotic Ancient Era, commanding armies of dead and primeval undead.

His mysterious master is Duan De—who triggered deep fear in Shī due to his reincarnation potential.
Shī believed Duan De might enslave him in future reincarnations.

In his fear, Shī released the reincarnation seal embedded in his body—crippling his power and rendering him vulnerable.
characters.trivia:
His reincarnation seal was inscribed in his ribcage—the seal’s glyphs glow when he fears loss of autonomy.

Rumor claims he once ascended briefly as a Quasi-Emperor before succumbing fully to corruption.

In death, a single fragment of his skull remained lit with necrotic qi—some cults believe the skull still hums with massacre grief.

characters.title: Tai Chu
characters.introText: It refers to the earliest imaginable point of existence, often before time, space, or form—a mythic moment of creation.
characters.history:
In a mythical place called the Impregnable Path , Ye Fan and his entourage arrived at the entrance to the Emperor's Road , the most difficult and sacred place on the path to True Immortality . This road was not opened randomly, but rather waited for a sufficient number of Emperor candidates from various races to gather. Before the gate opens, a giant crystal monument appears, where the candidates leave their names and body imprints as proof that they have arrived and are worthy of entering the Path of Heaven.

On the monument, 53 names were engraved , including those of legendary figures and some familiar to Ye Fan and his companions. The first name that appeared was "Absolute Beginning," indicating a mysterious, powerful figure who likely came from a realm connected to the secrets of the cosmos. These characters come from various races and backgrounds, including Yin Tiande , Golden Cicada , and even  the White-Robed God King (Jiang Taixu) . A surprise also comes from Dongfang Taiyi , the Demonic Elder who has appeared in humorous and terrifying stories in the past.
characters.trivia: "Absolute Beginning / 太初" literally means absolute beginning , is also the name of an era in the Han Dynasty, and in Daoist philosophy means the initial stage before all creation — highly symbolic and philosophical.

He was once close to becoming a Quasi-Emperor, but his breakthrough was interrupted by the Holy Prince. Since then, he has hunted the Holy Prince throughout the universe, even killing those associated with him, in an attempt to force him out of hiding.

characters.history:
Ye Fan met QI Luo in the Heavenly City. The place that Qi Luo chose was very beautiful. It was suspended in the sky, an ancient watchtower connected to each other. It was built with five-colored jade. Rumor has it that it was supported by the Southern Mountains Demon Imperial Palace. Qi Luo said, I want to see how you will perform under the siege of so many young elites. Don’t lower the prestige of the Heavenly Court.  After Qi Luo finished saying this, Killing intent soared into the sky in all directions. Qi pillars pierced through the sky and earth. Blood energy covered the sun and poured down. Dozens to a hundred great experts surrounded the ancient watchtower.

This is the test that Qi Luo gave Ye Fan, he spread the news about Ye fan, then Ye Fan's haters came one by one to kill him. Most of them came from the Archaic Immemorial Races, such as Lu Dongfa, Niu yi, Yue Qianqiu and experts from various races. Ye fan had been surrounded, he immediately started his fight with the six reincarnation fists he flew, splitting the sky and cutting everything in his way! He blocked Lu Dongfa of the Heavenly Feather Race, forced back Niu Yi of the Demon Bull Race, and then quickly killed the four great experts. Suddenly, the huge silver foot emitted a nebula-like light. It shook violently. Meanwhile, Ye Fan's feet also emitted endless light, the sky and earth became a dazzling expanse. Many people flew out like pieces of paper. The person who came was Yue Qianqiu, wearing the Silver Moon Clan's Wind and Cloud Battle Boots. Not finished with Yue Qian Qiu, suddenly he was attacked by the Goddess of the Underworld.

Ye fan fought from right to left, from top to bottom. He finally defeated them one by one, some were killed and some were injured. Then he broke through his way out. Goddess of Underworld Severely Injured, Yue Qianque was trampled to death by Ye Fan.

characters.title: Tu Fei
characters.introText: You should have tender feelings for the fairer sex.
characters.appearance: A young man of about twenty years of age. He wasn't very handsome, but his eyes were particularly bright. They were like the legendary 'thieving light'.
characters.history:
He meet Ye Fan in the Yao Guang fifteenth mine. They dig up some good Origin Stones togeher. When the two of them retreated from the stone tower. Ye Fan was about to leave when Tu Fei suddenly pulled him back and said, "Wait, there's something on you. Why do I feel a familiar aura?"

I'm really not a professional. I don't have anything special on me. "Wait, this is ...... the aura of the Wavering Light Sacred Maiden!" Tu Fei eyes shone like pearls as he stared at Ye Fan and said, Brother, you're really not simple. You're even more agile than me. You can even steal something from the Sacred Maiden of Wavering Light. I once came close to the Sacred Maiden of Wavering Light. The best of us have photographic memories. This is her aura, I can't be wrong. The young man had no animosity towards Ye Fan. Instead, he acted very familiar and said, Take it out and let me have a look. Ye Fan guessed that it was definitely the Wavering Light Sacred Maiden's bra. He immediately pulled out the Pristine Jade Bottle and put it inside. Oh my God, my heavenly eyes are blinded! Tu Fei saw it clearly and immediately cried out in surprise. He said, I tell you, brother, you're good. You're really good. When did our profession produce a talent like you? I admire you to death. I've dreamed of doing this. It's true that we're not in the same business. I got this by chance. Ye Fan felt that it was too dangerous to go with this man. If he provoked Yao Xi, there would be big trouble. He wanted to get rid of him. I admire you so much. In our trade, we emphasise getting something by chance. We don't have to do it on purpose.

Ye Fan killed Yao Guang member and the eight true disciples of the Ji family in front of the young cultivators of Qu State. The news seemed to develop rapidly and spread quickly, causing an uproar. Tu Fei smiled and said, "You're famous in the area around Qu Prefecture. All the cultivators are talking about you. If you make a fuss next time, I think the news will spread to the Holy City.

Where does the old Dragon Azure King live? Ye Fan asked Tu Fei. It's so far away. Even if we fly at full speed, it will take us more than ten days to get there, Tu Fei replied. The Northern Region is vast. Some sects even needed to fly for a year and a half to get there. Fortunately, the Dragon Azure King did not live that far away. What do you want to do anyway? Tu Fei couldn't believe Ye Fan wanted to visit his old friend. Cloud Lake Oblast is unlike any landscape in the Northern Territory. It is green and full of vitality. Besides trees, there is water. There are springs every hundred steps, and rivers every ten miles. Tall mountains stood tall, and huge waterfalls covered the entire mountain range. It was a vast expanse of white. The endless plains were green and verdant. In addition to the ancient trees towering into the sky, there were huge rivers flowing everywhere. They crossed each other, as if they were dragons splitting the land. Huge lakes are seen everywhere. They were connected together, stretching as far as the eye could see. There are large lakes everywhere, and mist is seen everywhere. This is indeed the homeland.

in devil city tu fei and ye fan met Little Dragon Azure King and little sky roc king. little Sky Roc King clasped his hands behind his back. His golden hair fluttered in the wind, his eyes intimidating. He looked like the only one in the world, exerting strong pressure on people. The entire palace trembled. The Golden Winged Little Roc King looked at everyone with disdain and started moving again. He grabbed the black and yellow cauldrons with unfathomable heavenly strength. Little Dragon Azure King tried to stop them. Tu Fei also came to help.

Finally the fight couldn't be stopped, so they held a fight between Ye Fan and the The Golden Winged Little Roc King where Ye Fan emerged as the winner.

Hei Huang, Li Heisui, Tu Fei and Pang Bo heard Ye Fan making a fuss in the Southern Region of the Eastern Barren, immediately They immediately set off for the Southern Region, Hei Huang drew a formation and they left. But the direction of the teleportation made by Hei Huang was one million miles off making them too late to help Ye Fan.

Arriving in the Southern Region, Ye Fan had cleaned up his own mess, Hua Yunfei had run away with his protector. Ye fan met his friends and told them about his dao wound that had healed and shared the heavenly fruit with them to perfect it, after that ye fan invited them to look for a Xiao nannan.

The Eastern Barren had the word “Barren” in its name because it was vast and uninhabited. Some primitive areas had not been visited by anyone since ancient times. They crossed the void and headed towards the Eternal Mountain in the central region of the Eastern Barren. However, they deviated six million miles and appeared in an uninhabited barren area. If they had not found half a stone tablet on the big mountain, they would not have known where they were. This was the relic of a great sect that had been destroyed in the past.

Tu Fei, Ye Fan and the others entered an ancient city called “Sky Gazing”. This was one of the ten great ancient cities in the central region. The Black Emperor was like an old horse who knew the way. He headed straight for the high platform in the city. “I told you that stupid dog deliberately deviated from the Immortal Mountain. Otherwise, how could he have gone six million miles? He clearly wanted to enter the Sky Gazing City,” Li Heishui said. The ancient city was very large. The central area was not a square, but a large platform. At this time, the sunset was setting, and the entire platform was flashing with red light.

Tu Fei, Ye Fan and others went to the immortal mountain to see the bright spring coming from the sky and ran to the immortal mountain. There the holy lings were fighting with the beasts in front of Mount Adai. Because they were desperate, they finally escaped, but the only way was to enter the immortal mountain. Inside they were trapped, various phenomena appeared. Even the emperor's traces also appeared inside the immortal mountain in front of the ancient tree of enlightenment tea. There were so many trap formations inside the immortal mountain, Hei Huang was unable to bring them out safely, fortunately Xiao Nan Nan could see the true traces of the formation and brought them out of the difficult situation until they found the ancient enlightenment tea tree. This place was the famous Immortal Mountain, and was one of the Seven Great Life Forbidden Areas in the Eastern Barren Territory. Every moment they wasted here meant additional danger.

After taking the enlightenment tea leaves, Xiao Nannan led them away again, the only way was to take them deeper into the depths of the immortal mountain. They had no choice but to continue on their journey. They took a long detour around the Netherworld River and the Yellow Spring Pool. It was an extremely dangerous place, and even though it was a long distance, they could already feel the hairs on the back of their necks standing on end. Only after they had walked a long distance did they let out a long breath. The indescribable sense of oppression finally lessened. After advancing for a few miles, the vegetation had become thinner, and there were more rocks. They had entered a vast area between the rock cliffs. The ground here was dry and hard, and there were only a few ancient trees here and there. This place was extremely dry, and huge rocks were scattered everywhere. They found an ancient cave that had been dug out by some people under the black rock cliff. The marks of knives and axes were clearly visible, and they were carved out by the passage of time.

After advancing for about a dozen kilometers, the black mountain became even more majestic. It was as if they had unknowingly arrived in ancient times, and an ancient aura flowed, causing their hearts to palpitate. After advancing for dozens of kilometers, the black mountain seemed to have reached the peak of the Heavenly World, and its bottom suppressed the Nine Underworlds. It was majestic and terrifying, and there were ancient trees and forests shrouded in black mist. “This Immortal Mountain is truly mysterious. There are so many things: the Nine Hole Stone Man, the Ancient Tree of Understanding the Way, the Netherworld Grass, the Heavenly Tears Green Gold, and now even the Divine Medicine of Longevity has appeared.”

After walking for dozens of miles, they found a giant lake, and there was a stone crocodile stirring up waves in it. It was definitely a terrifying existence. What kind of place was the center of the Immortal Mountain? They were all filled with strong curiosity, but they were well aware that once they approached, they would definitely die. Where is our path to survival? At this moment, they were almost in despair. If they continued forward, they would have to climb over these huge mountains, and enter the center region.

A chessboard filled with golden light… Hei Huang immediately jumped up, and said, “That must be the Gate of Life left behind by the Void Emperor!” Hei Huang quickly studied the chessboard and made them teleport one by one and they ended up in different places because Hei Huang,

Pang Bo was teleported to the central plains continent, and if he flew back alone, it would take at least five to six years. If it was far enough, it might take more than ten years.

Tu fei was teleported to the “Northern Plains continent. The Northern plains was a desolate place with no signs of human habitation for millions of miles. Whether it was the vast grassland or the vast desert. It was possible that you would not see a single person even if you walked for a lifetime.

Only Li Heishui ,Ye Fan, Hei Huang and Xiao Nannan remained in the Central region of the eastern barren continent.

After Tu Fei was teleported to the northern plains by Hei Huang, he was sealed by a powerful person there, until Ye Fan found him ten years later. At that time, Ye Fan also did not have the power to open the seal, because it was guarded by someone in the Great Saint realm. Since then, Tu Fei has disappeared from Beidou until an undetermined time.

characters.title: Tuoba Chang
characters.introText: Tuoba Chang is  a character from the Chinese xianxia novel Shrouding the Heavens (遮天). He is the talented heir of the Tuoba clan, one of the Four Great Source Technique families of the Northern Region. Renowned as a prodigy in Source Techniques, he gained fame in the Sacred City through his exceptional stone-gambling and stone-cutting abilities.
characters.personality:
Elegant and handsome antagonist

Extremely competitive

Proud of his noble family heritage

Strong desire to protect family honor
characters.history:
During the Sacred City arc, Tuoba Chang became one of Ye Fan’s primary rivals. Ye Fan, who was operating under the alias Gu Feng, repeatedly confronted him at the Ji Family Stone Workshop. Their competitions involved selecting source stones, sensing their internal structures, and cutting them open. The high level of skill displayed by both participants astonished the gathered cultivators and established Tuoba Chang as a formidable opponent.

Tuoba Chang’s mastery of Source Techniques was widely regarded as comparable to that of Gu Feng. However, his reputation was controversial, as he was known to strengthen himself by seizing and assimilating the Source Technique attainments of other practitioners. Because of this, many cultivators viewed him as an antagonist despite acknowledging his talent.

In their stone-gambling confrontations, Tuoba Chang demonstrated remarkable skill. He selected a Dragon-Head Stone and successfully extracted rare treasures such as a Dragon-Qi Stone Bead and a Human-Head Divine Source. Later, while competing with Ye Fan for a stone believed to be the “Stone King,” he uncovered a valuable divine source. Nevertheless, Ye Fan surpassed him by cutting open a divine source containing a sealed living being, shocking everyone present and overturning the result.

Tuoba Chang later appeared as Ye Fan’s opponent in the Source Technique Tournament. Proud of his aristocratic lineage and determined to uphold his family’s honor, he clashed repeatedly with Ye Fan both verbally and technically. Despite his ability and confidence, he was ultimately defeated by Ye Fan, allowing the latter to advance to the finals.

Although portrayed as a handsome and elegant antagonist, Tuoba Chang is characterized by intense competitiveness and a strong sense of pride in his family heritage. His confrontations with Ye Fan remain one of the most memorable rivalries in the Sacred City storyline, showcasing some of the highest-level Source Technique battles in the early portion of the novel.

characters.title: Undying Daoist
characters.introText: The Undying Daoist is one of the most sinister and enigmatic figures in Shrouding the Heavens. Originating from the mysterious Undying Mountain, he is an ancient being whose physical body decayed long ago, leaving only a powerful primordial spirit preserved within Immortal Source. Though he presents himself with the calm demeanor of a wandering Daoist, his true nature is far darker: he is one of  the hidden mastermind behind the Dark Turmoils, a catastrophe that spanned eras and claimed countless lives. Suppressed by the Unrivaled Emperor Wu Shi using the legendary by the Investiture of the Gods, he remained sealed for ages until the events of the story brought him into contact with Ye Fan and his companions. Ultimately, his long‑preserved spirit met its end at the Immortal Ascension Road, where he was sacrificed and perished completely.
characters.personality:
The Undying Daoist presents himself as a serene, compassionate wanderer, speaking softly and carrying the air of an ancient sage. However, this outward demeanor conceals a deeply manipulative and malevolent nature. His calmness is a mask for cold calculation; his gentle tone hides a mind capable of orchestrating catastrophes across epochs.

He is patient, cunning, and willing to wait countless ages to achieve his goals. His ability to maintain a façade of benevolence even while plotting destruction makes him one of the most unsettling figures in the story. Unlike righteous emperors who act for the sake of all beings, the Undying Daoist acts solely for himself, driven by ambition, obsession, and a distorted pursuit of immortality.

Despite his decayed state, he retains a sense of superiority and detachment, viewing others as tools or sacrifices. His personality is a chilling blend of ancient wisdom, false serenity, and hidden malice.
characters.history:
The Undying Daoist’s origins lie in the depths of Undying Mountain, a place shrouded in ancient secrets and forbidden power. In a distant era, he rose to prominence as a terrifying cultivator whose ambitions and methods defied the natural order. At some point in his long existence, his physical body decayed and returned to dust, yet his primordial spirit endured, preserved within a block of Immortal Source. This allowed him to survive far beyond the lifespan of any ordinary being, continuing to influence the world from the shadows.

His involvement in the Dark Turmoils marked him as one of the most dangerous figures in history. Acting from behind the scenes, he orchestrated chaos across star domains, manipulating events that led to widespread destruction. Recognizing the threat he posed, the Unrivaled Emperor (Wúshǐ Dàdì) confronted him. Though even the Emperor could not fully annihilate him, he suppressed the Undying Daoist using the Investiture of the Gods , sealing his primordial spirit deep within the Sacred Cliff.

Ages later, Ye Fan, the Black Dog, the Old Madman, and Little Nannan encountered him at the Sacred Cliff. Appearing as a frail, ancient Daoist with a decayed crown and tattered robes, he spoke with a tone of false compassion, masking his true identity. Eventually, his role as the architect of the Dark Turmoil was revealed.

After countless years of imprisonment, the Undying Daoist was finally brought to the Immortal Ascension Road, where he was used as a living sacrifice. There, his primordial spirit was extinguished, ending his long and destructive existence.

Used by immortals, sects, and cultivators of all races.

Served as a universal spiritual manual for aligning with the Dao.

Represents the power of order and pattern within the Dao.

Enables understanding and harnessing the flow of cosmic cycles, fate, and spiritual dynamics.

In rituals, it signifies the ability to:
Measure, align, and adjust spiritual energies.

Calculate auspicious moments.

Maintain balance between Heaven, Earth, and Man.

✅ Dào Dé Tiānzūn: The embodiment of Dao and Virtue, creator of the timeless Dao Scripture.

✅ Created the third of the Nine Secrets, 数 ("Shù"), representing order, calculation, and the harmonious structure of the universe.

✅ His teachings have been a beacon across ages and races, especially in turbulent epochs like the Post-Barren Era.

characters.title: Void Great Emperor
characters.introText: Void Great Emperor is male a character in the novel Shrouding the Heavens (Covering the Sky) by Chen Dong. Also known as Void and Xuanyuan, he attained enlightenment through the infinite void, mastering the ultimate limits of space.
characters.appearance: He looked utterly ordinary at first glance, of medium build, with average features and nothing particularly handsome or striking about him. Yet this plainness carried a quiet, steady warmth that made others feel at ease. His calm, reserved demeanor gave him an air of natural simplicity, a grounded authenticity that felt genuine rather than dull. Even after ascending to the level of a Great Emperor, his appearance remained mundane and unremarkable, his body returning to an everyday normalcy after surviving countless tribulations. In his later years he appeared youthful, with flowing white hair, but still bore that approachable, trustworthy face, humble, simple, and quietly extraordinary in its very lack of grandeur. Beneath that unassuming exterior, however, lay a subtle aura of transcendence, a depth that hinted at the unimaginable power hidden within such simplicity.
characters.personality:
'The Void Emperor was steadfast, fearless, modest, and silent ,  a man of few words whose actions spoke louder than any declaration. Deeply dutiful and unyieldingly resolute, he lived by the creed “一生不弱于人” (a lifetime never inferior to anyone / never bowing to others), embodying unbreakable will and self‑sacrifice. Heavy with responsibility and loyalty to his race, he chose to shoulder burdens that would have crushed lesser beings, fighting endless battles alone for humanity’s survival rather than seeking personal glory, immortality, or a second life despite having the means.

Quiet in confidence yet never arrogant, he faced every threat ,  ancient Supremes, dark turmoils, extraterrestrial invaders ,  without retreat. Even with overwhelming power, he remained humble and composed, preferring silence and action over praise or recognition. His sense of duty ran so deep that even in death he continued to stand as a shield for all living beings, sacrificing everything, including his own legacy, for the sake of others.

Tragic yet dignified, selfless yet unwavering, he became one of the most respected ,  and most “苦” (bitter, burdened, tragic) ,  emperors in the series, a figure defined not by dominance, but by the immense weight he chose to carry for the world.
characters.history:
The Void Great Emperor was the founder of the 荒古 Ji Family, one of the ancient aristocratic clans of the Eastern Wilderness on the North Dipper/Beidou star. Born into one of humanity’s darkest eras ,  after the last accomplished Saint Physique fell at Saint Cliff ,  he rose through sheer perseverance, lacking the exceptional innate talent or peerless physiques possessed by other emperors. Through the Void Scripture (虚空经), he forged his path to the Great Emperor realm, mastering the dao of boundless void and space, becoming nearly unbeatable in positional warfare, evasion, and spatial dominance.

His age was plagued by active Forbidden Zones (生命禁区), where ancient Supremes awakened to harvest life for longevity, triggering repeated Dark Turmoils (黑暗动乱). In this era of despair, he stood alone as humanity’s shield. He quelled multiple turmoils single‑handedly, suppressed Undying Mountain (不死山), battled invading gods from beyond the domains (域外诸神), and protected the human race when no other great powers remained. He left behind the Void Mirror (虚空镜) ,  the Ji family’s ultimate imperial weapon ,  and the Void Scripture as his legacy.

In his twilight years, even with immortality medicine in hand, he refused a second life, choosing instead to preserve hope for future generations. He feigned death to lure two Supremes of Undying Mountain into mutual destruction, sacrificing himself to buy humanity precious time. After his passing, his body was placed within a nine‑layered coffin and set adrift through the cosmos with no grave ,  his obsession with protecting humanity continuing even in death.

His life and legacy are remembered as one of the most tragic yet honorable among all emperors, perfectly captured in the line: “虚空一生，不弱于人” :  A life in the void, never inferior to anyone.

His black hair was loose, his face was sharp, and his eyebrows reached his temples. There were countless stars in his eyes, making him look unfathomable. characters.personality: He is a very strong and tough person, with a dominant attitude he suppresses people of the same generation and can even suppress people at the holy lord level with enormous power.
characters.history: Wang Teng was called the Northern Emperor by the young heroes of the five regions. The Northern Emperor used to travel between the Northern Plains and the Eastern Wasteland under the name of the Wolf God. At the age of fifteen, he was already unrivaled. After ten years of accumulation, no one knew what level he had reached. Moreover, everyone knew that he had the destiny of the world and even obtained nine secrets. After entering the Qishi Residence, no one dared to oppose him. He also remained in seclusion and rarely appeared. Even when he went out, he would only go to the seclusion area behind his residence.
characters.trivia:
Wang teng survived ten heavenly tribulations.

He once entered the Eastern Wasteland and took an ancient creature as his servant

Wang teng sent Wu Guli, and Jin Wu Duo to kill Ye Fan. One of them was three meters tall, and his entire body was covered in silver scales. He had four arms and was full of power. His silver hair covered his shoulders, and there was a vertical eye in the middle of his eyebrows. The other was two meters tall, and his entire body shone with golden light. He had a pair of golden divine wings, and every inch of his body was covered in golden scales. Among his golden hair, there was a pair of horns.

When in the ji family, wang teng received the inheritance of the void. The inheritance was not the inheritance of the void emperor, but a fragment of a weapon from his enemy that penetrated the body of the void emperor at that time.

This name implies great power and cosmic reach . He is not simply a ruler of the mortal world, but someone destined to touch the heavenly order and rule the universe.
characters.history:
Amidst the increasingly heated situation on the Ancient Road of the Human Race , Wang Tianyu , a powerful and influential old figure, accused Ye Fan of secretly killing young geniuses and devouring their flesh and blood. The accusation was extremely serious, as it involved a dark, demonic cultivation practice that was highly condemned. Ye Fan firmly denied the accusations , and some of his allies such as Longma and Ji Ziyue defended him, claiming that the accusations were malicious and baseless slander.

However, the atmosphere worsened when two high-ranking law enforcers from the Ancient Road—wearing Daluo Silver Essence Battle Armor —arrived with extremely solemn and imposing manners. Their arrival signaled that the senior figures of the Ancient Road might truly want to take down Ye Fan , under the pretext of upholding justice. Ye Fan realized that this was no longer a simple fight, but a massive conspiracy being orchestrated by powerful forces targeting him directly, even without any solid evidence. Pang Bo advised them to prepare to flee, as they would not be given a fair trial.

There are too many things left for them to reminisce about. Old friends, old events, scenes after scenes. Now, they find that the deepest memories in their hearts are the other side of the starry sky and not the beautiful scenery on this side.

He was very experienced in dealing with others, but at this moment, his words were a little shaky and he was very emotional. Adrift alone in a foreign land, he struggled alone on this ancient star. characters.history:
Ye Fan roared. In front of the great tombs, piece after piece of heavenly essence flowed with heavenly splendor. Everyone opened their eyes. Their old eyes were cloudy, filled with tears, all trembling with excitement. At this moment, there was no need to say anything else. The Heavenly Emperor had come to fulfill his promise. A melodious war song was sung. The path to conquering immortals had begun!

The army was vast and majestic. Several old friends rushed over, all of whom were personally sealed by Ye Fan back then. For example, Pang Bo, Zhang Wenchang, Zhang Ziling, Tu Fei, Li Heishui, Dongfang Ye, Li Tian, ​​​​and Yan Yixi. There were also Dragon Horse, Wang Shu, Lei Bo, Ji Chengdao, Little Que’er, and Xia Jiuyou.They led various departments in the Heavenly Court. Among them, Ji Haoyue, Li Ruoyu, and the others had become emperors during the last tribulation. They would conquer the road together.

The people of the past did not die and all reappeared. In addition, there were other old friends who also rushed over, such as  Wei Wei Wavy Light God, Huo Lin’er, Huo Qi Zi, and others.

characters.introText: Wei Yi is a legendary figure who holds the status of the Hidden Great Sage of humanity, someone who rarely appears, but once he makes a move, changes the course of history. His appearance is inconspicuous, almost like an ordinary old man—yet his aura makes even Saints tremble.
characters.appearance:
Wei Yi is a legendary figure who holds the status of the Hidden Great Sage of humanity, someone who rarely appears, but once he makes a move, changes the course of history. His appearance is inconspicuous, almost like an ordinary old man—yet his aura makes even Saints tremble.

Age: Aged, decrepit, like a hermit who has gone through tens of thousands of seasons.

Hair: Long, completely white, hanging down his shoulders like ancient snow.

Face: Cold and calm, full of wrinkles, yet his eyes hold an inscrutable Dao light.

Posture: Body slightly hunched, as if time has weighed him down—yet when standing upright, he is like a heavenly pillar supporting the universe.

Clothing: A dull gray robe of coarse material, without any ornaments or symbols of splendor. But when viewed with the eyes of the Dao, the robe contains the pattern of an ancient heaven-earth formation that is alive.
characters.personality: Wei Yi was a figure who reflected true strength in silence—a humble Great Sage, preferring to hide behind the curtain of the world, watching everything calmly and patiently.
characters.history: He was one of the three heroes of Jade Holy Land at that time, the youngest brother of the Old madman.

characters.title: Wu Shi
characters.introText: Wu Shi is the son of the Western Empress and Great Accomplished Sacred Body one of the most powerful Great Emperors in history, a supreme figure from Covering the Sky. Born with the rare Innate Sacred Body Dao Embryo, he rose during the Desolate Ancient Age to become its final human emperor, dominating an entire era with absolute invincibility. Known for his overwhelming strength and unmatched presence, he suppressed forbidden zones, quelled dark turmoil, and stood unrivaled across the nine heavens and ten earths. Unlike other emperors, his path was defined by complete dominance, with no equal ever able to challenge him, earning him the legendary praise: “At the end of the immortal path, who stands at the peak? A single glance at Wushi makes the Dao itself seem empty.”
characters.appearance: He looked to be in his twenties, with thick black hair and eyes full of wisdom that seemed able to pierce through everything. His heroic bearing was awe-inspiring; with every gesture, the myriad laws of heaven and earth trembled and wailed before him. His presence was unmatched in all the world.
characters.personality: Emperor Wushi possesses a personality defined by absolute dominance, quiet detachment, and profound inner solitude. Outwardly, he embodies supreme confidence and unwavering authority, an existence so powerful that he never doubts victory, facing all enemies with calm inevitability rather than struggle. Yet beneath this invincible exterior lies a deeply restrained and introspective nature: he is not arrogant in a loud or reckless way, but instead distant, almost indifferent, as if ordinary emotions and conflicts no longer reach him. His magnanimity is evident in how he treats even defeated foes with dignity, reflecting a ruler above petty concerns. At the same time, his life is marked by loneliness and unfulfilled desires, his inability to revive his parents or respond to those who loved him reveals a quiet sorrow he never expresses. This duality makes him both godlike and human: an unparalleled emperor who stands above all beings, yet ultimately turns his back on the world, carrying a silent burden that no one else can share
characters.history: In the eyes of the world, Wu Shi is a god and omnipotent. He has intimidated all races, suppressed the seven forbidden zones, wiped out the gods of the outer realm, and swept the entire world. He is invincible in heaven and earth, feared by everyone since ancient times.
characters.trivia:
Wu Shi Great Emperor (无始大帝) was the first and fastest among the Three Heavenly Emperors — Ye Fan, Ruthless Empress, and himself — to break through to the Immortal Emperor' realm

He never suffered a single defeat, hence the saying, "At the end of the immortal path, who stands at the peak? Upon seeing Emperor Wu shi, all paths become empty."

As the last human emperor of the ancient era, Emperor Wushi was the first innate holy body Dao embryo in history, achieving Dao in just 500 years, becoming the fastest emperor to attain Dao in recorded history.
characters.quotes:
"I stand alone at the peak of the clouds, as vast as the ocean yet as insignificant as a speck of dust!"
― Wushi

characters.title: Wu Ziming
characters.introText: Wu Ziming is an important supporting character in the Chinese xianxia novel Shrouding the Heavens (遮天). He holds dual status as the senior disciple of the Five Elements Palace and the young master of the Wu Family of the Sacred City. Due to both his sect background and noble lineage, he frequently appears in social and political gatherings among cultivators.
characters.history:
He first appears at the Shaking Light Holy Land stone workshop, where he represents the Five Elements Palace together with Li Chongtian of the Illusionary Destruction Palace to welcome the Holy Maiden Weiwei. During this meeting, the two are overwhelmed by the imposing aura of Shaking Light disciples Nangong Man and Wen Yuan, placing them in an awkward and disadvantageous position.

Later, at the Dao-Yi Stone Workshop, Wu Ziming participates in a stone-gambling event. After Hun Tuo cuts open a stone and obtains a divine medicine, even consuming it on the spot, Wu Ziming becomes dissatisfied and believes such actions will attract hostility from many factions. Soon afterward, he gambles against Ye Fan over the Nine-Orifice Stone Man. He loses the wager and is forced to pay Ye Fan one hundred thousand jin of source, suffering a significant financial and reputational loss.

Wu Ziming also encounters Ye Xuan at the Miaoyu Nunnery. Recognizing the danger of exposing Ye Xuan’s identity, he advises him to change his name to avoid trouble and even assists him in attempting to enter the nunnery. Ye Xuan ultimately refuses due to his own concerns and leaves, but the event demonstrates Wu Ziming’s social skills and diplomatic awareness as the young master of the Sacred City Wu Family.

Although not a primary antagonist, Wu Ziming is portrayed as a well-connected aristocratic cultivator who values reputation and influence. His appearances help illustrate the complex social networks, sect relations, and power dynamics among the younger generation in the Sacred City storyline

characters.title: Wukong
characters.introText: Wukong is The younger brother of the Fighting Emperor.
characters.appearance: When the world shook, as the six extreme weapons clashed. Somewhere in the Western Desert, inside an ancient temple, a sacred monkey wearing a kasaya opened the door of a dilapidated temple that had been sealed for a thousand years. He walked towards the edge of the cliff, lost in thought as he gazed towards the Central Continent.
characters.personality:
The battle between the Sacred Ape Prince and the Heavenly Prince has ended. The Heavenly Prince died, and his generals wanted to avenge his death, but the Divine Silkworm Princess came to help the Sacred Prince's group. Both sides refused to give in, so the Silver Moon Heavenly King took action to kill the Sacred Prince's group. Suddenly, Victorius Fighting Buddha came and destroyed the Silver Moon Heavenly King.

Kun Zhou and the victorious Fighting Buddha entered the battlefield, but Kun Zhou had no intention of fighting alone, he also brought another great sage. In outer space, an intense battle between great sages took place, one by one the great sages on the Kun Zhou side came out, there were a total of three great sages fighting the Victorious Fighting Buddha, and each of them held an emperor weapon. In outer space, an intense battle between great sages took place, finally another great sage on the Kun Zhou side came out, there were a total of two great sages fighting Victorious Fighting Buddha, and each of them held an emperor weapon. The heavenly technique turned into a misty rain. Victorious Fighting Buddha fought Kun Zhou and the Golden King alone. Even the stars trembled. The battle had reached the climax. Just when they thought Victorious Fighting Buddha would lose, suddenly a change in the atmosphere occurred, the imperial aura was Shrouding the heaven. Victorious Fighting Buddha appears with his two clones and each of them controls an emperor weapon. Black Divine Metal, Demon Subduing Pestle, and Heavenly Silkworm Armor.

In this battle, Kun Zhou's body and soul were split apart. His injuries were extremely serious, and they were great dao scars that were difficult to heal. They were blasted by ancient imperial weapons. The overall situation was set. The holy war was about to end. Towards the end of the battle, three golden Sacred Ape surrounded Kun Zhou and the Golden King. When they were both about to be killed, Sage Huntuo came to intervene with the aim of bringing peace. Then another great sage also came and apologized for lending the emperor's weapon to Kun Zhou. Almost all the Great Sages of the ancient race had arrived. They stood on the extraterritorial battlefield, begging Victorious Fighting Buddha to let the two of them go.

The Great Sage Kun Zhou was killed, and the Great Sage of the Golden Tribe was released.

Eight heavenly generals were killed, Sage Kun Zhou's disciple "Heavenly King Silver Moon" was killed.

All of Great Sage Kun Zhou's subordinates were Killed. No one survived.

Before leaving, he also reminded the ancient kings not to attack his nephew's friends, this was directed at Ye Fan and Ji Zi.
characters.history:
Wukong comes from the era of the Battle Saint Ape Emperor. He is the younger brother of the Emperor. He grew up under the guidance of his elder brother and his cultivation was extremely high! Back then, he was fearless and could rampage through the world. His cultivation level was comparable to that of a Saint Emperor at the same age and he had killed many powerful beings. After the ancient race came out, they all went to the ancient land of the Battle Saint Ape lineage to search for the battle emperor weapon. They did not sense the aura of the Emperor weapon. Many people suspected that it had been taken by his younger brother.

Millions of years ago he was sealed with his nephew, Battle Saint Ape Junior, the son of the emperor. He woke up first, two thousand years before the Sacred Ape woke up from the divine source, reappearing in this world. He is currently in the western desert, just at the time of the flourishing era. After he climbed Mount Meru and entered the Buddhist Sect, his dharma name was Wukong.

After the Valley of the Gods was destroyed by Ye Fan and Zhang Lin, the warrior Buddha sent someone to deliver a letter. A Buddha child from the Western Desert crossed the Central Continent and entered the Eastern Desert. Finally, he came to the Northern Region and brought a decree. “Peace under the sky.” There were only these four words, bold and powerful. The moment it was opened, the heavenly dao rumbled. The heavenly voice descended from the sky and the light of the dao flowed into the sky. It was as if a group of ancient Buddhas were chanting. Their voices resounded throughout the world, shocking everyone.

characters.title: Xi Moti
characters.introText: The name "Xi Moti" in the Hindu context has no direct or common meaning.
characters.history:
Ye fan met some monks who could cultivate, then he asked them to bring his teacher here. A few days later Xi Moti, the teacher of the monks, came to see Ye fan. After meeting Ye Fan had many questions regarding the earth and ancient religions of the past. According to Xi Moti In ancient times, there were many great sects and ancient sects. Experts were as numerous as clouds, and there was no shortage of great divine abilities. However, things have changed now.

Xi Moti talked a lot about the orthodoxy of the ancient times. He said that the many inheritances were like a hundred flowers blooming, competing with each other in beauty and experts standing in great numbers. Later, everything declined. The temple he was in happened to suffer a great calamity and lost most of its Dharma. He was completely marginalized and lost contact with the various sects of the past. In this era, he did not even know if the various sects still existed. He only knew a few people who knew about cultivation, but he felt that the various sects should still exist. It was just that they were in the Last Days and all of them were hiding themselves from the world.

To be honest, Ye Fan was not very interested in ancient India. He wanted to know more about the various religions of ancient China. Xi Moti explained to him “Middle Earth is unfathomable, he also does not know much.” He respected Middle Earth from the bottom of his heart and did not understand Taoism. He had never met anyone from this sect. He had only heard about the demons in Middle Earth from the elders and did not understand much. The only thing he had personally experienced was the demon god. It made him tremble and he only caught a glimpse of it from afar. He did not dare to approach and immediately retreated. According to Xi Moti, the waters of Middle Earth were very deep. The demon god was just one example. He had heard the senior monk say that he had encountered other terrifying existences but he did not know much.

Finally they set off and took the small stone Buddha to the Tibetan area. They wanted to open the way to Spirited Mountain. At Spirited Mountain they found an ancient temple. It was not very big and only had a stone hall. An old monk died in a sitting position. He also left his last words.

She was very handsome and could be called a handsome young man.

characters.history:
The autumn wind blew, ruffling the yellow leaves and shaking the mountains. The northern region was a land of extreme cold. The four seasons alternated, and autumn and winter were long. Half a year, there was no sign of life, and the weather was dry and cold. The Disorderly Cloud State had endless mountains that stretched endlessly. There was not a single piece of flat land, and its tall peaks pierced the sky. That was also the reason for its name. The Disorderly Cloud State was an eleven to twelve day journey from the northern region of the Holy City. It was separated from the Fire Cloud State by an oasis and two reddish-brown deserts. This is the place that Ye Fan chose as a place to trap his pursuers in order to get resources.

Although Mountain Rock City was located in the middle of the mountains, it was the central city of the Disorderly Cloud State. There were mountains everywhere, so there was no flat land to build a city. The city was not magnificent. The streets were paved with mountain rocks, and the trees on both sides of the ancient road were almost bare. Yellow leaves fluttered in the air, indicating the coldness of autumn.

Xia Jiuyou came to the restaurant with two old men following behind her. They were dressed in gray and looked very old. Their backs were hunched, and they looked like two loyal old servants. She refuted their conversation about the ancient sacred body. Everyone looked surprised, thinking that the young man might indeed come from a holy land lineage. The Eastern Barren Territory was boundless, and there were many extraordinary people deep in the mountains and rivers. Not all experts were in the holy land. But Xia Jiuyou spoke as if she had no fear. Xia Jiuyou's arrogance made Tu Fei angry. He challenged Xia Jiuyou to a soul fight, and asked Ye Fan to fight him. The soul fight began between Ye Fan and Xia Jiuyou. In the middle of the fight, a gray-clothed elder behind Xia Jiuyou suddenly stopped them. After this battle, Xia Jiuyou's expression eased a little. She no longer threatened to expel everyone.
characters.trivia: She wants to capture Ye Fan to make him a slave.
characters.quotes:
— Xia Jiuyo's opinion on the Ancient Sacred Body.

— Xia Jiuyou said coldly to everyone.

characters.title: Xiang Yifei
characters.introText: Here’s a breakdown of the possible etymology and meanings of the Chinese name Xiang Yifei (向一菲):
characters.appearance:
Face:  His face is sharp and clean, with a strong jawline and eyes that radiate confidence. His eyes are sharp, as if they can penetrate the hearts of others, but sometimes they radiate the sadness of the past.

Hair:  Jet black hair, shoulder length, tied in part with a silver cloth ribbon or dark red ribbon — indicating his status or sect. When fighting, his hair often flows wildly, symbolizing freedom and unfettered strength.

Body:  Tall and slender, but full of power — a reflection of years of cultivation training. His movements were as light as the wind, yet each step was steady and filled with the pressure of dao.

Attire:  Wears a long dark Green robe embroidered with clouds and eagles — symbols of freedom, sharp vision, and soaring ambition ( Yifei = "flying in one direction"). His waist is adorned with a jade belt with the symbol of an ancient sect.
characters.personality: Xiang Yifei came from the Great Yan Dinasty. His title is Holy Son of Da Yan.
characters.history: Xiang Yifei came from the Great Yan Dinasty. His title is Holy Son of Da Yan.
characters.trivia: Xiang Yifei survived Ye Fan's massacre at Fire Ridge. Xiang Yifei even reaped great benefits, breaking through to the next realm through Ye Fan's heavenly tribulation.

characters.history: 9,000 years ago, an unrivaled genius appeared in Middle Ground. His name was Xiang Yufei. He had become an Emperor when he was only 19 years old. He was invincible and had the bearing of an ancient emperor. Unfortunately, the heavens were jealous of geniuses. He died at the age of 20, and the Longevity Lock could not prolong his life. According to legend, in his final moments, Xiang Yufei buried himself in an ice coffin and slept on a snowy peak. He wanted to avoid death and resurrection in the future.

characters.history:
The Second Son of the Celestial Court Emperor had arrived. He led an army of one hundred thousand divine soldiers, descending like a storm from the heavens, their sole purpose — to annihilate the scattered remnants of the Celestial Court’s divisions. Now, their vast host advanced along an ancient road, determined to sweep away every obstacle, to crush every thorn that dared stand before them.

The celestial army surged like a tidal wave, draping the firmament in armor and iron. The radiance of their halberds and spears turned the starlight cold, and a killing frost spread across the sky. At the forefront rode Xuan Yi, seated upon a white qilin that shimmered with divine brilliance. His white robes were purer than snow, untouched by dust. When he smiled, there was a strange, demonic allure beneath that calm grace — a beauty both sacred and unsettling. Though he appeared youthful, his eyes carried the depth of an ancient abyss, and when he gave the order to advance, he could not have foreseen the cataclysm his ambition would unleash.

Later generations would call it “The Second Son’s Disaster” — the bloodstained dawn of a new cosmic calamity.

The universe was vast and silent.  In the depths of a distant starry river, Ye Fan’s battle had just ended — a confrontation that shook the heavens, witnessed only by a few who survived that battlefield. The Second Son, in his march of conquest, had no knowledge that another storm of destiny had already unfolded far away — a duel that changed the fate of countless realms.

In the chaos that preceded him, the Dragon Maiden, Shenming, and the Golden Celestial Maiden had already unleashed destruction upon the stars of the Ancient Heavenly Court — shattering divine constellations, splitting ancient Heavenly worlds, and staining sacred territories with rivers of blood. Seeing this, Xuan Yi — proud and eager to prove himself — chose to act as well. Recently, his divine arts had reached their zenith. His form had grown youthful and radiant, his body refined to perfection, his confidence swollen to the point of divine arrogance. As turmoil spread through the starry heavens, word of the celestial slaughter raced from domain to domain, igniting fear and uproar across the ancient territories. Yet Xuan Yi and his followers pressed onward, oblivious to the greater storm approaching from the depths of the cosmos.

When Xuan Yi returned with his troops. They had retreated to the territory controlled by the Celestial Court and entered an impregnable path. After that, he was in no hurry. He didn't believe that someone would offend his father and cause trouble here. However, just as they were quietly returning, the path collapsed. A demon-like figure entered the depths of the Celestial Court and attacked. Ye Fan had arrived. He descended from the sky and reached out to capture the divine son of the Celestial Court, destroyed his physical body. Then, he took his Nascent Soul and sealed it in a large flag, subjecting it to horrific torture.

Inside Jiuxiao Wanfu Palace, the people who can enter are all of high status. They are all sect masters of the big sects. The younger generation is only Dragon Sparrow, Phoenix Goddess, and Kunlun Pisces. Seeing Ye Fan's strength, the sect masters wanted their disciples to learn from him. If a disciple was allowed to cultivate with him, not to mention his inheritance, even their status would be completely different. characters.appearance: The Yaoguang Saintess was like a pearl with sparkling skin. She looked like a fairy from the heavens who had accidentally fallen into the mortal world.
characters.personality:
Yao Xi, the Saintess of the Pure Land of Yao Guang, in a very poetic and captivating manner. Her comparison to a luminous pearl shows the extraordinary beauty and purity that radiates from her, both physically and spiritually.

The description “like a fairy from the sky who accidentally fell into the mortal world” reinforces the impression that Yao Xi is not only beautiful, but also has an unusual divine aura. She seems too pure, too graceful, for the harsh and intrigue-filled world of mortals. It emphasizes that she seems out of place in the world she finds herself in—and thematically, this is very relevant to her decision to flee the “impure” Yao Guang Pure Land.
characters.history:
Yao Xi, as the Holy Maiden of the Yao Guang Holy Land, actually held a very high position—a symbol of purity, a successor to the core teachings, and usually a representation of the will of the sect itself. So when someone like Yao Xi chose to flee, it was an extraordinary event that indicated a serious crisis within the sect.

Yao Xi’s decision was not an impulsive act, but rather the result of deep observation and disappointment. When she said that the Yao Guang Holy Land had changed, it indicated that the values, teachings, and perhaps even the power structure within the sect had been infiltrated or distorted. The phrase that “the Holy Land is like a withered old tree” emphasized that the place no longer had the Qi, purity, or purpose that once made it sacred.

As the Holy Maiden, Yao Xi should have been the most guarded, respected, and protected person. But in reality, she had to flee to save herself—this implied that the danger came not from outside, but from within the sect itself.
