characters.history:
The true identity of Ye Qingxian is Xiao Zi, the daughter of Ye Yishui and Ye Xian. Her name was given by her grandfather, Ye Fan, to safeguard future generations from the darkness that awaited them after the end of the Dharma era. Emperor Ye Tian intervened in time and space, leaving Xiao Zi in ancient times, hoping to seek help from Emperor Huang Tian. However, to avoid karmic consequences, she changed her name to Ye Qingxian.

Ye Qingxian, the extraordinary descendant of Ye Fan, was sent back to ancient times to bridge the gap between the Celestial Emperors Huang and Ye, bearing a tremendous karmic burden. Due to mysterious interference from the ancient ancestor resulting in continuous reductions in her cultivation, she eventually fell into ruin. Yet, Ye Fan resurrected her to fight alongside him in the final battle, completing her path.

In "Perfect World", Ye Qingxian is a mysterious character who appeared midway through the story, helping Shi Hao without revealing her true identity. When Ye Fan entered the celestial realm, he deduced the reason for Emperor Huang Tian's disappearance. Years earlier, Emperor Huang Tian had sacrificed himself, embodying extreme evil for the sake of the celestial realm. Only a few, including Ye Fan, knew the truth. Together, they opened a temporal passage, allowing Ye Fan to kill the dormant extreme evil.

On the other side, Ye Yishui's daughter, Ye Qingxian, was sent to uncover the truth about Emperor Huang Tian during those years. Before Ye Qingxian's departure, she already knew that Ye Fan had faced extreme evil during that period, which had destroyed the soul and could only be revived with the third-cycle life medicine. The news couldn't be transmitted, but by resurrecting Ye Fan, there was hope to convey the information to Emperor Huang Tian of that time, eliminating the danger at that critical moment. This vital information could determine destruction or salvation.
characters.trivia:
Ye Qingxian, is a character in the oriental fantasy novel " Perfect World " written by Chen Dong . She is the granddaughter of Ye Fan , the protagonist of the novel"Shrouding The Heavens". She once protected the Emperor Shi Hao of Desolate Heaven in the Celestial Clan, but was eventually killed by the Lord of the Life Forbidden Zone, Xianling, when the Emperor Shi Hao of Desolate Heaven achieved the status of the Immortal King.

In the novel "Holy Ruins" Ye Qingxian's blood is influenced by the Empress, and her story intertwines with the blood-stained land. After millions of years, the demon's body reappears when Chu Feng, now the Immortal Emperor, stumbles upon her body and resurrects her with his immortal power. After resurrection, Yao Yao regains some of Ye Qingxian's memories and, at the same time, reaches the Immortal King level due to her rebirth. After many eras spent meditating in the chaos, Yao Yao also becomes an Immortal Emperor just before Chu Feng's sacrifice ceremony. In the grand finale, Yao Yao and Ye Qingxian separate into two distinct individuals.

In the novel " Sacred Ruins ", Ye Qingxian's blood was also transformed by the empress and entangled with the blood-stained soil. It was not until millions of years later that Yaoyao's body reappeared. After Chu Feng.

After being resurrected, Yaoyao also awakened some of Ye Qingxian's memories, and at the same time, she rose to the realm of Immortal King by rebirth. After several epochs of cultivation in the depths of chaos, Yaoyao also became an Immortal Emperor on the eve of Chu Feng's sacrifice. In the finale, Yaoyao and Ye Qingxian became two people.

This place became a holy land, and no one knew how powerful the man named Laozi was. In the end, he disappeared, leaving behind an empty mystical realm. Many people had tried to find him, but they all returned empty-handed. In the end, Yin Tiande, who had defeated various sect masters, carried the fate of the world and entered the Eight Visions Palace. Ten years had passed, and people no longer knew how powerful this young man was, who had risen like a legendary emperor!

characters.title: Yuan Gu
characters.introText: Yuan Gu is the eighth generation descendant of Emperor Yuan.
characters.appearance: was a tall and extremely muscular young man. His black hair reached his waist, and his skin was bronze. There was a devilish mist lingering around his body, giving off an extremely oppressive feeling. His eyes were very special. There was a black sun in his left eye, and a blood moon in his right eye. He looked extremely evil, and ordinary people did not dare to look directly at him. He could devour the primordial spirit of humans. His physical body seemed to be able to crush the heavens and the earth, making people tremble in fear.
characters.personality: He is very arrogant and dominating. A type of expert filled with demonic nature.
characters.history:
Yuan Gu, born on the demon mountain in the Primitive Lake. He was the eighth generation grandson of the Primitive Emperor, and his bloodline strength was no weaker than the original son of the ancient emperor. He was the best in his tribe.

In the year when the Primitive Emperor died, two terrifying holy spirits were born one after another. They were both at the peak of the holy spirit realm, and each of them could fight against the ancient emperor…” The two holy spirits were born, and they wanted to take the weapons left by the Primitive Emperor. They came to the tribe and almost wiped out the great imperial family at the peak of its glory. It can be said that in that battle, the earth was dyed red, and the eight great royal families were subordinates. They received the order of the royal family to save them, but all of them died.

The Primitive Emperor had three sons, and each of them could shock the gods and make immortals cry. They were all half a step away from the path, but they all died in that battle, and even their sons were sacrificed. In the end, only a dozen descendants of the youngest son of the Primitive Emperor remained. The most prosperous royal family was almost wiped out from the face of the earth, and it was a tragic scene.  One must know that from the birth of the ancient emperor to his death, and then the rise of the princes, there would be at least tens of thousands of years of golden age. However, they only enjoyed half of the heavenly fortune before they faced the great calamity.  And it was also because of that battle that it was impossible for the descendants of the Primitive Emperor to survive. In the end, they chose the most outstanding descendant, Yuan Gu, who was almost on par with the son of the ancient emperor.
characters.trivia: The Yuan Emperor's Final Secret Technique was indeed more powerful and terrifying than before. This special secret realm was equivalent to purgatory! If one's primordial spirit was trapped here, it was certain death.

Ye Fan met QI Luo in the Heavenly City. The place that Qi Luo chose was very beautiful. It was suspended in the sky, an ancient watchtower connected to each other. It was built with five-colored jade. Rumor has it that it was supported by the Southern Mountains Demon Imperial Palace. Qi Luo said, I want to see how you will perform under the siege of so many young elites. Don’t lower the prestige of the Heavenly Court.  After Qi Luo finished saying this, Killing intent soared into the sky in all directions. Qi pillars pierced through the sky and earth. Blood energy covered the sun and poured down. Dozens to a hundred great experts surrounded the ancient watchtower.

This is the test that Qi Luo gave Ye Fan, he spread the news about Ye fan, then Ye Fan's haters came one by one to kill him. Most of them came from the Archaic Immemorial Races, such as Lu Dongfa, Niu yi, Yue Qianqiu and experts from various races. Ye fan had been surrounded, he immediately started his fight with the six reincarnation fists he flew, splitting the sky and cutting everything in his way! He blocked Lu Dongfa of the Heavenly Feather Race, forced back Niu Yi of the Demon Bull Race, and then quickly killed the four great experts. Suddenly, the huge silver foot emitted a nebula-like light. It shook violently. Meanwhile, Ye Fan's feet also emitted endless light, the sky and earth became a dazzling expanse. Many people flew out like pieces of paper. The person who came was Yue Qianqiu, wearing the Silver Moon Clan's Wind and Cloud Battle Boots. Not finished with Yue Qian Qiu, suddenly he was attacked by the Goddess of the Underworld.

Ye fan fought from right to left, from top to bottom. He finally defeated them one by one, some were killed and some were injured. Goddess of Underworld Severely Injured, Yue Qianque was trampled to death by Ye Fan. Then he broke through his way out.

The embodiment of the natural Dao (Ziran 道法自然) : Not ambitious, not deceitful, not imposing his will — but precisely because of this, he is close to the Dao.

A “Zhenren” (真人): Daoist term for a true human being , who has become one with the Tao and lives according to his true nature, not social engineering or worldly ambition.

Zhang Bairen is a name with great symbolic power:

He is a breaker of the system of bloodlines and destiny , an example that patience and inner strength can overcome holy blood and heavenly talent.

It is a reflection of the Dao , not in brute force, but in wu wei — stillness, poise, and balance in action.

characters.title: Zhao Qingchuan
characters.introText: The name "Zhao Qing chuan" in Chinese has a beautiful and meaningful meaning. "Zhao" (赵) is a common surname in China, while "Qing" (清) means "clear" or "pure", and "chuan" (川) means "river". So, overall, the name "Zhao Qing chuan" can be interpreted as "Zhao who is clear as a river" or "Zhao who is pure and clean as a river".
characters.personality: Zhao Qingchuan was a very influential figure among the younger generation, not only because of his extraordinary skills, but also because of his background as a member of the Zhao Clan—a noble family that wielded great power in the Eternal Star Lord. The Zhao Clan was known to have equal status to the Cao Clan, and the two were considered two major forces that dominated the region, both in terms of political influence and military or spiritual capabilities. The rivalry and alliance between the two clans greatly determined the stability of power on the Eternal Star Lord Planet.

characters.title: Zhao Yanran
characters.introText: Zhao Yanran Zhao Yanran (赵嫣然) is a minor antagonist in the xianxia novel Shrouding the Heavens (Zhetian). She serves as the Holy Maiden of the Wanchu Holy Land and is also a member of the Saint-Assassination Alliance, giving her a unique dual affiliation within the novel's factional landscape. As one of the core disciples of the Wanchu Holy Land, Zhao Yanran became involved in the conflict surrounding Ye Fan during his early cultivation journey. She participated in an assassination attempt against him at Fire Demon Ridge, seeking to eliminate him before he could grow into a greater threat. During the confrontation, however, Ye Fan turned the situation against his attackers by drawing down a heavenly tribulation. Caught within the tribulation's range, Zhao Yanran was ultimately struck down and killed by the heavenly lightning.
characters.history:
Zhao Yanran took Liu Yiyi hostage

Holy Son of Da Yan, Xiang Yifei Together with Holy Son of Dao Yi, Li Donglai, the heir of the Golden Family of the Northern Plains, Jin Chixiao, the Holy Daughter of All Beginnings, Zhao Yanran and 9 other saints and saintesses made a plan to kill Ye Fan. A total of thirteen saints and saintesses had come, and it was comparable to the night when the thirteen Supreme Beings besieged the Heavenly King Jiang Taixu! Liu Yiyi was taken hostage by them and they threatened to kill Yiyi if Ye Fan did not come.

Ye Fan swept his gaze across everyone and said, “Let go of Yiyi. I’ve fulfilled my promise and rushed here. You guys can’t even do this, right?” “Sure, no problem. As long as you’re here, it’s enough. She’s just an insignificant person,” someone said indifferently. “No, I must make him kneel and beg us!” All Beginnings Saint Zhao Yanran’s voice was cold and filled with hatred. Not only was the Holy Son of the All Beginnings Holy Land killed, even the Holy Leader had perished. She only wanted to kill Ye Fan.

The first one attacked the holy child dao yi. Next was the holy child da yan. One by one Ye Fan defeated them. “Why don’t you all come at me together?” Ye Fan said and laughed. Facing 13 Saints alone, his tone showed that he was not afraid at all. Everyone surrounded him, and their killing intent enveloped him.

Facing this, Chaos Green Lotus appeared beside Ye Fan. Countless strands of mist shook, turning everything into illusory flowers. Everything disappeared. The saints took turns to go up to test their strength, and each of them displayed their ultimate techniques. However, the thirteen heroes couldn't break through at all. They were forced back by Ye Fan, and some of them even coughed up a mouthful of blood. You all have to gather! Ye Fan laughed again. 
"Kill!" 
Finally someone rushed up together. Even the older generation figures wanted to take action, not giving him a chance. A miserable scream sounded, and a rain of blood poured down. At that moment, Ye Fan suddenly acted ruthlessly, activating the secret of All characters. The secret of the Row character was displayed, and he threw himself up ruthlessly. A saint child was blasted with his bare hands, turning into a bloody paste, dying a cruel death. At the same time, one of the Saint Child of All Beginnings' arms was torn off, blood splattering everywhere. "You..." The Saint Child of All Beginnings almost fainted. She retreated to the center of the crowd, her beautiful face pale, shocked and angry at the same time. “Alright, you’ve all tested him. Now, it’s time to kill him!” An elder spoke.

The Holy Maiden of All Beginnings stood in the middle of the crowd, her face pale. One of her jade arms had been torn off, and her entire body was covered in cold sweat. Her hair that reached her waist was dyed red with blood, and she was on the verge of fainting. “Is there not a single one of you who dares to fight me?” Ye Fan looked at the 13 Holy Sons, with a hint of mockery on his face. The expressions of all the Holy Sons changed. Ever since they were young, who had ever spoken to them like this? There was actually a hint of disdain in his tone! They were the prodigies of the Eastern Desolation, and had always been the center of attention. They were proud and respected, so when had they ever been looked down upon like this?

However, at this moment, none of them stepped forward. Among them, not a single one had the confidence to suppress Ye Fan. Just now, everyone had already tested him. The 13 Holy Sons were unable to do anything to Ye Fan, and because of that, some were seriously injured, and there was even one who lost his life here. This was a lesson learned, and blood was the proof!

characters.title: Zi Tiandu
characters.introText: He had purple hair and was tall and handsome, no different from a human male, he wore a purple robe. when they saw him, they would know that he was a descendant of the ancient king with the purest bloodline.
characters.appearance: He had purple hair and was tall and handsome, no different from a human male, he wore a purple robe. when they saw him, they would know that he was a descendant of the ancient king with the purest bloodline.
characters.history:
One by one the ancient races of the ten thousand races have awakened after being sealed for millions of years. Zi Tiandu is one of them, he is the young master of the Valley of the Gods. Zi Tiandu is good friends with Wang Teng, he once followed Wang Teng to the Ji family. At that time Wang Teng wanted to propose to Ji Ziyue. There he also saw Ye Fan fighting with Wang Teng. After the fight, Zi Tiandu's older sister invited Ye Fan to the Valley of the Gods as an honored guest. Zi Tiandu had bad thoughts towards Ye Fan, but before he planned it, Ye Fan left with the Nine Dragons pulling the coffin. After twelve years of Ye Fan's disappearance, he finally returned and heard a lot of news about his friends being hunted by the ancient race. One of them was Zi Tiandu who forced Dongfang Ye to jump off a cliff. Ye Fan then looked for Zi Tiandu in Vermilion Bird City. Ye Fan borrowed a travel portal from Nan Yao, and went to Vermilion Bird City looking for Zi Tiandu, because Zi Tiandu was not there, he slaughtered the ancient race

One month after the destruction of the Wang family, Zi Tiandu came to Vermilion Bird City in the Bright Moon Palace. There was a peaceful and pure land for sect master level figures to gather and talk about the dao. There was also a romantic place where the unparalleled beauties of the Southern Ridge could appear, but they definitely would not stay overnight. In addition, there was also an ancient cave left behind by an ancient sage. It was moved here to allow those who came later to comprehend the dao and attract living fossils. The Bright Moon Pavilion was located in the sky above the Southern Ridge Vermilion Bird City. From the outside, it looked like a heavenly palace, but after entering, it was a completely different world. There was a small world here that was a hundred li in circumference. It had existed for tens of thousands of years.

Chen Yuan, Liu Yunjie, Kong Lingdao, and Xie Siyuan were young experts from the Southern Ridge. Although they were not as strong as the Southern Demon, they had great backgrounds. Some were sons of gods, some were direct descendants of ancient demons, and some even inherited the orthodoxy and officially became highly respected young sect masters. However, they were not the main characters at this time. They accompanied the young master of the Valley of the Gods and invited Zi Tiandu to a grand banquet. In the function, Zi Tiandu became the center of attention of many people from the younger generation who asked him about the younger generation of the ancient race, Zi Tiandu always answered them by comparing him to the Zincient desolated sacred body. He talked big and made fun of Ye Fan. After he finished speaking, Ye Fan appeared with a sword in hand, walking with big strides.

There were more than ten ancient creatures at the entrance of the garden, Ye Fan swung his sword, cold light poured out, drowning this place like a heavenly river. He killed ten people with one move, taking action ruthlessly. The expressions of Chen Yuan, Liu Yunjie, Kong Linghua, Xie Siyuan and the others all changed. The smiles on the faces of several pearls in the Southern Mountains also froze. Ye Fan was like a demon god. With just one sword, he charged over, and no one could stop him for even half a step. Just now, they were still discussing casually, and some even belittled and criticized Ye Fan. But now that they had seen it in person, none of them dared to speak.

Zi Tiandu finally took action. Above his head, a purple ancient pagoda rose and fell. Thunder rumbled in the sky, and tens of thousands of strands of purple energy descended, protecting him below. A battle shook the heavens and the earth. As the two collided, a burst of light similar to the collapse of the starry sky could be seen. This place became the center of the storm, rapidly expanding outward. Large amounts of blood rained down. Zi Tiandou’s hair was disheveled and his entire arm was covered in blood. His right hand changed shape, convulsing uncontrollably as it was thrown out. A series of drum sounds rang out, so heavy that it sounded like heavenly thunder. A dragon-skinned drum appeared in Zi Tiandou’s hand, and with each beat, a dao light shot out. The “Ah” mantra was transformed by Ye Fan with the Secret Words of Fighting, and it became the Sacred Sound of Fighting. Zi Tiandu’s body shook violently, and cracks appeared one after another. This was a world-shaking battle. In the blink of an eye, the two exchanged more than a hundred blows. When the battle reached the 500th round, Ye Fan punched out with the Six Paths of Reincarnation Fist, shattering the void. The top level of the purple pagoda cracked open before exploding with a bang. Zi Tiandu screamed in pain as he was thrown into the air along with the fourth-level pagoda. Fist after fist smashed out. Boundless holy light filled every inch of space between heaven and earth. Zi Tiandu used his hands to block, but his hands shattered on the spot. Even his chest almost exploded. His body was crisscrossed and covered in countless cracks as blood flowed out. All kinds of weapons in the sky were destroyed. Ye Fan slaughtered crazily. He found an opportunity and tore off Zi Tiandu's arm. The next moment, he stepped on Zi Tiandu's chest and directly smashed his chest into pieces. Ye Fan destroyed all of Zi Tiandu's confidence and dignity.

After almost losing, ZI Tiandu released the secret technique of the Valley of the Gods. A technique that can exchange souls and take over someone's body. He wanted to take Ye Fan's body. But unexpectedly, Ye Fan's primordial power was stronger than his. ZI Tiandu finally died miserably. After that, the sage character from Zi Tiandu's body came out to attack Ye Fan, an ancestor from the Valley of the Gods appeared. Zi Tiandu's ancestor attacked him after Zi Tiandu's death with The ancient king's typography. Li Tian came with the Divine Furnace to stop the ancient Character and erase its traces. After killing Zi Tiandu Ye Fan didn't leave, he sat there waiting for the enemy to come one by one..

cultivation.title: Divine Bridge

cultivation.introText: Represents the True Dragon of the Spine (Back) of the Human Body exploring one's potential to establish the Immortal Platform of the Head. Established by Heavenly Emperor Huāng for his personal Supreme improvement and then for the Transcendence Volume to become Daozu (Quasi-Immortal Emperor), years after he unintentionally awakened the Sea of Bitterness to survive a life-death calamity. cultivation.history:

The Dragon Transformation Realm secretly hides the lost True Dragon Treasure Technique in the Shrouding the Heavens World, therefore, non-human or dragon bloodline inheritors seek to complete the Dragon Transformation Realm to attain a possible sliver of this Quasi-Immortal art.

cultivation.title: Four Pole Realm
cultivation.introText: Succeeds the Dao Palace Realm. To enter this realm one needs to sense the heaven and earth energies. This realm basically cultivates the Four Limbs as the Four Poles touching the void of Great Dao. This realm is divided into four realms cultivating the respective four limbs in each realm. Cultivators can develop spatial/void abilities at this Realm. The order of cultivation varies depending on the practitioner. Upon completion of cultivating the four limbs, one reaches a state where hands and feet connect heaven and earth, and every movement and gesture embodies the mysteries of laws and techniques. They are nearly impossible to kill by purely physical means. As long as the head escapes and the primordial spirit remains undamaged, the body can be regenerated. Divine sense can materialize into tangible entities, possess external objects, search souls and capture spirits, read minds through soul-searching, and modify memories. To improve and cultivate all the Four Limbs, one needs to dual cultivate one's physique and Dao (law power). This will prepare for the Dragon Transformation Realm, cultivating the Spine with Dao into a True Dragon.
cultivation.trivia:
Ye Fan arrived at this realm after facing heavenly tribulation. Usually special physique users have higher potential so they face tribulations during the process of entering this realm.

cultivation.title: Great Emperor
cultivation.introText: The Great Emperor (大帝) is the last publicly known realm of Shrouding the Heavens world. Equivalent to the Supreme Being of the Heavenly Emperor Huāng's former world. It succeeds Quasi-Emperor and can be succeeded by Heavenly Emperor or Red Dust Immortal when without access to the Immortal Realm. Normally based on the former world, the next realm is the True Immortal stage of the Immortal Dao Realm.
cultivation.appearance:
The successive realm after Quasi-Emperor. The essence of immortality lies in the spirit, the consciousness; its very easy to make one's body eternal. Great Emperors are what can be called "Half-Immortals"; possessing their battle power but not their longevity. Due to Shi Hao being able to kill immortals while only being a Zhi Zun (Perfect World), and the fact that nobody who can become a Great Emperor in the severely damaged mortal world would be normal, Great Emperors would likely be in the same realm of power Shi Hao was. By the Post-Barren Ancient Era, the Chaos Ancient Era Great Emperors were long gossip and fairytales.

A Great Emperor usually lives for 10,000 and can increase to 20,000 if he or she attempts the second life extension. Generally, no Quasi-Emperor may become a Great Emperor in the first 10,000 years of the last Great Emperor's death. Each successful Great Emperor determines the rise and decline of its Racial Group. During this period, the world enters a state similar to a “Dharma‑Ending Age,” where cultivation becomes extremely difficult and even a Saint may only appear once every few thousand years. However, a few rare physiques—such as the Chaotic Body and the Innate Saint Body Dao Embryo—are exceptions, as they are not suppressed by any laws.

A confident Great Emperor will attempt to become an Immortal of the Mortal World, the Red Dust Immortal equivalent Quasi-Immortal King.

The Heavenly Emperor (天帝) is a combat power designation in Shrouding the heavens universe. It refers to a title granted to those who reach an invincible level within the “Great Emperor” realm. Although they share the same cultivation level—Perfect Integration of the Five Great Secret Realms—as ordinary Great Emperors, their combat strength can overwhelm multiple Great Emperors. Moreover, they do not need to rely on the Celestial Heart Mark to maintain their imperial status, distinguishing them from Supremes who sever their Dao Fruit.

Generally, the difference in combat strength between Great Emperors is extremely small; when two fight, it often ends in mutual destruction. However, there are exceptions—this is where the Heavenly Emperor comes in. A Heavenly Emperor possesses power that surpasses ordinary Great Emperors and can face several at once without falling into disadvantage.

Even among Heavenly Emperors, there are differences. A Great Emperor who has just attained Heavenly Emperor–level combat power is not on the same level as one who has lived nine lifetimes and is on the verge of becoming immortal.

The Heavenly Emperor is a title, not a cultivation realm. It stands above ordinary Great Emperors. To earn this title, one must possess supreme combat power that exceeds that of normal Great Emperors. 
Few Have attained the title Heavenly emperor:

Eternal Heavenly Emperor

Ruthless Emperor

Duan De as Tribulation Heavenly Venerable in Nether Ancient Era

Great Emperor Scriptures (大帝古经, also called 帝经 or Emperor Scriptures) in Shrouding the Heavens refer to the supreme cultivation manuals created or perfected by Great Emperors the highest beings on the human cultivation path. When a Great Emperor reaches the peak of their Dao, they condense their lifetime of enlightenment, ultimate techniques, and deepest understanding of heaven and earth into a scripture. These texts become indestructible legacies that far surpass ordinary ancient manuals or holy land inheritances.

Each Great Emperor Scripture usually focuses on one or more of the 'Five Secret Realms. Many contain the strongest known method for a specific realm—for example, the Dao De Scripture’s Wheel Sea chapter is considered unmatched for foundational cultivation. Because of their power, these scriptures are extremely rare and are fiercely guarded by Holy Lands, Imperial Clans, and ancient sects. Some scriptures also have strict requirements, such as needing a specific physique; for instance, the Beginningless Scripture can only be cultivated by someone with the Innate Saint Physique Dao Embryo.

Not every Great Emperor leaves behind a complete scripture. Some leave only partial volumes, fragments, or individual supreme techniques. Throughout the story, Ye Fan gathers the strongest per‑realm methods from multiple Emperor Scriptures and eventually fuses them into his own ultimate manual—the Heavenly Emperor Scripture (天帝经). Unlike most Emperor Scriptures, it has no physique restrictions and, when fully mastered, guarantees the ability to reach the Great Emperor realm.

A person who cultivates the secret realm system using his body as his seed without resorting to external forces, and finally achieves enlightenment. The most powerful person who attains enlightenment after the five secret realms are perfectly integrated into one, and finally makes a final leap, merges with the mark of Tianxin, and becomes the emperor. The highest realm of humanistic monks, the Supreme of the Ancient Era, the Heavenly Lord of the Mythical Era, the Emperor of the Ancient Era, and the Great Emperor of the Ancient Era are all in this realm.

The Supreme, Heavenly, Ancient Emperor, and Great Emperor who achieve the imperial status can integrate the Tianxin Seal and suppress others to achieve enlightenment. After becoming a great emperor, one's own imperial law will be promoted from the quasi-emperor's law at the quasi-emperor level to the law of the great emperor, suppressing no one in the nine heavens and ten places . However, after breaking away from the mark of Tianxin and cultivating oneself, one will fall into a lower state, and his strength is roughly equivalent to another form of enlightenment. After the great changes in the world, there will only be one enlightened person in an era.

The Great Emperor comes to the world and commands the vast universe. He is respected by all in the universe and no one refuses to obey him. The emperor's lifespan can reach ten thousand or twenty thousand years, and he can use elixirs to live out his second life. At this stage, other than killing himself or passing away, he will become an immortal. But there are always some geniuses who can live for many lives and eventually become immortals in the mortal world. There is also a gap in combat power between great emperors. There are some who are particularly heaven-defying. After becoming great emperors, they take a half step further and reach the pinnacle of the extreme realm. Their strength far exceeds that of ordinary great emperors. In order to distinguish them, they can be called heavenly emperors (天帝). When they reach the level of heavenly emperors, Level one can already refine immortal weapons. Emperor of Heaven is a title rather than a realm. It is a title that is derived from being too powerful to distinguish ordinary emperors. Such a strong person is still an emperor even if he breaks away from the Tianxin Mark, unlike the ancient emperor, the Great Emperor, and the Forbidden City's Dark Supreme who cut themselves off, and their realm will fall after cutting off the Tianxin Mark.

Great Emperors and their titles are grouped by Eras: Chaos Ancient, Mythological, Supreme Ancient, Barren Ancient, Post-Barren Ancient and finally Heavenly Emperor. Each Era has unique characteristics that separate it from others:

Chaos Ancient: Rise of Heavenly Emperor Huāng and his comrade-in-arms. No Great Emperor titles and the most foggy era. The initial spread of the current Five Secret Realms cultivation system of Shrouding the Heavens, but originally called Becoming a Seed.

Mythological: Commonly use "Tiānzūn" <Heavenly Lord> in their title, but not all use it. Era with many "Earth Chinese mythological beings" becoming Great Emperor. Creation of the Nine Secrets, the Nine Characters: 前字秘 ("Qián"), 兵字秘 ("Bīng"), 数字秘 ("Shù"), 组字秘 ("Zǔ"), 斗字秘 ("Dòu"), 临字秘 ("Lín"), 行字秘 ("Xíng"), 者字秘 ("Zhě"), and 皆字秘 ("Jiē").

Supreme Ancient: Commonly use "Huáng" <Sovereign> in their title, most apply it. Fall, enslavement and finally new rise of the Human Race to dominate the universe over the myriad races from then on. Due to causality, many Great Emperors were murdered by the era founder Heavenly Sovereign Bù Sǐ who only sought to complete his Nine Turns Nirvana through Great Emperor blood to alone become an Immortal and return to his homeland.

Barren Ancient: Free in title since this era: commonly use "Dàdì" <Great Emperor> or "Dì" <Emperor> in their title, but also <Sovereign> as a title. Several Great Emperors were murdered by Heavenly Sovereign Bù Sǐ for his Nine Turns Nirvana. Birth of two known heavenly-defying Immortal Emperor potential geniuses: Ruthless of Mortality and Wú Shǐ of Morality.

Post-Barren Ancient: Law Finality Era when cultivation resources dropped or even completely disappeared in quantities. High difficulty to prove Dao and enlightenment into Great Emperor, even the Immortal Platform Realm became a struggle. The restrain was semi-broken by the Azure Emperor Wàn Qīng, whose leftover Dao marks disappearance postmortem allowed a rise of new geniuses, mainly Ye Fan.

Heavenly Emperor: Rise of Great Emperors in mass and made titles useless. Heavenly Emperor Yè rises and proves Red Dust Immortal, opening the path to true Immortal Dao and ending the Law Finality Era. Leads to the Sacred Ruins world.

This demonstrates their extraordinary control over primordial forces and their ability to construct independent spaces on a world-like scale. However, naturally occurring Small Worlds containing genuine life and vitality are exceptionally rare.

No two true Great Emperors can exist at once, due to the limitation of the Shrouding the Heavens World's Heavenly Dao. (Dao of Heaven)
Exceptions are Red Dust Immortals.

cultivation.title: Immortal of the Mortal World
cultivation.introText: Immortal of the Mortal World or commonly known as the Red Dust Immortal (红尘仙), is the mortal version equivalent theoretical realm after Great Emperor, with a total of Nine Transformations: 8th reaching True Immortal combat ability and the final 9th Life reaching Quasi-Immortal King. It should be noted that mortal world is also equivalently known as red dust world.
cultivation.appearance:
A Great Emperor in the Shrouding the Heavens World must live several lives by comprehending long life dao from immortal medicine and various means, living one life to another, achieving ultimate rebirth several times until his/her life force no longer corroded by the passage of time.

Some Great Emperors in the Shrouding the Heavens World lacked the willpower and confidence to attempt the path of the Red Dust Immortal to the 9th end as well as would rather bet on the safer, but less likely, appearing Gate of the Immortal Realm, therefore, they slashed off their connection to Heaven as Great Emperors and placed themselves in a semi-stasis state at certain forbidden areas to slow down their lifespan dissipation and became the Ancient Emperors. Abandoning all morality and natural self from their Dao, these former Great Emperors periodically come out of their seal to indifferently massacre any weaker creature to squeeze and devour life essence to extend their lifespan. These massacres leave many starry skies almost lifeless, gloomy and dark, hence, the Dark Turmoil feared by many in history until the era of Heavenly Emperor Yè.
cultivation.history:
Red Dust Immortal was established by Heavenly Emperor Huāng (Shi Hao) when he was looking for a way to transcend his mortal limits as the world enters Cultivationless Age. This is the age where great dao is backlashing the cultivators in the world. The impact towards Shi Hao is minimal since he is using "body as the seed" approach to transform himself to transcend above heaven and earth. During his fruitful encounter in Heaven Connecting Land, Shi Hao was transported into the Age of Emperor Collapse, basically living in countless past ages from the era he's living in. He found out that the situation in this era is practically the same as Cultivationless Age that his era is suffering. There were too many dead true immortals and their dao is covering heaven and earth, limiting mortals from transcending to the next realm. Thus, in order to return and keep living, Shi Hao used multiple means to live life after life and finally live 8 lives, where he's already 490,000 years old, before returning to his own era using the Embodiment Transformation Technique and that mysterious drop of blood. He arrived at Imperial Pass and years has yet to pass. At this point in his eighth life, he's already equivalent or slightly stronger than normal true immortal or undying beings. When he returns to the current age, he is still 1800 years old to other people. When he has lived around 13,000 years in the current age, he met darkness Huo Ling'er in the Dam World, then he started training crazily without regards to his life. He spends 900 years cultivating by engaging in a life and death battle in Void Immortal Gold Stele against a copy of his true self gaining further insight and comprehension of Dao where he dies during first 100 years and revives once more only to battle himself and almost dying every time for another 800 years (total of 9 lives that he has lived up till this point). Finally, he faces and survives through terrifying Immortal Ascension Tribulation. His promotion to Immortal is called 9 lives Immortal Ascension.

The aspect of living nine lives seems to be the same in Shrouding the Heavens World. However, the ascension from Great Emperors to Red Dust Immortal is not accompanied with Immortal Ascension Light. It should be noted that Shi Hao or Huang created his cultivation system to produce mighty warriors who can fight against foreign realm and dark turmoil. Simultaneously, Shi Hao wanted these top cultivators to establish their own Dao and not become constrained by his and the system at Great Emperor (Supreme), therefore, enable advancement to Immortal Kings, Immortal Emperors and beyond. The Red Dust Immortal is a cultivator who can fight Immortals as a Mortal while not completely following Heavenly Emperor Huāng's Perfect World World immortal system's dependence on the Immortal Realm, hence, the Immortal of the Mortal World.

But unlike the previous realms, the Immortal Platform is divided by stages: the initial stage, the intermediate stage, and the peak or advanced stage.

Six Reincarnation Fist is a pinnacle martial art that combines the principles of the six paths of reincarnation in ancient teachings. Each path represents a different form of power and emotion, making this technique extremely complex, yet extremely terrifying on the battlefield.

With each punch, the user calls upon the power of one of the reincarnation paths. If fully mastered, all six punches can be unleashed in one sequence, creating a nearly unstoppable force.

1️⃣ The Way of Heaven (天道拳 Tiān Dào Quán)

Contains divine power and heavenly blessings.

Each blow purifies and destroys dark energy.

Can heal oneself in battle.

2️⃣ The Path of Man (人道拳 Rén Dào Quán)

Represents human will, courage, and determination.

A punch full of pure physical strength, relying on will to break through all obstacles.

artifacts.title: Investiture of the Gods
artifacts.introText: The Investiture of the GodsGod-Sealing List (封神榜)(Fēng Shén Bǎng) is one of the most mysterious and powerful treasures in Shrouding the Heavens (遮天), a supreme relic personally forged by Great Emperor Wu Shi hundreds of thousands of years ago. Although it appears outwardly as nothing more than an ancient scroll, its true nature is far more extraordinary. It was created by Wu Shi at the height of his power as a divine treasure intended to seal beings that surpassed ordinary cultivators. According to legend, Wu Shi originally wished to forge a sacred artifact capable of sealing Immortals and therefore named it the (Investiture of the Immortals)Immortal-Sealing List(封仙榜)(Fēng xiān bǎng). However, after discovering that the so-called immortals of ancient legends did not truly exist and that only god-like beings remained within the world, he ultimately renamed it the Investiture of the Gods God-Sealing List, a title that would become renowned throughout the ages.
artifacts.appearance:
This artifact successively suppressed the Undying Daoist and his physical body, as well as the corpse of the Great Accomplished Saint Body. Its power is equivalent to the Great Emperor Wushi personally taking action
The God-Sealing List appears as an ancient scroll but possesses unimaginable power. Its primary abilities include:

World Sealing – capable of sealing entire regions or worlds.

Supreme Suppression – able to suppress even the most powerful beings in existence.

Imperial-Level Power – its might is considered equivalent to a personal strike from Great Emperor Wu Shi.

Heavenly Court Fortune Gathering – capable of gathering, stabilizing, and concentrating the destiny and luck of the Heavenly Court.

Divine Investiture – able to bestow divine titles and perform ceremonies similar to the ancient process of deification.
artifacts.history:
The God-Sealing List is a divine artifact from the Shrouding the Heavens. Forged by Great Emperor Wu Shi, it possesses the extraordinary ability to seal worlds and suppress supreme experts. Throughout the story, it was used to suppress the Undying Taoist and his physical body, as well as the corpse of a Great Accomplishment Saint Body. Its power is considered equivalent to Wu Shi personally taking action. Known wielders of the artifact include Great Emperor Wu Shi and Gai Jiuyou.

During the Myriad Races Assembly at Yaochi, Gai Jiuyou unfurled the God-Sealing List, creating a devouring vortex that intimidated the Ancient Royal Clans. Later, during the events surrounding the Immortal Road, the God-Sealing List was damaged but subsequently reassembled. Afterward, it reproduced the imprint of the world itself and disrupted the formation process of Emperor Zun's World Cauldron.

In the later stages of the story, Ying Hao used the God-Sealing List at the Immortal Platform of Celestial Venerable Lingbao to inscribe divine titles. Through a ritual of divine investiture, he conferred the title of Supreme Pure Moral Heavenly Venerable upon Lao Zi, as well as a divine title upon Chuan Ying. This event revealed another hidden function of the God-Sealing List: its ability to gather and consolidate the destiny, fortune, and providence of the Heavenly Court.

artifacts.title: Myriad Things Mother Qi
artifacts.introText: The Myriad Things Mother Qi Cauldron was conceived by Ye Fan as part of his plan to forge an unparalleled cauldron. After opening the Golden Sea of Bitterness, he collected vast quantities of herbs and began the process of crafting the cauldron. Its primary material is Myriad Things Mother Qi (玄黄母气), a rare and highly valuable refining substance originally used by the Ruthless Great Emperor (狠人大帝) to forge extreme Dao weapons. This primordial material contains the fundamental power of the universe and emits an immense aura of Mysterious Yellow Qi.
artifacts.appearance:
Refinement Process

Ye Fan obtained a large supply of Myriad Things Mother Qi within the Bronze Immortal Palace (青铜仙殿) and meticulously forged it into the Myriad Things Mother Qi Cauldron. The Kunlun Strange Emperor further enhanced the cauldron by refining it with the Purple Flames of the Fire Domain for three months, improving its quality and durability.

Fusion and Evolution

As Ye Fan’s cultivation advanced, the cauldron evolved alongside him. He integrated nine types of immortal scriptures and absorbed the powers of numerous Emperor-level weapons. This continuous evolution transformed the cauldron into the Heavenly Emperor Cauldron (天帝鼎), its final form as a peerless immortal artifact, far surpassing ordinary extreme Dao weapons in power.

Properties and Power

Defense: Even at an early stage, the cauldron displayed extraordinary defensive capabilities. It floats above Ye Fan’s head, emitting chaotic qi that can crush voids, offering him powerful protection.

Offense: The cauldron is not only extremely durable but also immensely powerful in attack. In combat, it can suppress any opponent, nullify or even reflect enemy attacks, and deliver fatal strikes. Ye Fan used it to defeat countless formidable enemies.

Evolution Ability: The cauldron continuously evolves as Ye Fan grows stronger. From its initial form to the final Heavenly Emperor Cauldron, it underwent multiple upgrades, each time reflecting Ye Fan’s increased cultivation and power.
artifacts.history:
Myriad Things Mother Qi—also called Mysterious Yellow Mother Qi (玄黄母气) or All Things Origin Mother Qi—is one of the rarest and most exalted primordial substances in Shrouding the Heavens. It originates from the dawn of creation itself, embodying the essence, foundation, and generative source of all existence. Even a single wisp is unimaginably heavy, surpassing mountains in weight, and contains boundless potential for creation, suppression, and refinement.

Within the story, Myriad Things Mother Qi appears as a formless, gaseous primordial energy capable of transforming into countless manifestations. It is a supreme material for forging unparalleled artifacts, most famously the Myriad Things Mother Qi Cauldron (万物母气鼎). This legendary cauldron was created by Ye Fan, who obtained the root source of this qi during his exploration of the Bronze Immortal Palace (青铜仙殿). Some accounts imply that the Ruthless Great Emperor (狠人大帝) had once safeguarded or left this primordial substance within the palace.

Using his refining methods and the chaotic flames of the Bronze Immortal Palace, Ye Fan gradually shaped the cauldron. What began as a simple copper vessel eventually evolved into the true Myriad Things Mother Qi Cauldron, becoming his central treasure from the Wheel Sea Realm onward. The cauldron grew stronger alongside him, absorbing divine energy, heavenly tribulations, and Dao imprints from defeated enemies—including supreme beings from forbidden zones.

Later, after stepping into the Great Emperor realm, Ye Fan fused nine types of immortal divine gold—such as Immortal Tears Green Gold, Phoenix Blood Red Gold, and Dragon Pattern Black Gold—to forge a nine-colored immortal cauldron. Merging this with the original Mother Qi Cauldron, he ultimately created the Heavenly Emperor Cauldron (天帝鼎), a peerless immortal artifact.

The properties of Myriad Things Mother Qi make the cauldron extraordinarily versatile. It can:

suppress enemies with overwhelming weight and primordial pressure

refine or absorb energy and Dao principles from defeated foes

nurture divine materials or imprison opponents within its internal world

provide near-impenetrable defense

continuously evolve by integrating the Dao marks of adversaries

artifacts.title: Sun Scripture
artifacts.introText: The True Sun Scripture also  known as the True Sun Scripture or the Immortal Sun Scripture  was created by the Sun Saint Emperor, one of the two supreme ancestors of the human race in the ancient times. It is known as the "Mother Scripture of the Human Race" along with the True Yin Scripture

artifacts.title: Wushi Bell
artifacts.introText: The Wushi Bell (无始钟, Wúshǐ Zhōng) is the signature Imperial Weapon of Wushi the Great, forged by the Great Emperor as his ultimate divine weapon. Wushi sought exceptionally rare materials capable of withstanding and embodying the power of Chaos, travelling across the world in search of a life-bearing Chaos Small World. He ultimately obtained Chaos Stone (混沌石) from the Immortalization Pool (化仙池) in the Qinling Mountains, from which he refined the immortal material required for the bell.
artifacts.appearance: His signature Great Emperor Imperial Weapon
artifacts.personality:
During the era of Shrouding the Heavens (遮天), the Wushi Bell existed as an Extreme Dao Emperor Weapon created by Wushi Great Emperor.

Even in this form, it was already one of the strongest weapons in the universe. It possessed enough power to suppress Ancient Supremes, protect humanity from dark turmoil, and represent the peak of the Great Emperor realm.

Its abilities at this stage focused primarily on:

Absolute suppression.

Imperial-level destruction.

Sealing dangerous existences.

Protecting its wielder and allies.

After the events of Shrouding the Heavens, the Wushi Bell continued to evolve and eventually reached the level of an Immortal Artifact.

Its appearance in Perfect World Chapter 1765 — “Frozen World” revealed the terrifying level it had reached in the future. At this stage, the bell was no longer limited to suppressing enemies through imperial might; its Dao laws could affect an entire battlefield, freezing space-time and turning a massive conflict into a motionless historical scene.
